chos 'khor/po grub lte/ mdo las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par ma bgyis par chos kyi dngor lo bskor bar mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub lte/ rtsabag gang dang yang dag ldan pas/ zhes dang/ mdo las kyang] rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyidadang ldan pas tshog kyi gakhor lo bskor ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab lte/ chos 'khor bskor ba la lha sogs 'phro ba gzhan gyis mi nus pa tshangs pa'i gangor lo dang / 'dzig rten thams cad zil gyis mnan pa gcigadagos pa'i phyid dang po grub ste/nyi khri las/ mi 'jigs pa thob pa'i gnas te/ khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bca'o/ /dngor gyinang du seng ge'i sgra slog go/tshangs pa'i gsor lo 'jig rten na dge bhyong ngam/ bram ze 'am/ lta'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs spru 'am/ gzhan sus kyang rung bas chos dang ldan par 'jig rten du bskor bar mi nus pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang]dgongs 'grel las kyang] chos kyi dngor longo mtshar rmad du byung ba sngon lhar gyur ba/ sogs gsungs pa'i pyidagazhanayang/ 'gog bden chos can/ mngon rtogasasan par thal/rtogs pa'i chos gshor yin pa'i phyig der thal/rtogs pa'i bstan ba la thob byed lam bdenadang thob bya'i 'bras bu 'dog bden gnyis yod ba'i phyir te/ kun btus las/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa yang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbye bas 'gog pa dang lam gyi bden pa dag go/zhes gsungs pa'i phyig de la kho na re/ lung gi chos dngor bskor ba po'i sems canawend par thal/ lung gi chos gshor rtsom pa po'i sems can yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/des lung gi tshig brtsams kyang brjodadon 'dzig rten du bskor ba 4 sangs rgyas kho na yin gyi gsar ga rang byang sems gang yangade masan pa'i phyiranta/ rnam mkhyen ma thob pa'i phyiradangan 'gran zla bral ba'i sgonas mayin pa'i phyir te/dedag dang don dngos gnas la 'dra ba du ma mthun snang du yod pa'i phyig de la kho na re/ lung gi chos gshor bskor ba'i sa brgyad pa ba yod par thal/ 'grel ba las/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor 107
phar byinaskabasadang po/ba dang]zhes gsungs pa'i pyir na ma khyab ste/ma 'ongs pa na chos zhagar bskor ba'i rgyur ba'i nus pa 'di nas thob par bshad tsam yin pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ lam ma zhugs kyi snying rje rtogs pa'i bstan pa yin par thal/ lam ma zhugs kyi snying rje chen po rtogs pa'i bstan pa yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ lam ma zhugs kyi lhag bsam dang snying rje chen 4 sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin kyang]snying rje tsam rgyud ldan gyi phyi rol pa yang yod pa'i sgyigakun btus las/phyi rol pa'am nyan thos sam byang chub semasadapa' yang (1)rung /dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi la brten nas rtswa sa/ ṭwāṃ shārnyi ( dron paX snro rnghi dwo/ pa/snro pa/lhangapa dṛ hūm̐ ༈ pa'i lugs/thal khur ba'i lugs bshad pagasum/dang po la kha cig na re/sangs rgyas kyi bka' thams cad 'khor lo rim pa gsum du ma 'dus zegakha (2rig 'khor lo rim pa gsum du 'dus kyang 'khor lo gsum du grangs mnges (3rigade gnyis ka mi gud par thal/bka' thams cad 'khor lo rim pa gsum ༈ rnyi( rnghi spri dī dī ñdzakāhā ( /pa/ parnyirnyi( snasade ca ༷tsho (lha kṣiṃ zlo dzo )pa sna dā rdzu lha // pa gsungs pa'i 'khor lo gsum du 'gyur ba'i phyigader thal/de rjesab srasadang ston pa'idagongs ba yin ba'i phyir te/rnam bshad las/ chos kyi 'khor lo chor bu thor bur gsungs pa rnams kyi (9 hā/lha /༷pa ñtsha do dzño dīrsha zlosdishāX'i/ :pa ༈ dzorā rā rirnyi ( pa~X dzño ( tram̐ shā /shā )pa gar 7) zhikhan gyi spri snodadang shag gnyis zeg chen gyi sde snodado//zhes gsungs pa'i nyid1 bar zengs gnyis ba/rung lte/2 bar zengs gnyisab/cigashas 'khor 4 gsum/3 bar zengs gnyisapa/zer na/108
chos 'khor/gzhanasang bka' thams cad lha'or lo gsum du grangs nges par thal/bka' thams cad bsdus na dusadang soragasungs pa'i pangor lodang 4dang]dus bar bar gsungs pa'i gnar lo bar ba dang]dus tha mar gsungs pa'i dngor lo tha ma gsum du grangasanges pa'i phyir te/de ltar grangs nges paradagongs 'grel dri zhus kyis shugs la bstan pa'i migadagongs 'grel las/bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mar phung po rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyang bka' bstsal/nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mar bden pa rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyang bka' bstsal/nas/rnam grangs du mar khams rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyang bka' bstsal/nas/yang bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cadango bo nyid ma mchis pa/nas/myangan las 'das ba zhes kyang bka' bstsal lagasan/zhes gsungs pa'i pyidakhyab lte/rnam grangs du mar bka' bstsal pas thor bur gsungs tshuladang/des dngor lodang 4 bar bganyis la dri bdangos su bltananas tha ma shugs la bstan pa'i phyigalegs bshad snying po lagashugs laganas pa'idonade nyid dus kyirim pa'i sgonas lha'or logasumadang sbyar ba'i/zhesagasungs pa'i migyang kha ciganare/dngor lodang bosananadagongs 'grel las bshad pa'i gshor lodang 4 yin pas khyab/de bzhin du bar bdang tha ma la'ang khyab zer na/ston pas dus dang por wā rā ṇa sīr lnga sde la sham thabs zlulasar bgo ba la bslab bar bya'o//zhes pa'i mdo chos can/dgongs 'grel las bshad pa'idangos bstan gyi pa'or lodang 4yin par thal/dngor lodang 4yin pa'i )gder thal/dusadang sar gsungs ba'i mdosan pa'i phyigakhyab ste/dus dang por gsungs ba'i mdode dngor yodang po'i mtshan nyidayin pa'i phyir lte/legs bshad snying 4 las/dusadang khor gsungs tshad kyi gsung rab thams cad la min te/zhes gsungs pa'i phyiga'adod na/dri zhus kyi gakhor lo dang 4 yin par thal/'dod ba'i phyir/khyab ste/dri ba zhus pa ltar dogs pa 109
phar phyin skabasadang po/med pa'i dngor lo dang po der mi lasdog pa'i pyir te/ legs bshad snying po las/ de'i phyir dus dang 4ra bden pa bzhi la brtsams nas rang gi mtshan nyidage'od pa sogs su gsungs pa'i dngor lo dang 4 drang don du ston pa yin gyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ de drang don du 'grel ba'i dogs pa med pa'i gyis legs bshad snying po las/ bslab bya gsungs pa la 'dir dogs pa gcod mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gzhan yangaka zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud 6lta bu'i chos zhig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi smranags kyi tshal du gnas par spha /zhes pa'i mdo chos can/ dgongs 'grelanas bshad pa'idangos bstan gyi gshor lodang 4 yin par thal/ gshor lo dang 4yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas tshul bstan ma thag gsungs pa'i mdo yin pa'i pyid 'dod na/ grub don gyi mdo tshanadang po'idangos bag gyi de yin par thal/ ladod pa'i sgyid gdodan/ drangadon gyi mdor thal/ 'dod pa'i pyid khyab ste/ grubadon gyi mdo tshan dang po las/ chos kyi gshor lo bskor ba de yang bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ngesadon gyi mdo yin pa'i phyir te/ khyad chos lnga ldan gyi stong nyidadangos su ston pa'i mdo yin pa'i mig gzhan yang] dus dang shog lung las/ dge slong dag khur yod do/ /khur khur ba 4 yod do/ /phung 4 lnga ni khur ro/ /khur khur ba 4 ni gang zag go/zhes pa'i mdo chos can/ dgongs 'grel tshig zin gyi gsar lo dang ṭo yin par thal/ dngor lo dang 4 yin pa'i pyir/ der thal/rang sde bstan par zhugs zinadang gzhan lde kha cig bstan pa la gzhug pa'i ched du gsungs pa'i gshor lo dang po yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ gzhug pa la ldem poradagongs pa ni/ rang lde dang gzhan sde kha cig rjes su bzung ba'i ched du gang zag gi bdag yod par gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mig 'dod na/ dri zhus kyi lta'or lo dang po yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i 110
chos 'khor/gyig 'dod mi nus te/ dgag bya rang 'dzin rtogs pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa la ma brtsams pa'i phyig khyab lte/ der ma brtsams pa la dogs pa med pa'i phyir te/ legs bshad snying po las/rang gi mtshan nyid yod pa sogs su gsungs pa'i 'khor lo dang 4 drangadon du ston pa yin gyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyidbyar me/sbyi ༵ pa'i] /ātstsha sbya snaji zloshā mi ༷ ༵༵ ba/ lha/ pa/ ghnā snro pa~X dzño spra shālha (sta yin pa'i phyig rtags dus dang pos grub/ 'dod na/ drang don gyi mdo yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ sgra ji bzhin pa'i mdo yin pa'i phyig der thal/ gang zag gi bdag med dngos su ston pa'i mdo yin pa'i phyir te/ legs bshad snying po las/ dang por lā rā ṇa sīr gang zag gi bdag med gsungs shing/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gzhan yang mi rtag se gas bcu drug dngos su ston pa'i lta'or lo dang po chos can/ der thal/ de'i sgyig rtags grub lte/ thal 'gyur ba'i skabs kyi rnam bshad las/ mi rtag sogs ston pa'i gtor lo dang po/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gzhan yang] phyi don yod par ston pa'i dngor lo dang 4 chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyigrtags grub nye/ rnam 'grel las/ des de nyid don btang snyoms can/ /glang chen gzigs stangs nyid mdzadanas//'jig rten thugasani 'ba' zhig gis//phyi rol spyod la 'jug par mdzad//ces gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod na/ dri zhus kyi lugar lo yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i pyir/ 'dod na/gzugs nas (1)byang phyogs bar gang rung rang ladzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par ston pa'i mdo yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i pyig 'dod mi nus te/ phyi don yod par ston pa'i mdo yin pa'i pyid khyab nye/ dranganges ji ltar 'byed kyi skabs su dang por phyi don ston pa'i 1 par zengs gnyisab/byang phyogs rtso bdun bad 111
phar phyin skabs dang po/gnar lo dang po drang don dang / de rjes rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa ston pa'i gshor lo dang po drang don du bshad pa'i pyid dang po grub ste/ legs bshad snying 4 las/ dngor lo dang po las phyi rol gyi dbang du byas pa'i gzung 'odzin gnyis gsungs pa drang don pu nas/ pyi rol 'gog pa'i rigs pa rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigaganyis pa grub ste/legs bshad snying 4 las/ chos rnams la ngo 'odang] nas/ de gnyis la ma pye bar rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par gsungs pa yang drang don no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gzhan yang / yum bar ba las/ gang yangadag pa'i skyon med pa la zhugs pa de dag ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i mthu med do/ /zhes pa'i mdo chos can/ dgongs 'grel nas bshad pa'i dngos bstan gyi dngor lo bar ba yin par thal/ lusar lo bar ba yin pa'i phyir te/yum gyi mdo tshig yin pa'i phyis 'dod na/ brjod bya ngo bo nyid med pa sogs lnga po gang rung la brtsams par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyig khyab ste/ grubadon gyi mdo tshan bar ba las/ chos rnams kyingo bo nyid ma mchis pa nyid las brtsams nas/ skye ba ma mchis pa dang] 'gag pa ma mchis pa dngakagzod ma nas zhi ba dang / rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa nyid la brtsams nas/zhes gsungs pa'i phyis gdod na/ drang don gyi mdoyin par thal/ gdod pa'i phyig gdod mi nus te/ mthar zug theg pa gsum du grub par ston pa'i mdo yin pa'i pyid gzhan yangaka lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ /zhes pas bshad bya'i yum bar ba las/ gzugasani mi rtag ba nyid du yid la spras//she/sbyi kṣiṃ ṅgi (spri (shā ༷hā zloshārnyi/ //sna/ ((lha( ṭā pa(shā/na (( /pa// 〉pyi hārsha khyab lte/ grub don gyi mdo tshan gnyis pa las/ chos kyi gshor lo bskor ba de yang bla na mchis pa/ nas/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa lags/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/112

phar phyinaskabs dang po/pa'i sgyig rtsabar 'dod na/ gzhan dbang yongs grub bden grub tu ston par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ sa sde lnga sdom gnyis dang pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad dang rnam bshad rigs pa gang du mdo de bden grub ston par drangs pa med pa'i phyir dang / thogs 'grel gyis bden med bstan tshul 'chad par 'gyur ba'i pyig rnam bshad las kyang / chos thams cad bden pas stong zhing dri ma slo bur ba yin pa dang / mthar zug theg pa gcig tu bstan par theg pa chen po rgyud bla mas legs par sgrub pas de dag gi don gcig yin min bsam par bya ba kho na yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyidyang kha cig na re/dri zhus kyi gshor 'ordzo dang po yin na brjod bya bden bzhi la brtsams pas khyab zer na/ rgyal 4 la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal 4 chen po/ gzugs la skye ba yang yerdzod/'dzig pa yang yod/ de'i skye ba dang 'jig pa yang shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang/ 'du shes dngaka 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa'i skye ba yang yod/ 'dzig pa yangagengad/ de'i skye ba dang 'dzig pa yang shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i mdo chos can/ bden bzhi la brtsams par thal/dri zhus kyi gsor lo dang po yin ba'i phyir te/ dri zhus kyi mdo las/ phung sho rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyang bka' bstsal/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi na'or lo dang po yin pa'i phyig der thal/ de'i dngos bltan gyi de yod pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod na/ dri zhus kyi mdo las/ phung 4 rnams kyi ji ltab de bzhin du skye mched rnams dang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang/ zas rnams kyi bar yang bka' bstsal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mar bden pa rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyang bka' bstsal/ zhes phung 4 dang skye mched dang rten 'byel dang zas bzhi dang bden pa bzhi la 〈sna serdzor dri ba zhus pa ma yin par thal/ dri zhus kyi sa'or 'odzi dang sa la bden bzhi la brtsams pas khyab pa'i nyid 'dod mi nus te/ de lngar ma zad khams bco brgyadadang byang phyogs kyi bar 114

phar phyinaskabasadang po/dogs pa de 'dra mi rigs pa'i sgyig yang kha cig /phyogs snga smra ba po zogs med dang chos skyong gi dngos slob sogs su 'dod pa mi 'thad par thal/ dogs pa rje btsun gyis rgyan rtsom pa'i dus nas yod pas dogs pa khong slong yin pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ skye 'o blo gros dman pa dag /nas/ gsal bar mdzad pa ma yin nam/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa ma rgyal ba las rgyal bsalang de bstan pa la dgos pa ci yod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyigrang lugs ni/ mdo'i rgyan rtsom pa'i mchod brjod bkod pas de rtsom na gzhi phung khams skye mched dang / gnyen po lam gyi phyogs dang / rnam pa bye brag gam khyad par gyi don yin pas gzhi gnyen rnam pa gsum gang rung re re kho na'am gsum ka ston/ gsum ga ston na bzlos zhes brtsad spru la/ lan du gsum ka rtsom yang zlos skyon med ces lan mdzad pa'i phyig yang kha cig /mchod brjod las 'phyos par bsam nas mchod brjod skya rtsod lan du byed pa ni don cung zad kyang ma rtogs pa'i gtam yin bar thal/ bstan bcos kyi bshad tshul gzhi gnyen rnam gsum re re tsam bshad na bzlos skyon dang / dgos med kyi rtsod pa gnyis spangs te bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mkhyen gsum spyi'i rnam bzhag lung rigs kyis grub par bshad pa'i pyigadesan chen po kha cig 4/ mkhyen gsum la bstod pas rtsom par dam bcas la rtsod padang] gzhanadag zo 4 ba/ mkhyen gsum skye med kyi rnam can la rtsome paradam bca' la rtsod gsungs pa gnyis kyang mi 'thad de/ mchod brjod la mi rtsod pa'i phyir dang / skye med tsam la mi rtsod par gzhi gnyen rnam gsum rnams la rtsod pa'i pyig rnam bshad las/ rgal lan 'di dag nas/ don legs par ma rtogs pa'i rnam 'gyur du gsal te/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig yang kha cig na re/ dogs pa skye ba'i gzhi mchod brjod zer b.lasgo mi 'thad par thal/ 'de'i dogs pa dang rtsod pa mchod brjod la ma yin par khyod kyis khas blangs pa'i mig de la lan dngos dang shes byed dang] lung don 144

phar phyin skabasadang po/nyid yang sngon gyi kha cig na re/ byang sems kyi rgyud la gzhi shes lam shes ngo bo tha dad du skye/sangs 'phags kyi rgyud la mkhyen gsum ngo 4 tha dad du skye ste/ gzhi shes kyis gzhi kho na dang /lam shes kyis lam gsum dang / rnam mkhyen gyis rnam pa kho na shes pa'i phyir zer na/ 'o na/slob dpon gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mig gi shes pas kyang shes bya thams cad mkhyen gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ de'i mig shes kyis chos thams cad mi mkhyen ba'i phyir te/ rnam mkhyen yin na chos thams cad mkhyen pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / bden gnyis las/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis kyang / /shes bya'i dkyil zhakhor kun khyab can/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ de'i mkhyen pa thams cad mnyam rjes ngo ṭo gcig pa shes bya kun mkhyen pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen gsum ngo ṭo tha dad pa de'i mig gzhan yang / de gnyis ka la/ sangs 'phags kyi gzhi shes dang byang sems kyi gzhi shes gnyis re re nas chos can/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes yin par thal/ nyan thos kyi de'i 9ga gdod na/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyisadang bral ba yin par thal/ zeg dman gyi labasan pa'i gyis khyab ste/ thabs shes khyad par can stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba dang snying rje chen 4 phan tshun gcig gis gcig ma zin na khyad par can ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ theg dman gyi lam yin na thabs mi mkhas pas 'bras yum la ring bas khyab pa gang zhig /de yin na thabs shes khyad par can dang bral bas thabs shes nyi mee ba'i lam gyis khyab pa'i gyig dang 4 grub lte/ rtsabag de ni mtshan maradamigs sgo nas/ /thabs masan pas ring ba dngaka /zhes dang / jo sa lha gcig gis kyang] thabasadang bral ba'i shes rab dngaka /shes rab bral ba'i thabs dag kyang / /gang pyir 'ching ba zhes gsungs pa/ /de bas gnyis ka spangs mi bya/ /zhes dang/ dri ma med par grags ba'i mdo las/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab ni 'ching 146

yangadag mtha'/byed pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyig mdo las/ byang chen yum la spyod pa thabs mkhas pasatsanangs su bzung ba yang ji srid dudage ba'i rtsab dedag bla na med spru yangadag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par ma gyur pa de srid yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byedado/ /nam dge ba'i rtsab de dag bla med rdzogs byang du yongs su smin par gyur pa de na yang dag pa'i mtha' dam ba mngon du byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang] rnam bshad las kyang]de 'dra'i gdul byade nyid smin grol gnyis kyi nang nas smin lam la bkod zin na yangadag mtha' mngon du bya bar shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid 'dod na/ de sems can smin tshul brgyad kyi ma mtha' la byed par thal/ gzhan kun la ma yin pa'i phyis rtsabar 'dod mi rigs bar thal 'di dang 'do bya'o snyam pa'i kun slong gi rtog pa rgyud ldan gyi gang zagasan pa'i mig khyab lte/de 'dra'i rtog ba yod kyi bar du zhing de snyed la skude snyed dang] sku re re'i dngor sems can grangs med la tshigs bcad re bstananas 'phags pa'i go 'phang la lasad mi nus pas khyab pa'i sgyigader thal/de ltar thub pa la ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang zag med las kyi kun 'byung phra mo yang spangs nas mnyam bzhag las slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis snyoms par 'jug dgos ba gang zhig /rtog pa yod pa'i dbang gis 'bad med lhun grub dang mnyam rjes ngo 4 gcig tu mi rung bar byed pa'i phyigadang po grub ste/ bden gnyis rang 'grel las/rtog pa dang ni nyon mongs dang] /bag chags ma lus gtan bcad can/ /zhes dang] rnam bshad las/ de 'dra dus gcig tu lan gcig byed pa yang 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba la rag las shing] ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang] zag pa med pa'i las kyang spangs nas/ zhes pa nas/ snyoms par 'jug pa la ltos pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gnyis pa grub ste/rtog pa gnas 'gyur gyi sgo nas de'i bag chags kun spong ba'i phyid bden gnyis las/ de tshe mtshan ma mi 'byung phyig /gnas pa brtan phyir mi bzhengs 161
phar phyin skabs dang po/so/ /zhes dngaka (1)de'i rang 'grel las/ bcom ldan 'das 'di yis rtog pa'i sa bon mtha' dag bag chags dang bcas te rtsab nas bton pa nyid kyis phyir tshad ma mi 'byung na bzhengs pa lta ga la yod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyig des na/ rnam bshad las/ ji srid kun slong gi rtog pa yod pa de srid du mi nus pas de 'dra dus gcig la byed pa yang] zhes gsungs pa'i phyislnga pa yang dag mtha' ngos 'dzin la/ rong ṭīka pa na re/ de bzhin nyid 'dir bstan mngon du mi byed rgyu'i yang dag mtha' dang / de la slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pa de bzhin nyid (2)mngon du byas tshad yin zeg nanagyi4pa la las chos nyid dri bral gyis 'gog pa 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' yin zer na/ 'o na/ ston pa mchog gi sprul skus byang sems la sangs rgyas ma thob bar du sangs rgyas mngon du ma byed cig ces gdams par thal/ des de dag la rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas bar du yang dag mtha' mngon du ma byed ces gdams pa gang zhig /'dir bstan yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa'i gang zag yin na sangs rgyas yin dgos pa'i sgyid mi ma grub lte/ dang po ltar nade bzhin nyid la slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag na mnyam rjes ngo 'o gcig pa'i sangs rgyas pas khyab/ gnyis pa ltar na chos nyid dri bral gyi 'bosnag bden thob na sangs rgyas pas khyab pa'i pyir te/ rnam bshad las/ sangs rgyas ma thob bar du sangs rgyas mngon du mi bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don du 'gyur bas labad par (3)dka' zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ shes sgrib spangs pa'i spangs pa dang pyi rol don 'odzin gyi rtog pa spangs pa'i spangs pa gnyis/ 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' min zer na/ 'o na/— — wawa wawa— —1 bar zengs gnyis ba/rang 'grepalas/2 bar zengasaganyis gamangon sum pu3 bar zengs gnyisab/dka'o//zhes/162
yang dag mtha'/'dir bstan yang dag mtha' yin na/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas pa'i snga rol tu mngon du byed nus la mi byed pa dang byas rjes su byed pa'i khyad par gsum ldan gyi yang dag mtha' yin pas khyab par thal/ de gnyis ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yod pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ 'dir bstan gdams don gtso bor gyur pa'i yang dag mtha' gcig yod pa'i phyig der thal/ rgyun mtha' bas sangs rgyas pa dang dus mnyam du mngon du byed rgyu'i yangadag mtha' gcigatsamad pa'i nyid der thal/ mdo las/ dedag gi yangadag pa'i mtha' (1)mngon sum duni mi bya'o/ /zhes pa'i shugs la gtso sar (2)bstan pa'i 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' yod pa'i pyid 'bum gyi gnod 'joms las/ sems can smin par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag par bya ba la sesnags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyodad pa mtha' dag rdzogs par byas nas mngon du byas pa la nyes pa med kyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ de bzhin du rnam bshad las kyang] de 'dra'i gdul bya smin spol gnyis kyi nang nas smin lam la bkod zin na yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du bya bar shugs la bltan pa yinanyes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyidgzhanayang] pyi roladon 'dzin gyi rtog pa spangs pa'i spangs pa chos can/ khyod 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' yin par thal/ khyod khyad chos gsum ldan gyi 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' yin pa'i mig der thal/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas pa'i snga rol tu mngon du byed (3)nus la mi byed/ de gsum byas rjes su byed rgyu'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i myang 'das yin pa'i pyid dang lha ghnā pa༈/tudersha kau spra/ /shārnyi phru 〈sna ༵ dzorsha dzño ༵༵ /shā pyalapa (rnyi pa/da /rdzu 1 par zengs gnyis pa/mngon du mi bya'o//2 par nangs gnyis spru/gdams/3 par zengs gnyis pa/ nus mi byed 163

yangadag mtha'/gi bsam ngor lam gyi bzod pa mthar phyinasan dgesnas (1)pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las skyabs kyi skabs su bshad pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ dgra bcom rtogs pa sngon song gi byang sems la bde gshegs bka' 'das kyi rtsasgyung byung bar thal/ ston pa mtshog gis de la deng phyin chad sogs gdams pa gang zhig /des theg chen lam du yang bar bar du yang dag mtha' mngon du byed pa'i pyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ rnam bshad las/ nyan rang zhi ba'i/ nas/ zeg pa chen por zhugs pa rnams bar bar du yang dag mtha' mngon du byed kyang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ sngon goms pa'i dbang gis yang dang yang du snyoms par 'jug pas lam zeg chen rigs nges las bskal chen sum cu sesnagasakyis ring zhes pa'i don yin ba'i phyig der thal/de ltar zhugs kyang yun ring du snyoms par 'jug 'dod med pas yang dag mtha' mngon du ma byas pa'i pyid mdo sde rgyan las/ mya ngan 'das la mngon dga'i phyis /rtogs pa bul ba yin par 'dod/ /ces dang / rnam bshad las/ goms pa'i dbang tsam du zad kyi/ 'de la dus yun ring du mnyam par bzhag pa'i 'phen pa ni cungazad kyang med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyidyang kha cig na re/ sangs rgyas kyi sar nyan rang gi spangs rtogs kyi rigs ma rdzogs par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sar nyan rang gi spangs rtogs med pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ nyan 'os kyi rtogs rigs la de'i rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis ma khyab pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ sa der rtogs rigs gsum ka mthar sgyin pa'i lam yod pa'i phyir te/ nyan rang gi rtogs rigs mthar zug gi lam 〈snad pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ rong1 sa brgyad pa ba la sangs rgyas kyis ma bskul na theg dman lam du stung zer ba dang] la las bar ma dor mya ngan las 'da' zer na/'o na/ sa brgyad par mya ngan las 'da' bar bshad pa de dgongs pa can gyi myang 'das ma yin ———1 bar zengs gnyis pa/pararnam bshad/ 175
phar phyin skabs dang po/par thal/ de myang 'das mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyig rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ brtag pa mtha' bzung gis ma bskul na bskal pa la 〈snags pa'i bar du gzhan don gyi rgyun re zhig chad pa la 'dir bar ma dor mya ngan las 'da'/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rtsemo nas dge rtsagad pa'i myang 'das/ bzod pa nas ngan 'gro'i myang 'das/ lhag bcas lhag med kyi dang /dgongs pa can sgya myang 'das dang brgyad bshad pa'i phyir/ nyi snang las/ bstan pa (1)'di la mya ngan las 'das pa rnam pa mang 'or rnam par bzhag ste/ 'di ltar rtsemo/ zhes pa nas/ de nyid kyi phyir sems can thams cad kyi don gyi bya ba rgyun bcad pa'i de nyid 'di'i yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yin no/ /zhes bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ khyab ste/ gser phreng las kyang /de'i phyir sa brgyad pa la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ma bskul na mya ngan las 'da' bar gsungs pa yang de la dgongs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ tshos gsum ma rdzogs par de mngon du mi byed pa'i lam shes dang thabs mkhas bcu'i sbrengar ba 〈snad pa'i phyig 'grel pa las/ de kho na nyid mngon du mi byed pa'i rten can 'bras bu sems can ma dī sdidī rdzu spra/ pa (lha rnyi/ zhesna kau ga] sna ༵༵ sras shā mp+raṃ galha kṣiṃ zlohā hūm̐ sde ༵/nga~X/ (dri pa lha/pa dka' gsungs yang blun 4 phal cher gyis zugag bu gcig gnyis kyis tshar khul rang gzhan du ma snang yang dka' ba'i gnad phra mo ma lus par tshig nyung ngus bshad yod pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mdzad pa brgya'i zhal lhag ger gsal zhing mdo dang 'phags seng gi legs bshad kyi 'dab ma rgyas pas slo ldan yongs kyi zugs kyi lcags kyu kho nar (2)gyurato/ /———— —1 bar zengs gnyis ba/'di laphugangs su/2 bar zengasaganyis ba/nayir ro//176
smras pa/shes bya pha mtha' med pa'i khengs ldan lha'i malha da 〈snan/ /ma pham sku bzhi'i zhal nas 'dren mkhas 'ogs med zhabs/ /'phags seng lha chen blo zos ral klung gaṅgā'i chus/ /deng dus sems kyi bskal mang dri kun bkrus pas tshim/ /rgya mtsho'i gling gi rin chen mchog 'dra'i chos/ /dka' gnad dri mas ma sgags rang rang gi /blos byas nyes bshad 'ching bu bkra ba der/ /'bad 'tshal bsgrims kyang re ba ji ltar skongs/ /tshul de ma bzod lhag bsam dar chen btsugs/ /thos bsam grur zhugs gzhung mang rgya mtsho brgal/ /mtshungs bral 'jig rten rin chen kun rnyed des/ /legs bshad nor bus grags pa rā dza bzhin/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa mdo dang bzlos pa'i skyon spangs nas dgos pa yod par bshad pa la/ rtsabagrnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam/ /zhes drenags byung / 'phros sbyongar mtha' dbyad pa gsum/dang 4 la/ nyan thos zhi ba/ nas/ de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i mchod brjod kyis shugs la rgyan rtsom par dam bcas nas dgos sogs bzhi 'chad par 'di byung] gnyis pa ni/ bstan bcos rgyan 'di brtsams pa la chos can/ dgos sogs bzhi yod de/ mdo gsum sgya brjod bya rnam mkhyen du bgrod pa'i lam mngon rtogs brgyad du byas pa brjod bya dang] bstan bcos dang dgos pa la brten nas mdo'i don byang sems kyis mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur ba gnas skabs kyi nying dgos dang / mthar shug gi nying dgos de las thob 'gyur gyi rnam mkhyen dngakabstan bcos 'di la brten nas mdo gsum gyi don bde blag tu rtogs pa dgos pa dang / nying 177
phar phyin skabs dang po/dgos snga ma las phyi ma de byung du 'brel ba shugs la bstan pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ rkang pa dang 4 gnyis kyis brjod bya'i ngo 'o dang / de nas gcig gis khyad par dang / de nas gsum gyis nying dgos dang / tha ma gnyis kyis dgos pa bstan nas 'brel ba don gyis 'phangs 〈sna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidgsum pa mtha' dbyad pa la/ dgos sogs bzhi'i mtha' dbyad pa dang / bka' bstan bcos kyi mtha' dbyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dgag gzhag spang gsum/ dang po la paṇḍi ta kha cig na re/ bu/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dbang rnon de rgyan gyi dgos 'brel gyi ngag la brten nas rgyan la dgos sogs yod par tshad mas nges nas 'jug zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ des phal cher yod las che snyam pa'i the tshom gyi sgo nas 'jug pa'i phyir te/ 'grel ba las/ don la ze tshom bskyed pa nyid kyis 'jug pa'i yan lag ces gsungs pa'i phyig khyab par thal/ de ltar slob dpon chos ma〈snag dang] rje rgyal tshab gsum gyis bshad pa'i pyid 'thad ldan las/ gang phyir 'dzig rten don gnyer ni/ /ze tshom las kyang 'jug pyir ro/ /zhes dang / gser phreng las/don mi 'gyur gyi dogs pa bzhi bsal nas de bzhi phal cher yod las che snyam pa'i/ zhes dang]rnam bshad las/ dgos sogs bzhi la don 'gyur gyi ze tshom bskyed pa'i 'jug pa'i yan lag ston pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang paṇḍi ta 'ga' zhig na re/ bram ze bum dgos 'brel gyi dgos pa gzhung mdzes pa'o 3da spyir lus mdzes pa rung yang] dgos pa lus mdzes tsam mayin par thal/de lasadon rtogs pa sogasadagos pawend pa'i phyir te/ gser zeng las 'on kyang mdzes pa dgos par 'chad pa skabs su ma babs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cigan re/ rgyan gyi nyingadagosasanan/ rgyan gyi nying dgos mthar thugasan pas khyab zeran/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas rgyan la thos sogs kyi zhugs pa la brten nas 'ob pa'i sa bcu'i 178
dgos sogs chos bzhi/ye shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig der thal/ de rgyan gyi gnas skabs kyi dgos pa'i dgos pa yin pa'i pyid yang kha cig na re/ngo bo nyid skude rgyan gyi nying dgos yin zer na/ de chos can/khyod rgyan gyi rjes su grub par thal/ 'dod pa'i mig 'dod mi nus te/ rgyan ma grub pa'i snga rol nas yod pa'i mig yang kha cig na re/ rgyan gyi 'brel ba yin na/ dgos sogs bzhi'i nang gi 'brel ba yin pas khyab zer na/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas thob bya'i 'gog lam rgyan dang 'brel ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ de gnyis rgyan la rag las pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de byung 'brel yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i sgyid 'dod mi nus te/ 'du ma byas yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ rgyan gyi 'brel ba yin na/ bdag gcig 'brel yin pas khyab zer na/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas yum don rtogs pa'i thos bsam las byung ba'i rnam mkhyen de thos bsam de dang 'brel ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/ de byung 'brel yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas thob pa'i rnam mkhyen (1)de nying dgos mthar zug zer na/ de 'dra'i rnam mkhyen kho kho rang yin par thal/ de 'dra'i rnam mkhyen yin pa yod pa'i pyid gdod na/ de chos can/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya khyod thob pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod des thob pa'i rnam mkhyen yin pa'i pyig 'dodan/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya chos can/ sangs 'phags yin par thal/ rnam mkhyen thob ba'i gang zag yin pa'i sgyig des tshig gi gnyi tshul gzhan yang shes 36/ /rang lugs la/ bstan bcos kyidagos sogs bzhi dgos 'grelangag gi brjod byadang/de la brtenanas rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas rgyan ladagos sogasaspend par rtogs padagos 1 parazengs gnyisapa/dergyan gyi/179
phar phyinaskabasadang po/padang]de la brtenanas rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas rgyan la (1yos bsam kyis zhugs pa nyingadagosadangaka 'grel ba de byung 'brel ba sogs yin no/ /bstan bcos 'di'i dgos sogs bzhiyodade/ mdo'idon mngon rtogs brgyadadang/don bdun cu brjod byadangaka ṇḍa la brtenanas de dag bde blag tu rtogs pa dgos pa dang/ de la brten nas sa bcu thob pa dgos pa'i gnas skabs kyidagos pa dang]de la brten nas rnam mkhyen thob pa dgos pa'i mthar zug gidagos pa yin/ bstan bcos dang] dgos pa'i shes rab gsum dang] nying dgos (2)shes rab gsum gyi phyi ma snga ma la 'brel bde bstan bcos kyi 'brel ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyan gyi dgos 〈snags la bzhir nges te/rtogs ldan 'jug pa'i yan lag don med pa sogs bzhi bsal nas 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos sogs bzhi yod/ de las mang mi dgos nyung na mi 'du ba'i pyidrtsod slong la kho na re/ rgyan gyi skabs gnyis pa brtsams pa la dgos pa med par thal/rgyan gyi brjod bya la dang po'i brjod byas khyab pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na/ dgos 'brel dang mchod brjod zur du bshad pa la dgos pa med par thal/ rgyan gyi brjod bya la de'i brjod byas /lhashā ṭwāṃ snrosna spyu thapa khardzu/na kṣiṃ rshan ༵ / kṣiṃ hūm̐ ༵ (spra ghnā //shā mp+raṃ ñtsha ṭwāṃ sdirshapa ༷nā sno pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ rgyan la ma brten par de rtogs pa yod pa'i pyig yang kho na re/ dgos sogs la bzhir ma nges par thal/ bstod 'grel las/ rdzod byed phun tshogs dang lngar bshad/ ka shis/ brjod bya/ da〈snas pa/ 'brel ba gsum du bstan pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/rjod byed legs tsam gyis rtogs ldan 'jug pa'i gtso ṭo min la/ gsum du bstan pa ni dgos ——wawa— ————wawa———1 bar zengasabantas pa/zos rtsogs/khu bar zengs gnyis ba/rnalamakhyen/180
bka' bstan bcos/pa gnyis gcig tu bsdus tsam yin gyi/ nying dgos chad pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtogs sla/gnyis pa bka' bstan bcos la'ang dgag gzhag srang gsum las/ dang po la/ thun mong gi ngo 'o dang / 'gal mi 'gal dang / so 〈snar dpyad pa gsum/ dang 4 la kha cig na re/ bka' bstan bcos kyi ngo 'o ming tshig yi ge'i rang bzhin gyi skye mched bcu'i gzugs yin zer/ la las/ gzugs min gzugs phung zer/ dang ṭo la bka' bstan bcos chos can/ skye mched bcu'i gzugs ma yin par thal/ de'i nang gi sgra yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ phyi'i skye mched kyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga la gzhi mthun mi srid pa'i sgyig der thal/ nang gi dbang shes lnga'i yul 'gal ba'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ dbang bo'i sems ni nges phyir dngaka /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa'ang mi 'thad par thal/ khyad par de ltar min na gzugs dang gzugs phung yin khyab mnyam yin pa'i phyid bye spru ba dag ni/ bka' bstan bcos ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs pa'i bdag nyid ming spyi ldan min rdzas grub tu 'dod de/ rang 'grel las/ bye brag tu smra ba rnams na re/ chos thams cad rtog ge'i skyod yul ma yin pas ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi rang bzhin ming gi tshogs la sogs pa ni rdzas su yod pa kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri zhes chos de dang de la ming byas pa ni ming dang / de 'dra'i ming du ma ni ming gi tshogs yin pa'i phyig dang 4 grub lte/ rang 'grel las/ ming byed pa ni ming ste/dper na/ gzugs sgra zhes bya ba/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ rang 'grel las/de la ming gi tshogs ni dper na gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dag ces (1)bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ bye mdo gnyis das bka' bstan bcos gnyis ming tshig yi ge gsum ka tshogs ——— ——wawa —— —1 bar zengasaganyis pa/bya ba ste/ 181

sems bskyed/pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ de'i dngos bstan gyi dbye ba ston pag de yang sogs gsungs pa'i phyig der thal/ de yang gi de bsnyegs sa yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ bstan bya'i gtso bo la byed pa'i pyig de la kho na re/ de yang sa gser zhes sogs kyis sems bskyed nyer gnyis dngos su ma bstan par thal/ des dpe sa sogs nyer gnyis dang grogs 'dun sogs nyer gnyis dngos su bstan nas sems bskyed nyer gnyis shugs la bstan pa'i phyig rnam bshad las/nyer gnyis dpes mtshon par byas pa'i don dang / dpe don chos mthun gyi sgo nas don gyis bstan pas/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis dngos su bstan nas/ grogs 'dun sogs (1)dang dpe chos mthun spyor tshuladon gyis bltan pa de'i don yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ sems bskyed kyi ngo po 'ogs med sku mched kyis sems byung du bzhed par thal/dbyig gnyen gyis sems par bshad/thogs med kyis smon lam du bzhed pa'i pyig dang po der thal/ mdo sde rgyan las/ spro ba che dang rtsom pa che/ /don che ba dang 'byung ba che/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems pa ste/ /zhes dang] de'i 'grel pa las/ sku(na tan gsum mam gnyis la dmigs pa dang ldan pa'i sems pa ni sems bskyed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ spro ba che ba serdzogs kyis yon tan gsum mam gnyis la dmigs nas don gnyer gyi sems par byed pa sems bskyed kyi bskyed ba'idon du bshad pa'i phyir te/ rgyan gyi 'grel bshad las/ sems 'byung ba zhes bya ba la 'byung ba dang skyed pa'i don tha dad pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid rtags gnyis pader thal/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam gyi mchogani sems bskyed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ sems bskyed pa ni smon lam gyi sgo nas byed bar bshad pa yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ brtan pa rnams kyi smon lam ni/ /sems pa wa wa——— — —— ——1 b.razengs gnyisapa/dbadang /211
phar phyin skabs dang po/'dun dang bcas pa lte/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ gser phreng las/ grogs 'dun pa dang bcas pa'i sems pa la smon lam du gsungs pas sku mchedadagongs pa gcig tu 'dug gam snyam/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig sems pa zhes pa byed tshig yin no/ /sems bskyed de 'phags seng gis rnam rig dang] thogs med sku mched kyis sems byung du bzhed par thal/ shalta pas de ltar bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ des 'phags seng gi dgongs par bsam nas yid dang /thogs med sku mched kyi dgongs par bsam nas 'dun pa gnyis char la 'dod pa'i phyir te/dag ldan las/ sems bskyed pa'i dngos 4 zhes bya ba la sems ni yid dang 'dod pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed sems la 'dod pa mi 'thad par thal/ de buddha shris bkag pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ gser phreng las/ 'phags pa dang slob dpon gyi lugs sun phyungs nas don gnyer gyi 'dun pa nyid sems su 'dod pas sems sems byung rdzas gcig tu ladod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidsems bskyed kyingo 'o semasadang] skyed tshul smon lamadang] sems par byed pa'i sgonas skyed pa gnyis yin par thal/ de ltar rje btsun byams pa yang bzhed/ 'ogs med sku mched kyang bzhed/ 'phags pa yang bzhed/ slob dpon kyang bzhed pa'i pyig dang 4 grub ste/ rgyan las/ spro ba che/ nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems pa lte/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab ste/ sems pa zhes pa skyed pa'idon dang/ sems 'byung bdang skye ba don gcig pas sems su bshad pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ rkang pa tha mas sems su bshad par 'dug snyam du dgongs te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa bsgrubs zin/ gsum pa grub ste/'dun pas don du gnyer ba skyed pa'i don dang] ngo 'o yid kyi rnam shes la 'dod pa'i phyig dang po grub ste/nyi snang las/ sems bskyed pa'i gnas skabs ni don du gnyer ba gtso 'o yin pas na 212
sems bskyed/de dang lhan cig spyodad pa'i sems bskyed pa la/ nas/ smon lam dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba 'thad par 'gyug zhes dang / skyed pa zhes smos pas ni ma bskyed pa bskyed pa shes par byed pa yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gnyis pa grub lte/nyi snang las/ sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba la sems ni rnam par shes pa ste rnam par rig pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa gang yin zhe na/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa lte/ dkar po'i chos thams cad la dmigs pa ni de la srid pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ skyed pa'i don de ltar gang zhig /ngo bo sems la yang bzhed pa'i phyid dang sa grub lte/ rgyan snang las/ don du gnyer ba gtso sor gyur pa ni sems bskyed pa'i gnas skabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig zur gnyis pa grub ste/ rgyan snang las/ de ltar na yang byang chub semasadapa' rnams la smon lam dang ldan pa'i (1)sems bskyed de skye'o zhes bya ba ni 'thad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha (2khig gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob par 'dod pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i theg pa chen po'i sems khyad par can de/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na/ zeg chen tshogs lam pa'i sems bskyed chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyid 'dod na/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob par 'dod pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan yin par thal/ de dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i phyis 'dod na/ mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i sgyid gdod na/ de dang rten mtshungs par thal/ 'dod pa'i nyid 'dod na/ de rgyud ldan yin na khyod rgyud ldan yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyig 'dod na/ byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ der thal/de'i phyig— ———— —1 b.razengs gnyisab/sems de skye'o/2 b.razengs gnyis ba/ciganare/213
phar phyin skabs dang po/yang kha cig na re/ rang rgyu gzhan don don gnyer las byung zhing / rang gi grogs byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi zeg chen gtso 'o yid kyi rnam rig de de'i mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na/ sangs 'phags rgyud la byang chub don gnyer gyi blo yod par thal/ de la zeg chen sems bskyed yod pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ rongartsogs/ 'jug sdom 'ob la ma nyams pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed de 'jug sems kyi mtshan nyid/ 'jug sdom rgyud la mi ldan pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi sems bskyed de smon sems kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na/ 'jug sdom btang na/ 'jug sems kyang btang bas khyab par thal/ khyod kyis 'jug sdom ma nyams zhes smos pa'i phyid 'dod na/ byang sems kyi ②ltang byung ba'i gang zag yin na khyod kyi rgyud la 'jug sems med pas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyis 'dod na/ bdag bstod tsam gyi rtsaltung byung ba'i byang sems chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ de yod pa'i pyir/bslab btus las/ ci rtsor ma chud pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i dbang pu nas/yod par rig par bya lte/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las/ rnyed pa dang bkur nyi'i rgyu las rtsaba'i lhung ba byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir la/ zhes so/ /'dod na/ kun dkris chen po'i sgo nas bdag bstod kyi byang sems kyi rtsasgyung tsam byung ba'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi phyin drug nyams len gyis dngos su zin pa'i sems bskyed chos can/ 'jug sems ma yin par thal/ bdag bstod kyi galhung tsam byung ba'i rgyud kyi de yin pa'i pyir/ 'dod na/ 'jug sdom thob phyin chad kyi phyin drug gi bya bas dngos su zin pa'i sems bskyed ma yin par thal/ khyod 'jug sems ma yin pa'i phyig khyab ste/ nyams len ma 〈snas par de ltar bya ba sbyar na sangs rgyas kyi bar la khyab pa'i phyir te/ lam rim las/ 〈snam pa bzung ba nas sems de 'jug pa'i sems su shes par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ sdom pa bzung ba dngaka phyin drug gi bya bas dngos su 214
sems bskyed/zin pa gnyis dgos pa'i phyir te/ sgom rim dang 4 las/ gang phan chad sdom pa bzung ste tshogs rnams la zhugs pa de ni zhugs pa'i sems 〈sna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab lte/ des sdom pa dang tshogs gnyis la dngos su zhugs pa bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / byang 'phags kyi rgyud la smon sems med par thal/ byang 'phags yin na 'jug sdom thob la tshul khrims rnam par dag pas khyab pa'i phyir/ rtsabar/ rtag tu tshangs par spyod nyid dang / /zhes rtso/ /'dod na/ bden 'dzin mngon gyur du rgyud la ldan pa'i byang sems mthong lam rjes 4ba pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed chos can/ pyin drug gi bya bas dngos su zin par thal/ 'jug sems yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sgom rim las/ gang phan chad sdom pa bzung ste tshogs rnams la zhugs pa de ni/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ zin bya zin byed gnyis gang yang mngon gyur du med pa'i dus kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyis khyab ste/ de 'dra skye 'phags su'i rgyud la yod kyang smon sems la byed dgos pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ 'jug sdom blangs nas rgyud pa la slob pa'i tshe smon sems med par gdod pa ni de dag gi don min te/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyidde'i don min tshul sngar ltar yin te/ rnam bshad las/ des na/ smon sems ni tshogs lam nas bzung lte sa thob nas kyang khas blangs pa la nyes pa med par mngon te/ nas/ des dngos su ma zin pa'i sems bskyed skabs du mar 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la kha cig na re/ slob pa'i sems bskyed yin na phyin drug gi nyams len gyis dngos su zin pas khyab ༷| ṭwāṃ / spya ༷ / ༷ rnghi spri /| ṭwāṃ rto lta smaṃ ṭwāṃ/ dzā] ༷pa spya ༷ 3༷༷ ṭwāṃ las/ 'jug sems kyi bya ba de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ smon sems ni/ sgom rim dang 4 las/215
phar phyinaskabs dang po/khro khro dhī spri llī khro sdi jo llī | khye kho na ( pyā khro]snre ྅/ khro pyā pa'i mdo las rgyas par bshad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed rang nyid rang gi zin byed la su zhig smra /gzhan yang / bslab btus las/ des kyang 'khor ba'i bde ba mtha' yas pa skyed pa'i phyir byang chub (2)kyi spyodad pa dang bral ba la yang brnyas par mi bya ste/ 'phags pa byams pa'i rnam par thar pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na/ rdo rje rin 4 che/ nas/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa'i rdo rje rin po che ni nan tan dang bral yang nyan zos dang rang sangs rgyas (3)kyi gser gyi rgyan thams cad zil gyis gnon cing byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang mi 'dor la/ 'khor ba'i dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par zlog go /zhes pa'i don ma grub par thal/ sems bskyed kyang sgrub pa nyams len gyis dngos su ma zin pa'i smon sems des kyang nyan rang zil gyis gnon pa'i zhi mtha' 'gog pa'i phar sgyin dang / gsor ba'i dbul ba lugar mtha' 'gog pa gnyis kyi khyad par bshad pa ma yin pa'i phyig der thal/ phyin drug gi bya bas dngos su ma zin pa'i sems bskyed med pa'i pyir/ 'di'i byams pa'i rnam thar gyi gang don la/ 4 mkhas tshag cichi/stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis ma rin par bshad pa 1 parazengasaganyis gabadang 2 bar zengs gnyis ba/kyi sems/3 parathengasaganyis pa/kyi yonatan ñtsha/4 b.razengs gnyisab/kha'ug stong nyid/216
sems bskyedyin zer na/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa tsam dang stong nyid rtogs pa kho nas srid zhi'i mtha' khegs pa de tsam la 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs rdzogs par tshang par thal/ sems bskyed dang spyod pa nyams len gyi spyod par stong nyid rtogs pa gcig pu de bzhag pa'i pyig 'dod na/ rnam rdzogs bhyor ba brgya dang don gsum bshad pa dang / spyod 'jug las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang 'dad ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sa brgyad pa la sangs rgyas kyis bskul bar bshad pa rnams mi 'thad par thal/ shes sgrib slong ba dang rnam mkhyen thob pa la (1)de dag dgos pa ma yin pa'i phyig khyab cing] 'dod mi nus te/ de dgos nges yin pa'i pyid de skad du sgom rim las/ (2)lanar 'jig rten gyi bzo la sogs pa'i gnas kyi bar dag la yang byang chub sems dpas bslab par bya ba yin na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan la se gas pa lta ci smos/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab lte/ de thams cad sems can dang mthun pa'i rgyud pa de'i don sgrub tshul yin pa'i phyir te/ lung de'i 'phyor/ sgom rim las/ de ltar ma yin na sems can gyi don gyi rnam pa thams cad ji ltar bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na smon sems mngon gyur dang 'jug sems med par sbyin sogs spyad kyang 'de'i spyod pas zin go mi chod par thal/ 'di la sems can gzhan don du chas pa'am/ :snad pa tsho gas zhugs pa gang rung cigadagos pa'i phyis der thal/ g.yo byas nas sems bskyed pa dang] ras kyi kha tshar phul nas sems tsam bskyed pa sogs dang / gsal rgyal gyis dge ba kun la yi rangs byas nas sangs rgyas byang sems la phul nas sems bskyed pa thams cad bslab btusadang] sgom rim gnyis spur smon sems su bshad pa'i phyir te/ bslab btus las/ de la smon pa'i sems wawa wawa —— — — —1 parazengasaganyis pa/dedargas/2 b.razengasaganyisab/lan ltam
phar phyinaskabs dang po/ni sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /zhes smon pa las skyes pa yin te/ zhes pa nas/ de ltar na smon pa byang chub kyi sems su rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di la smon sems bskyed la smon sems ma yin pa yang yod pas shes par gyis/ thams cad smon sems skyes tshar ba yang mi bya ste/ ma sbyangs par smon chog du ma yod pa'i phyisyang kha cig na re/ sa thob nas 'jug sems dang sa ma thob pa la smon sems 'jog par thal/ de ltar sangs rgyas ye shes bzhed pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ sangs rgyas ye shes dang zhi ba lha'i sngon du yang de 'dra byung ba'i phyis rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ so skye la'ang 'jug sdom yod pa'i phyig der thal/ rtsasgyung byung ba'i byang sems yod pa'i phyig khyab ste/ byang 'phags la tshul 'chal mi srid pa'i phyir te/ kun 'byung rjes bzod khyad par can gyi nyi snang las/rtag tu tshangs par rgyud pa dang gzhan mi dga' (1)ba'i gnod pa mi bskyed pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid ma khyab mtshams kyi rtags grub ste/ rnyed bkur la chags nas bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi mnyung byung ba yod pa'i phyid bslab btus las/ rang gi yon tan brjod pa dang] /rnyed pa dang ni bkur nyi dang] /tshigs bcad rgyu yi gzhan smod dang] /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid masages yang smon 'jug gnyis tsho gas blangs ma blangs dang/ phyir mi ldog thob ma zob dang] rgyu la dam bca' ba dang] 'bras bu la dam bca' ba sogs yod de/ de dag mi 'thad pa'i phyig kho na re/ cho gas blangs pa'i sems bskyed 'jug sems dang ma blangs pa'i sems bskyed smon sems yin par thal/ tshos bshes kyis de ltar 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ dang po (2)gang gnyis pa yang yin pa'i phyid dang ṭo grub nye/ tshig gsal las/ 'jug pa zhes bya ba ni dge — — — — —— —1 par thengs gnyis pa/bar 'gyuraba'i gnad ban bskyed ba/2 bar zengs gnyis ba/gang zhig/218
sems bskyed/ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byas te yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba'i sems bskyed pa nas brtsams te bar gad med pa'i/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub lte/ tshig gsal las/ smon pa zhes bya ba ni smon pa tsam ste tshogs bsags pa sems de bskyed pa'i cho gas blang bar yang ma byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ smon 'jug gi sems gnyis gcig char du bskyed pa'i cho ga 'dzid pa'i phyir te/ mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung las/de la tshigs bcad dang 4 rkyang pas byed na rkang pa dang 4 gsum gyis 'jug pa sems bskyed len pa'i sbyongar ba ston cing] sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung] /zhes pa gcig pus smon sems cho gas 'dzin pa dang 'jug sems cho gas 'dzin pa gnyis ka ston par brda' 'phrod dgos/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab lte/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /sogs )pa /kyapa /bya( lha( rmos ṭwāṃ /snashā /spya ༵༵ bzhuspri (dī snaXshā shuzloshā pa/ spyad / 'a/spyaX chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de cig car tsho gas ma byas na spyodad 'jug gi cho ga gnyis mi snyed pa'i phyig der thal/ de bzhin du thub dgongs las kyang / phan 〈snan thos pas yang dag par dga' ba skyes pa/ sangs rgyas tshos dang tshogs mchog la/ /nas/pa(pa ñdzanā ༷ rshaghnā panā ( /lha paX rnyi pa gārdzu stang spritsho sa/ ༵༵/ ñdza nā (zlo rnyi dīd /spri po rab kyis rab mdor bsdus bas byang chub kyi sems sdom pa'i rang bzhin skyed par byed — — — —1 bar zengs gnyisab/la)ga rten 7na sdug bsngal/ 219
phar phyin skabs dang po/do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyig shin tu gsal/ rgyas par der stos/ yang kha cig na re/ 'jug sdom dang 'jug sems cig char kho na skye ba rnam bshad kyi don zer/ la las de rnam bshad kyi don du byasanas lam rimadang mi mthun zed gzhan dag gis rgyu mtshan med par 'jug sems tshogs lam 'bring kho nar yod zer/ 'phags yul du'ang bzhed tshul mang bas dgag gzhag mang bar mi bya bar rje yab sras dang zhi ba lha'i lugs nyung gsal cig bkod na/'o na/ 'jug sems la blo sbyangs pa'am sgom tshul med par thal/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyis sems can gyi don du rgyal sras kyi bslab bya gsungs pa rnams la blo sbyangs pa dang yid smon byas nas sgom pa de ma yin pa'i pyig der thal/ de la blo goms nas myong ba skyes te rgyal sras kyi 'jug sdom len pa med pa'i phyig khyab lte/ de 'dra ba'i myong ba skyes nas 'jug sems skyes kyang tsho gas ma bzung na 'jug sdom du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ lam rim chung ngu las/des na bslab bya rnams shes par byas te yid yul du byas nasade dag snying thag pa nas slob 'dod sbyangs te sdom pa blangs (1)na shin tu brtan pas/ zhes dngan mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las/ 'jug sems bsgoms stobs kyis rgyud la skyes kyang cho gas ma bzung na sdom par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la kho na re/ de gnyis dus gcig tu skyes pas khyab par thal/ 'jug sems rgyud ldan yin na 'jug sdom rgyud ldan yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gnyis 'gal yang cig char kho nar skye ba'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/'jug sdom dang 'jug sems gnyis 'gal yang de bskyed pa ni sdom pa bzung ba'i dbang kho na las shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de gnyis dus mnyam skye ba'i don min kyang cho ga gcig pa'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ gyod 'jug dar ṭīka las/ 'jug sdom ——1 bar zengs gnyis ba/ba shinatu bag pasa'adisna thabs bzang po'o//220
sems bskyed/dang 'jug pa sems bskyed 'gal yang 'jug pa sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga las logs su 'jug sdom len dgos par 'dod pa ni ma go ba chen po yin no/ /zhes dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las/ thun mong gi sdom pa (1)de gang zhe na/ byang sems kyi sdom pa len pa yin te/ 'jug pa sems bskyed cho gas 'dzin pa dang don gcig ces gsungs pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ 'jug sdom thob la 'jug sems ma skyes pa yang yod/ 'jug sems ldan kyang 'jug sdom mi ldan pa yang yod/ 'jug sems skyes kyang 'jug sdom ma thob pa ni bshad zin pa'i pyig dang po grub ste/ lam ma zhugs nas 'jug sdom blangs nas de rjes byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa mang ba'i phyig der thal/ byang chub kyi sems la myong ba ma skyes kyang 'jug sdom thob nas slar byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa zhi ba lha'i lugs yin pa'i phyir te/lam rim che ba las/ sbyor sngar bshad pa lta bu'i myong ba ma skyes kyang theg pa chen po'i bslab par bya ba rnams shes shing zeg chen la mos pa brtan na sngon la sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa bzung nas de nas byang chub kyi sems bhyong ba'ang yod de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/myong ba ma skyes zhes pas lam ma zhugs su bstan/ lhag mas smon 'jug gi sems bzung nas sems bsgom pa rjes su byed par bshad pa'i phyir te/ lam rim las/ spyod 'jug tu ldon la sdom pa dang sems bzung nas de'i bslab bya phyin drug gi bsam gtan gyi skabs su byang chub kyi sems sbyongang lugs rgyas par gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'di la'ang snod rung du phan yon sems ba dang] yan lag bdun pas skyabs 'gro sogs dgos par lam rim dang mkhas grub rin po ches gsungs so/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ byang sems la byang sems kyi rtsaltang byung la byang sems kyi 'jug sems ma btang ba lta bu yin pa'i phyig gzhan du bshad zin — —— — ——— — —1 bar zengasaganyisapa/de dag221
phar phyin skabs dang po/to/ /sa mtshams la kha cig na re/ 'jug sems ma mtha' tshogs lam 'bring nas yin par thal/gser phreng las/ tshogs lam chung ngur smon sems dang 'bring nas 'jug sems bzhag ste/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi mdo'i dngos bstan dang sbyar tsam rigs pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ 'bring nas 'jug sems bzhag ste/mdo las/ bsam ldan gyi skabs su phyin drug la slob par bshad cing/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigrtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ tshogs lam chung ngu na yang 'jug sdom dang 'jug sems gnyis yod pa'i phyis khyab ste/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa bzung nas phyin drug gi bya bas dngos su zin pa'i sems bskyed la 'jug sems kyis khyab pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ sems bskyed kyi sbyo'i mtshan nyid zhugs par khyad par med pa la spyodad pa nyams su len pa'i bya bas dngos su zin pa dang ma zin pa gnyis su dbye ba ni lung snga ma'i (1don no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ma khyab mtshams kyi rtags grub ste/ bhyod 'jug dar ṭīka las/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed tsam zhig ni tshogs lam khyad par can ma thob pa nas kyang yod la zhes gsungs pa'i pyidyang kha cigan re/theg chen sems bskyed kyi sems rten yinan gtso sems yin pas khyab zeran/dkon mchog sgron me las/ rgyaladang rgyal ba'i chos ladad gyur cing/ /nas/ blo ldan rnams kyis byang chub sems skye 'o/ /zhesadang/ mdo sde rgyan las/ des rtsab snying rjer lasad/ /cesadang/)hwa ris/ skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can/ /zhes gsungs pa'idon ma grub par thal/theg chen sems bskyed kyi sems rten la rgyal ba la dmigs pa'i dad pa yang med/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can yang med pa'i migader thal/ de'i sems rten du gyur pa'i sems byung med pa'i phyirate/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i pyid byas pa la khon re/ rnam 'grel las/ rnam shes min pas rnam shes kyi/ /nyer —— — — —1 b.razengasaganyis pa/donasan la/222
sems bskyed/len min pa'i phyirayang 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ rnam shes kyi nyer len la rnam shes kyi rigs shig mi dgos pa'i sgyig der thal/ zeg chen sems bskyed kyi nyer len la rnam shes shig mi dgos pa'i phyig der thal/ de'i sems rten la rnam shes shig mi dgos pa'i phyir na shin tu ma khyab ste/ de'i sems rten yin nade'i nyer len ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ sems de sems rten de'i ngo bor bskyed pa de de'i sems rten gyi don yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rgyu mtshan sems rten des gzugs sogs gzhal ba sogs mi rung na de gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar du mi rung bar mngon pa las yang yang bshad pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ 'de ni mkhar gzhong la rgya shug rten pa dang / nas/ brten par bshad pa de rnam pa gang dang gang gi ngo bor skyes pa la brten pa'i tha snyad byas pa lte tshul 'deni lam gyi sems rten thams cad la la rig par bya ste/chos mngon pa ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i brda'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisgnyis pa rang lugs la/ rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i gzhan don don gnyer gyi 'dun pa las byung zhing rang gi grogs byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen lam gyi gzhung shing du bstan pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can de/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ khyad par can gyi don yang lam gyi gzhung shing dang sa 'on dang sdoms sogs su bshad pa'i khyad par la bya zhing / thabs khyad par can du byas na slob lam la rung yang sems bskyed gnyis kyi gzhi mthun 'dod na mi rung bas sngar bshad pa kun la legs/de la ngo bo'i sgo nas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis yod/ nyams len gyi bya ba la ltos mi dgos pa'i rigs can gyi sems bskyed de smon sems kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na skye 'phags kyi rgyud kyi gnyis dang] sa mtshams tshogs lam chung ngu nas sa bdun pa'i bar du yod/ phyin drug gi bya bas dngos su zin dgos pa'i sems bskyed de 'jugasems kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na rang 223
phar phyinaskabs dang po/yin gyi sems bskyed nyer gnyis yod/ smon 'jug gi don 'thad de/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gyo ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par lga /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig phyin drug gi des zin pa'i tshad yod de/phyin drug gi bya ba dang sems bskyed kyi shugs dngos su cig char 'jug pa de de yin pa'i phyigder thal/de dus sems bskyedadangos su medanayangade'i shugs dngos sude la 'jug na de des dngos su zin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ sems bskyed kyis kun nas bslang pa tsam du ma zad gtong ba'i sems pa spel ba'i rnam pa shar ba'i dus nyid na rnam mkhyen don gnyer gyi dran 'dun du re ba dngos su yod pa ni rgyud pa nyams len gyi bya bas dngos su zin pa'i don yin la/ de lta bu med pa'i dus na dngos su ma zin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ sems pa yan chad kyis sbyin pa dang] spel ba'i rnam pa shar ba ni sbyin pa'i gshor gsum spel ba ste/ res kyi rnam pa shar bdang/ lhag mas rnam mkhyen thob 'dod kyi dran padangos su yod par bshad pas zin bya zin byed de dngos su 'jug par bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de ltar zin bya zin byed gnyis gang rung zhig dngos su med kyang dngos su zin pa yod de/ bya ba gnyis dngos su tshogs pas dngos su zin pa'i pyir te/ lam rim chung ngu las/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab shugs drag na sbyin pa gtong ba dang phyag dang bskor ba sogs byed pa'i tshe de dag la dmigs pa'i blo lda rnams stong nyid rtogs pa min yang de'i shugs dang ldan par 'jug pa mi 'gal la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigde bzhin du sems bskyed kyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag zin pa yang yod de/lam rim chung ngu las/ thun mgo lta bu la byang chub kyi sems shugs drag po sngon du btang na stong nyid kyi tingasnga 'odzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ byang chub kyi sems de dngos su med kyang de'i rtsis zin ba mi 'gal te/ thabs shes ya ma bral ba'i tshul yang de ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs 224
sems bskyed/pa'i phyig de la sa mtshams kyi sgo nas mos pa spre1da pa'i sems bskyed/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed/ rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed bzhi yod de/ tshogs bhyor gyi sems bskyed dang 4/ gnyis pa ni ma dag sa bdun gyi dang] gsum ba ni dag sa'i dang / bzhi pa ni sangs rgyas skya sa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i nyid mdo sde rgyan las/sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa 'o/ /zhes 〈sna/ /yang de la sems bskyed tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na rgyal sho lta bu/ rdzi 'o lta bu/ mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed gsum yod la/ dang 4 ni/thog mar rang gis sangs rgyas thob nas sems can gyi don byed 'dod pa'i sems bskyed de de dzño smra rsharsha spri||/ nyi/ ༵ ༵ dī (pa ༵ nd+ra sdirsha /sna sna /ba( rdornyi kṣiṃ (shā/ga(dri sdu spra rnyisna dpalha bstan bcos du ma las bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod nas bdag 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'i sems bskyed de/ spyan ras gzigs kyis sems bskyed par bshad pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ sems can 'di dag byang chub kyi snying por sngar (1)chas 'dug par sga 'dug pa'i phyis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / byang ༷༵༵ snro nāX shā ༷ji rnyi dīlha/ /dī pa( sdu shāsta sdursha dī /pa/ pa( pa/ tram̐ /sna ༵༵ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' ni thog mar sems can thams cad byang chub par 'tshal gyi bdag nyid ni ma lags dren/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bdag dang — —wawa —wawa —1 parazengs gnyisab/chos/225

phar phyin skabs dang po/pa'i phyir te/ dar ṭīka las/ don brgyad po ji lta ba rig pa dang / ji snyed pa rig pa dang / so so rang gis rig pa dang / chags pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba dang / thogs pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba dang / dman pa'i sgrib pa las krol ba dang / sbyi gnyis bgrangs pas rig pa dang / rnam par grol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid ngos 'dzin bshad zin to/ /yang sgras brjod kyis (1)dbye na du ma yod de/ don dam pa slob pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog lam rnams dang / kun rdzob pa 'phags pa slob pa rnams dang / tha snyad pa sngar bshad pa'i sku sogs yod pa'i phyir/ sgra don ni de gsum chos can/ dkon mchog ces brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rin ṭo che ltar 'byung ba dkon pa dang /dri ma ci rigs pa med pa dang / 'dod don stsol ba'i mthu dang ldan pa dang / 'gro ba la dge bas 'dzig rten gyi rgyan du gyur pa dang / mchog nyid dang / stod smad sogs kyis mi 'gyur ba'i khyad par drug dang mtshungs pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyis /mthu ldan phyir dang 'dzig rten gyi/ /rgyan 'gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyig /'gyur ba med phyir dkon mtshog nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ skyabs gsum spyi'i rnam bzhag ni/ skyabs gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan 'gad de/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs can gsum dang / sangs rgyas sogs la bsnyen bkur sogs kyi bya ba byed 'dod pa'i gang zag gsum dang drug gi dbang du byas nas skyabs gsum du bzhag pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i khyad par bshad pa la/spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyig /nas/ tshogs kyang de yi mthar zug phyis /zhes byung / lam gyi bgrod pa mthar zug par ma rdzogs kyang rdzogs pa ltar snang ba'i cha nas bzhag pa'i skyabs —— ——1 par zengasaganyis tha/dbye nadonadag290
skyabs gsum/de/ kun rdzob pa'i skyabs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ sa mtshams slob pa 'phags pa'i skabs kho nar yod pa'i pyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir/ /med phyir la)gas dang bcas pa'i pyir/ /chos rnam gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'dis slob pa'i rgyud kyi lung dang spangs rtogs kyi chos dang zeg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa slob pa rnams gnas skabs dang kun rdzob pa'i skyabs yin tshul so sor bshad kyang sbyor bshad na mtshan nyid de thob pa'i phyir/ snang tshul dang gnas tshod kyi sgo nas kun rdzob pa'i skyabs dang mthar shug tu ma phyin pa'i skyabs yin pas gnas skabs kyi skyabs dang / 'jigs bcas kyi skyabs zhes bya ba don gcig /lam mam dgos don mthar zug par rdzogs par snang zhing /don la'ang dgos don mthar zug par rdzogs pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i skyabs de/ don dam pa'i skyabs kyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams mi slob pa'i skabs kho nar yod de/ rgyud bla ma las/dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas lhag gcig yin/ /chub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab lte/ theg pa gsum gyi slob pa'i tshogs sam dge 'dun yang lam der sleb pa dang / mthar thug gi skyabs yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ /zhes dang / thogs 'grel las/ zeg pa gsum po'i tshogs kyang chos kyi sku rnam par dag pa mthar thug pa thob pas mthar pyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigdes na mthar thug gi skyabs dang / don dam pa'i skyabs dang / bden pa'i skyabs dang / mi slu ba'i skyabs rnams don gcig lte/thogs 'grel las/ skyob pa med cing skyabs med pa'i 'dzig rten phyi ma'i mtha'i mu dang mnyam pa mi zad pas skyabs/ rtag pa'i skyabs/ g.yung drung gi skyabs/don dam pa'i skyabs ni gcig nyid de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ mu zhes pa mtha'i ming 291
phar phyin skabs dang po/dang 'jig rten gyi gshor ba'i phyi mtha' dang mnyam pa'i mi zad pas skyabs te/ sems can re re'i gnas skabs la mtha' yod pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs mi zad pa dang / rtag pa'i skad dod bden par bshad pa mang bas bden pa'i skyabs dang / mi slu ba'i skyabs dang /g.yung drung gi skye 'chi spangs pa'i skyabs su bshad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rgyu 'bras kyi skyabs ni/ gcig la mtshon na theg pa gsum gyi tshogs rang rang gi ston pa sogs kyi dkon mchog rgyu skyabs dang / de'i thob 'gyur gyi dkon mtshog gsum 'bras skyabs yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ rigs can gzhan gnyis kyi yang rgyu'i skyabs gsum dang / 'bras bu'i skyabs gnyis kyang go bar 'gyur mod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyig slob pa'i rgyud kyi lung rnams chos can/ gtan gyi skyabs min te/don mngon par rtogs pa mthar zug pa'i phyir du thos bsam gyis brten par bya la/ don mngon par rtogs pa mthar zug pa'i tshe de la brten mi dgos pa gzings lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ spang pyig zhes dang / thogs 'grel las/ de yang lam mngon par rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i phyir na gzings lta bu'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /zhes dang / rgyan las/ don shes pa yi chos rnams kun/ /gzings dang 'dra ba nyid du bstan/ /zhes so/ /slob pa'i rgyud kyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab chos can/ gtan gyi skyabs min te/ gzigs ngor dri ma mtha' dag med kyang don la gnyen ngos dri ma spangs pa masan pas/ der snang des stong tshogs pa'i rdzun pa slu ba'i 〈snas can yin pa'i pyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ bslu ba'i lngardzos can phyis /zhes sem/ /dman pa'i lhag pa/ phru( swāsaphyi (rnyi ca//(stanā ṭwāṃ stabardzu sna ṭā/ trā/sa/sna chi sdi rnyi sprinā hā/ rnyis snapa shā ༈ thogs 'grel las/ sdug bsngal med pa tsam gyis rab tu phye la/ med pa ni skyabs sam skyabs 292

spyan lnga/mig dbang gzugs can pa la brten pa'i dpag tshad brgya nas stong gsum tshun chad kyi gzugs phra rags thams cad mngon du mthong ba'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i rig pa de/ sha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lha'i mig dbang gzugs can pa la dngos su brten cing sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs mtshungs ldan gyi rig pa de/ lha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid zer na/sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi sha'i spyan chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyis der thal/ de'i rgyud la spyan lnga ga yod pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ sbyor spyan lnga ga sangs rgyas la mnga' bar rdo rje gcod pa las bshad cing 'bum gyi gnod lasdoms las kyang sangs rgyas la spyan lnga yod par bshad/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ stong gsum phan chad 'i mthong bar thal/ dpag tshad brgya nas stong gsum tshun chad smos pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyis 'dod mi nus te/ chos thams cad rtogs pa'i phyir te/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyidgzhan yang / byang sems rgyud kyi sha'i spyan yin na dpag tshad brgya nas stong gsum tshun chad kyi gzugs thams cad mthong bas khyab par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i pyig 'dod na/ dpag tshad brgya tsam mthong ba'i byang sems las dang po ba'i rnam par smin pa'i sha'i mig chos can/ der thal/de'i pyir/ der thal/ sha'i mig la dpag tshad brgya mthong ba yang yod/ de bzhin du dpag tshad nyis brgya mthong ba dang / sum brgya mthong ba nas/ stong mthong ba dang / 'dzam gling mthong ba dang /gling gnyis mthong ba nas/ stong gsum mthong ba'i byang sems kyi sha'i mig gi bar mthodaman bcu gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ gser zeng las/ byang chen gyi sha'i mig gis dpag tshad brgya mthong ba yod do/ /nas/ stong gsum pa'i la)ga rten gyi khams mthong ba yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gzhan yang / mtshan nyid gnyis ka la sha'i spyan dang / lha'i spyan gnyis re re nas chos can/297
phar phyin skabs dang po/dbang shes yin par thal/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dbang 4 gzugs can pa la dngos su brten pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de dbang shes kyi go don yin pa'i phyir te/tshad ma mdo las/ thun mong ma yin rgyu yi phyig /de yi tha snyad dbang pos byas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ yid shes yin pa'i pyig der thal/ lam yin pa'i phyig der thal/sangs 'phags rgyud kyi de ye shes chos sku yin pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje gcod pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sha'i spyan mnga' snyam mam/ rab 'phyor gyis gserdzol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de de ltar lags te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sha'i spyan mnga'o/ /nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la lngardzos kyi spyan mnga'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rtsabar/ mngon shes so so yang dag rig/chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid de la kho na re/ sangs 'phags rgyud kyi sha'i mig dbang gzugs can yod par thal/ de la sha'i spyan yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs 'phags kyi rgyud la sha khrag gi dbang po gzugs canagengad par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i rgyud la sha rus kyi beem 4 med pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na beem pa~X ( snropa ༵༷ rdu( shā (dī pasnarnyi chi luspriX ༵ ༵( ( ṭā sna ༵ dzño lhar ryaṃ shārnyi spridī/ ba'i phyid gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo drangs zin to/ /de la kho na re/ dpag tshad brgya tshun chad kyi gzugs phra rags thams cad mthong ba'i byang sems sa dang po ba'i sha'i spyan chos can/ gzugs thag ring ba dang / sgrib (1)pa phra ba rnams mi mthong bar thal/ sems can gyi sha'i spyan yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ byas pa la khyab par thal/sha'i mig gis de dag mi mthong la/ lha'i mig gis mthong ba'i khyad par rigs pa'i phyir te/ mdo — wawa—— wawawawa — — — — 1 bar zengs gnyis ba/bdang /sgribab 298
spyan lnga/las/ gang phyir shas mig gis gzugs/ /thag ring gnas dang sgrib padang //phra ba thams cad mi mthong la/ /de'i phyir lha yis mthong bar 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ gzugs kho na mthong bar bshad pas/ sha'i mig shes tsam dang lha'i mig shes kyis yul mthong tshul tsam yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ don gyi nus la stos med na/ /bar chad la sogs yod na yang / /dbang (1)shes blo ni skye bar 'gyud /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab lte/ mig shes phal pa rang nyid skye ba rang gi gzung don la mi stos na ri bo sogs kyis bar du chod pa'i gzugs thams cad mthong bar thal ba'i skyon bshad pa'i phyir/ rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ mig dbang phal pa ma yin pa'i mig dbang khyad par can gyi bdag rkyen tsam la brten pa'i dpag tshad brgya tshun chad kyi gzugs thams cad mthong ba'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyisader thal/ phyin drugadang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'i sha'i mig grub pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'grel chen las/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom pa'i mthus stong gsum gyi gzugs che chung thams cad mthong ba'i rnam smin gyi mig grub pa ni sha'i spyan dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ 'dis 'dod pa'i mir gyur pa'i byang 'phags kyi sha'i mig rab kyis rtogs tshad bstan pa yin pas tshangs pa'i la)ga rten man chad mthong ba'i phyig de la kho na re/ mdzod las/ mig gis gong ma'i gzugs ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ 'dod pa'i mi'i mig gis 'dod lha yan chad kyi gzugs mi mthong ba ma yin pa'i ②ga der thal/ 'dod pa'i mir gyur pa'i byang 'phags kyi sha'i mig gis de ltar ma yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ de gzugs sogs yul lnga la 'jug pa'i phyir te/ yum gsum gnod 'joms las/ gzugs thams cad la 'jug pa ni sha'i mig gordzo/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mdo sde pad dkar las kyang / lhun ṭo ri rab thams cad dang / /khor wawa— — — —————1 par zengs tshos ba/skyes/ 299
phar phyin skabs dang po/yug kyang ni des mthong ste/ /ri gzhan gang dag grags pa dang / /rgya mtsho dag kyang mthong bar 'gyud /'og tu mnar med dmyal bar thug /steng du srid pa'i rtser gnas pa/ /bstan pa des ni kun mthong ste/ /sha yi mig ni de 'dra 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidkyi sha'ilha sna ṭwāṃ sprad/ shā sbya spru ṭhaṃ pa )pag zin panywa /pa~X ༵ lhasnaryaṃ ༷zlo rmyo sdushārnyi sha'i spyan dma' bas kyang dpag tshad brgya mthong bar bshad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de ma mtha' byas nas bshad pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'odzin shes rab mtshungs ldan du ladod pa dgag sla/ yang kho na re/ lha'i mig yin na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi sems can gyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mthong bas khyab par thal/ lha'i spyan la de ltar khyab pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ byang sems kyi lha'i spyan gyis rgyal chen bzhi'i ris nas 'og min gyi bar gyi lha'i mig gi yul shes kyang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris nas 'og min gyi bar gyi lha'i mig gis byang sems kyi lha'i spyan gyi yul mi shes pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ de bzhin du 'og min gyi bar gyi lha'i mig byang sems kyis shes pa dang / lha de dag gis byang sems kyi mig mi shes/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba shes pa'i yul can de/ lha'i spyan kyi mtshan nyid zer/la las rang gnas kyi gling tsam las mi mthong ba'i lha'i spyan yod zer na/ dang yo la kha cig /'o na/ mdo las mnar med nas 'og min ñtsha bar gyi lha'i mig dang yul rtsogs shes pa gcig dang / yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can gyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa gnyis bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ de la sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pas khyab pa dang / gling re tsam las mi shes pa'i lha'i spyan yod pa 300
spyan lnga/de'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ 'de byang chub sems dpa'i lha'i spyan bshad pa'i skabs yin pas ma mtha' dang ya mtha' bzung ba tsam yin pa'i phyir te/ yum gsum gyi gnod lasdoms las/ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa thams (1)cad shes pa nas/ lha'i mig go/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / lha'i spyan la nus pa che chung med par thal/ de thams cad kyis sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ 'dor byang sems kyi spyan gyi rab kyis kyang phyogs bcu'i gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi de shes pa gang zhig /sangs 'phags kyi gtsug tor dang / mdzod spu sogs kyis kyang spyan lnga'i yul gzigs pa 'chad pa'i phyir/ dang 4 grub ste/ 'jug pa'i sa bcu'i yon tan bshad pa dang / mdo las kyang / lha'i mig yongs su dag pa de nyid kyis 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can thams cad 'chi 'pho dang skye ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ phyi rol pa dang nyarna rang dang byang sems kyi mngon shes sogs la mi snang ba'i shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi phyogs na sems can gyi rigs snang ba stong gsum gyi lha mi las mang bar bshad pas 'jig rten gcig gi yang sems can thams cad mthong ba'i lha'i mig sems can la mi srid pa'i phyir te/ gzungs rgyal gyi mdo las/ sems can gang dag snang bar gyur pa dag dang / nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis min pa de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha'i mig la snang bar (2)gyur to/ /yang shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi phyogs na snang bar ma gyur pa'i sems can gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa la snang bar gyur pa de dag ni ches mang gi /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi lha dang mi rnams ni de lta ma yin no/ /zhes — —— ——— —1 bar zengs gnyisab/ cad/ces ba/2 b.razengs gnyis 4 /4raro// 301
phar phyin skabs dang po/gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dis du ma la zhib cha shes so/ /gnyis pa grub lte/ thub dgongs su dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa'i mdo drangs pa las/ 'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor gyis kyang gzigs so/ /de bzhin du mdzod spus kyang gzigs so/ /de bzhin du mtshan re res kyang / de bzhin du dus cig car du phyogs bcu rnams su 'dzig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad du gzigs so/ /zhes pa de ltar na'ang dbang po'i blor sngon gyi rjes su 'brangs pas rnam par bzhag go/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ gzigs sesna yan chad kyi gzigs tshul dang / de ltar sogs kyi yul khyad par med kyang dbang shes su lasdog pa'i rgyu mtshan gsungs pa'i phyir te/ thub dgongs las kyang / dbang po'i blor sngon gyi rjes su 'brangs pas rnam par bzhag go /zhes pas lha'i mig ces pa la 〈snags par brjod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig sangs rgyas kyi sa'i spyan lnga'i 'jog tshul 'di legs so/ /yang kha cig na re/ bdag med phra rags gang rung mngon sum du rtogs pa de shes rab kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ zeg chen mthong lam pa chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyis 'dod mi nus te/ gang zag yin pa'i phyig yang mi shes pa kha cig na re/ sha'i spyan dang lha'i spyan gnyis mig dbang gzugs can yin zer na/ 'o na/ 'bum gyi gnod 'joms las/ gzugs thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes pa ni sha'i spyan no/ /zhes pa'i lung don ma grub par thal/sha'i spyan dang lha'i spyan gang rung yin na shes pa yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi dam bca' 'thad pa'i mig yang kha cig na re/ sha'i spyan yin na rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yin pas khyab pa 'phags pa'i dgongs par medod padang lam dang gzhi mthun lasad cing rnam smin gyi 'bras bu mdzod ltar 'dod pa 'gal 'du chen 4 ste/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi sha'i spyan chos can/ lung ma bstan yin par thal/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ de ni 302
