sbyor lam/pa'i rgyu ni cung zad kyang med par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig gzhan yang / ldan tshul de dag gtan mi rung bar thal/ 'di'i bhyor lam bzhi dang mthong spang gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa mngon gyur bzhi rim bzhin nyams smad byed kyi spong gnyen du skye ra ba'i pyid der thal/ mthong smrang nyon mongs gzung rtog mngon gyur pa nyams smad ma thub bar du zeg chen gyi kyor lam drod thob dka' bas/ mthong spang nyon mongs gzung rtog mngon gyur pa drod la nyon mongs byed dam sgrib byed yin/ de bzhin du mthong spang rnam byang gzung rtog mngon gyur pa 〉mo la dang / mthong spang rdzas 'dzin mngon gyur pa bzod pa la dang / mthong spang btags 'dzin rtog pa mngon gyur pa chos mchog la nyon mongs byed dam sgrib byed yin pasade thob pas rtog pa (1)bzhi pa nyams smad byed kyi gnyen po 'ob pa yin pa'i phyir lte/ rnam bshad las/ desananges 'byed rnam rtog dang ldan pa'idon gong du drangs pa ltar kunanas nyon mongs byed du ldan par gsungs pas spang byar ldan pa yin la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyad par dang po gnyis grub lte/ de 'dra'i rnam rtog bzhi rags rim nas sbyar na mthong spang gzung rtog gnyis kyang drod rtses rim bzhin nyams smad pa'i pyir te/rnam bshad las/ rnam rtog bzhi 4 spang dka' sla'i gnad kyis drod kyi skabs su spang bya la gzung byar bden 'dzin nyams smad pa tsam du gnyen po'i phyogs la gzung byar bden 'dzin nyams pa med pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyig khyab lte/ 'phags pa'i dgo ngas pa yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa dang po dang gnyis pa dag ni go rim bzhin du gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis su 'gyur ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigdang 4 thos bsam dus su yang chos kyi bdag med rgyas par dbyad pa dang / spang byar bden 'dzin rags pa la goms pa che bas spang sla gnyen po 'char dka' ba ltar bden 'dzin —— ——wawa — wawa— ————1 par zengs gnyis ba/bzhi nyamasasmad/325
phar phyin skabs dang po/yang ngos zin dka' bas de las phra ba'i phyir ro/ /des na khyad par phyi ma gnyis kyang grub lte/rgyu mtshan de 'dra dang gzung 'dzin 'char dka' sla'i dbang gis bshad pa ltar grub pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ chos thams cad bden stong du rtogs par khyad par med kyang / goms ba yun ring thung gi dbang dang / yon tan gong du 'phel ba'i gnas skabs de bzhir rnam par rtog pa mngon gyur bzhi rim gyis shas chung du 'gyur bas mngon gyur spang byar tshul des ldan pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ nyi snang las/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa dag kyang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang /drod kyi dus su (1nyon mongs nga rgyal sogs rags pa de ltar spangs pa nyan sar yang bshad pa'i phyir te/ nyan sa las/des shes rab de kun tu bsten cing 〈snams par byas lan mang du byas pa'i rgyus/ zhes pa nas/bar du gcod par (2)byed pa'i/ nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal rags pa gang yin pa de kun tu spyod pa'i sgo nas spong bar 'gyur zhing / zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig /zeg pa gsum gyi skyedar lam bzhi la chung 'bring che gsum yod med kyis 'phags zed la la theg chen sgya lam tshang ba'i chung 'bring che ba'i dbye ba yod med la byed zer na/ de rnams mi 'thad par thal/ nyan thos rang don lhur len pas myur na srid pa gsum tsam yin pas sbyordzor lam drod ltan gcig yang yod/ zeg chen gyi rigs dang dbang po ji tsam che la dzño ba bzhin lam ma zhugs nas kyang rang don dor gzhan don lhur len byed pas tshogs sbyongar gnyis kyi yun la bskal chen grangs med gcig dgos pas gdul bya'i dbang gis drod sogs re re'i yun la'ang bskal chen stong phrag du ma dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de dag thams cad kyi dus su yang don gnyis kyi rgyu tshogs yongs ————— ——1 b.rathengs gnyis pa/nyon mongs dngang rgyal/khu b.razengs gnyis pa/byed/326
sbyor lam/rdzogs su lam la goms par byas pa'i rgyud gcig gi'ang drod chung 'bring dang chen ṭo gsum la'ang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen 4 yod pas de'i sgo nas zeg dman gyi de las khyad bar du 'phags pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gong nas gong du dang goms pa zhes bsngags pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ chung 'bring khyad lngastos su 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan ni zeg pa chen po'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing goms par byed pa ni khyad chos bla na med ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyid khyab ste/ bla na med tshul byang sems kyis stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la myong ba rnyed pas so skye'i dus nas gzhan don du bskal chen bye ba du mar yang dka' ba blo 'das rgyud par 'jug la/ nyan rang so skye dang 'phags pa 'og mas rang don du'ang yun de tsam snying stobs kyis mi phod la bsam pa tsam yang mi nus pa'i phyir/ dang po grub lte/ rgyan dī pa/ba sbyi lha dwo snying /shā ( kṣiṃ shā twā ghnā // mp+raṃ snro ñtsha )zlas/ rsharsha/ ghnā /pa bsna rnghi /smi pas( par rab tu 'jug ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis ba grub ste/ rtsabar/ ched du bya ba 'o ga pa dang / /zhes pa dang / 'grel pa las/ sems can thams cad kyi mchog nyid kyi chen po nyid la sogs pa la mi 'jug pa nyid kyis ched du bya ba log pa dang / zhes dang / sgyod 'jug las/ sems can de dag nyid la gron/ /rang gi don du 'di 'dra'i sems/ /rmi lam du 'ang ma rmis na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la skye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis lhag bsam brtan pas mi gtsang ba'i dong dper byas nas bshad do/ /ngo bo la kha cig na re/ tshogs lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing mthong lam ma skyes gong gi mkhyen pa/ snyadar lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ dgra bcom sngon song gi byang sems sbyongar lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/ mthong lam sngon thob zin pa'i phyir te/ dgra bcom 327
phar phyin skabs dang po/—pa'i lam yin pa'i pyig yang kha cig /theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun rdzogs rjes kyi 'jig rten pa'i don mngon rtogs de/ theg chen lhor lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ dgra bcom sngon song gi zeg chen lhor lam chos can/ 'jig rten gyi don mngon rtogs yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyig rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ 'das lam yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig /sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i theg chen gyi don mngon rtogs de theg chen gyor lam gyi mtshan nyid zer ba dang /rloms pa kha cig na re/ rong:kab/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing bden pa mngon rtogs dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gtso 4ra gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de/theg chen bhyor lam gyi mtshan nyid/theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthunadang so gang zhig/gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang dang por thob pa/ theg chen bhyor lam drod kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa gang zhig /de'i don la gsal snang 'phel ba de/ de'i rtsemo'i mtshan nyid/ gsum pa gang zhig /'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang dang por zob pa de/ de'i bzod pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhi pa gang zhig /de'i don la gsal snang 'phel ba de/ de'i chos mchog gi mtshan nyid zer na/ dang 4 gnyis la/ 'o na/ zeg chen sbyordzor lam pa'i bsam byung gi byams snying rje dang gong ma'i sgyin sogs la thos byung gis smon pa'i sbyin sogs drug chos can/ sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i de yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyig der thal/theg chen gyi spyor lam yin pa'i phyir te/zeg chen spru ra lam pa'i rgyud kyi lam yin pa'i phyis der thal/ tshogs lam du gyur pa'i de dag yod/ de bzhin du sbyor lam la yang yod pa'i phyig dang po grub ste/ kun btus las/tshogs kyi lam gang zhe na/ so so skye bo'i tshul khrims dang / dbang po'i sgo sdom pa dang / zas kyi tshod rig pa dang / nam gyi cha stod smad la mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson pa dang / yang rgyur gyur pa'i dge ba gzhan dag dang /thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab dag 328
sbyor lam/kyang rung ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ de'i rgyud kyi thar lam yin pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ kun btus las/ tshogs kyi lam gang yin pa sbrengar ba'i lam yang de yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / bhyor lam na tshogs lam las brgya 'gyur gyi thos bsam yod pa'i phyir te/ting nge bedzin gyi sgo mang 4 yang bshad pa'i phyig chos mchog chung ngu'i rtsabagating 'dzin de yi byed pa nyid/ /ces dang / gser phreng las/ rnam par rol zhing gos pa med pa'i ting nge 'odzin gyi bar ting nge 'dzin brgya lhag dang bcas pa dang / zhes dang / mdo las kyang / dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'odzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'odzin gang gis ting nge bedzin thams cad kyi spyod yul nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ shes rab gsum 'gal ba'i pyidgzhan yang / byang sems kyi bhyor lam drod sogs (1)bzhi gang rung yin na stong nyid rtogs pa'i lam yin dgos par thal/ drod sogs kyi mtshan nyid 'thad pa'i phyig 'dod na/ de bzhi'i sems bskyed bzhi chos can/ der thal/ de'i nyid 'dod mi nus te/ slob pa'i rgyud kyi thabs kyi cha yin pa'i phyis khyab ste/ dgongs 'grel las/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa nyid pha rol tu phyin pa gang gis 'dzin lags/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas 'dzin to/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis rang ṭīka pa dang /yang kha cig na re/ theg chen rigs nges kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i sbyi1ra lam drod sogs bzhi don dam par rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang can gyi slo yin zer na/ de bzhi tshos can/ chos nyid la gsal snang can gyi blo ma yin par thal/ chos nyid mi gsal bar snang ba'i blo yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ chos nyid kyi don sgyi chos nyid du snang ba'i blo yin pa'i mig der thal/ chos nyid la sgra —— —wawa—— ———— ——— —1 par zengs gnyis ba/bzhi ṭo/329
phar phyin skabs dang po/don rsās rung du 'odzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyig der thal/ chos nyid la rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/rnam 'grel las/ shes gang gang la sgra don 'dzin/ /de ni de la rtog pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang /shes gang zhes pas 'dzin byed bstan te/ gang la zhes pas yul bstan cing lhag mas sgra sbyo don spyi 'dris rung du snang na rtog par 'gyur tshul bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de bzhi chos can/ stong nyid la mngon sum yin par thal/ de la rtog med kyi blo gang zhig /de la rtog med log shes ma yin pa'i mig dang 4 grub ste/ de la gsal snang can gyi blo yin pa'i mig khyab ste/rnam 'grel las/ gnyid log pa 'am sad pa na/ /gsal bar snang ba can slo gang / /de ni rtog med/ces gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ stong nyid kyi don sbyi la stong nyid du snang ba'i blo yin pa'i mig der thal/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir te/ zhi lastos/tshu rol mthong ba thams cad kyi/ /sems ni de la nor ba'i pyir/ /yang dag dngos po cung zad kyang / /mngon sum dag gis grub pa med/ /ces gsungs pa'i pyidbyas pa la kho na re/ de la stong nyid gsal bar snang bar thal/ rgyan snang las/ ye shes kyi snang ba cung zad gsal bas/ zhes dang / ye shes kyi snang ba 'bring tsam du gsal bar gyur pa de'i tshe ni rtsemo'i gnas skabs te/ zhes dang / shin tu gsal bar shes pa'i snang ba skyes pa de'i tshe bzod pa'i gnas skabs/ zhes dang / ye shes kyi snang ba rdzogs par gyur pa de'i tshe zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ grar lam bzhi'i stong nyid la thos bsam dus kyi yul yul can rgyang chad rags par snang ba las gnyis snang chung du song ba'i chos nyid kyi don sgyi la gsal snang chung ngu sogs skye bas de ltar bshad pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/zos pa dang bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyis dmigs pa'i tshe yul gyi sgyi legs par shar yang / yul yul can gnyis gnyis snang shin tu rags pa dang bcas nas 'brel ba med pa lta bur snang la/ sgom byung gi shes rab kyi 330
sbyor lam/(1)tshe ni/ gnyis snang yod kyang gnyis snang rags pa log nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang ldon gyi kha cig na re/ sbyongar lam mnyam bzhag gi blo rnal 'phyor mngon sum yin gyi/ de na rtog pa ci yang med zer/ mnyam bzhag de chos can/ de bzhin nyid mngon sum du rtogs par thal/rnal 'byor mngon sum gang zhig yul de bzhin nyid yin pa'i phyig 'dod na/ (2)mthong spang rtog pa'i sa 'on dang bral bar thal ba dang rtog bcas ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/kun btus las/ shes bya la legs par ma zhugs pa dang / legs par zhugs pa dang / sgrib pa dang bcas pa dang / sgrib pa med pa dang / rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa dang / rnam par rtog pa med pa'i phyir te 'di ni bye brag go/zhes gsungs pa'i khyad par gsum mi 'thad par thal serdzo skye yang shes bya la legs par zhugs pa 〈snags yin pa'i phyig gzhan yang / de mi 'thad par thal/ so skye la stong nyid la ma 'khral pa'i mngon sum med pa'i pyir te/ dgongs rgyan las/ de la gang cig lha sa rnams kyi mngon sum de ni/ don dam pa'i dbang du byas nas ma zhabrul bar mi brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gzhan yang / de chos can/ stong nyid mngon sum du ma rtogs par thal/ mthong spang sgom spang gang rung gi bden 'dzin cung zad kyang kha ma bri ba'i phyig khyab ste/ de 'dra'i gzhi mthun blun 4 tshig spyi ba ma yin pas khas len pa bzhad gad yin pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ mdor na gang dag tshur ma'ong gis chos nyid mngon sum gyis rtogs pa yod par 'dod cing / zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ blun po tshig tsam zhig la/ nas/ mthong spang dang sgom spang gi bdag lta cung zad kyang kha ma bri bar bdag med mngon sum gyis rtogs par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig— — — — —1 parazengs gnyisapa/dmigs pa'i tshe'i/gnyisasnangaphugad kyang snga mganyis ltabu'i gnyis snang/2 pa rathengs gnyisapa/mthong srang sasan/331
phar phyin skabasadang po/yang kha cig na re/ we/de stong nyid la dran pa bcad shes zed de la bod kyi mkhas pa na re/stong nyid la ye shes kyi gsal snang med par thal/ dran pa bcad shes yin pa'i phyig khyab ste/ de sgra rtog yin pas gsal bar snang ba 'gal ba'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ dgongs rgyan las/ ye shes kyi snang ba shin tu gsal bar skye ba de'i tshe bzod pa'i gnas skabs te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ tshogs lam du rnam g.yeng shas che ba sbyongar lam du 〈snam byung gi stobs kyis de shas chung ba la dgongs pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ tshogs lam du rnam g.yeng shas che ba sbrengar lam du sgom byung gis 'dris par byas te/ shas chung ba la bzhed na rung la/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab lte/ rnam g.yeng de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gnyis snang yod la/ de (1)chung ngu'i gnyis snang chung ba sgom byung gis yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ gnyis snang yod kyang snga ma gnyis lta bu'i gnyis snang rags pa 〈snag nas/ yul de la zug pa ltar snang zhing / chu la chu bzhag pa'i tshul du 'gyur la khad pa ltar snang bas/ (2)stong pa nyid kyi don spyi shar ba la/ chos nyid gsal bar snang zhes bya'i/ rtog bral gyi gsal snang ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis de la kho na re/ stong nyid la gsal snang yod kyang mngon sum ma yin par thal/ de de la gsal snang can gyi mngon sum ltar snang yin pa'i phyig der thal/ mngon sum ltar snang drug po gang rung yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ de la gsal snang 〈snad pas ma khyab pa'i mig der thal/ smig rgyu chur 'dzin lta bu'i zhakhrul (3)can dang /bum pa'i tshogs sgyi bedzin pa'i kun rdzob shes pa brda rtog dang /rtags 'dzin rtog pa dang / rjes dpag dang / 'das pa'i don dran pa'i bcad shes dang / ma 'ongs pa'i (4don — —— — — — —1 parazengasaganyis pa/ chung 'bringagi gnyis/2 parazengasaganyisapa/tshulade ltabur stong ba/3 bar thengasaganyisab/snang]4 bar zengs gnyis pa/don mngon bar 'dod/332

gzung 'dzin rtogde gnyis dngos ming tha dad kyi so sor go bya yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ de phyir khyad par gang gi 〈snas/ /gang gi bosna bar gyur pa de/ /de las gzhan gyis nus ma yin/ /des na tha dad rnam par gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / phung po tshad mas nges nas gzung ba tshad mas nges dgos kyi gang zag med par thal/ phung 4 tshad mas nges na gzung ba tshad mas nges pas khyab pa'i mig der thal/ phung po la dmigs pa dang bzung na/ gzung ba la dmigs pa dang bzung bas khyab pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de de'i mtshan gzhi ma yin par thal/ phung po jis nas des de mtshon pa (1)skabs bab pa'i gang zag med pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa gnyis dmigs yul gyi 〈sna nas lasdog zer/ la la na re/ bzung tshul lam zhen tshul kho na'i sgo nas langog zer na/ dang po la/ 'o na/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gnyis kyi dmigs yul la phung po lnga khams bco brgyad dang skye mched bcu gnyis mi par 'thad par thal/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa gnyis dmigs yul kho na'i sgo nas 'grog pa'i phyig khyab ste/ skye mched bcu gnyis kyi gzugs sesnags yul drug gzung ba dang / mig sesnags yul can drug 'dzin pa yin pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/dang po ltar na yul drug gzung ba dang dbang po drug 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzung 'dzin la mkhas pa'i tshad kyang de'i steng nas bshad pa'i phyir te/ chos yang dag par lha/ ༵ palha /de hūm̐ spra/ra ྅ ghnā kṣiṃ ( shā sna sdu/ raṃ ghnā rdzu jipa sna (pa sna da/ tram̐ snasapa /nga rdzud shā shushā so/ /gzung ba ni gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya dang chos rnams te gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i chos 'di dag rnam pa dang tshul thams cad kyis shes pa dang / khong du chud ba dang 1 par thengasaganyis pa /skabs su bab/ 347
phar phyin skabs dang po/ston nus pa de ni thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsabar 'dod na/rtsabar/ rmongs dang phung sogs bye brag gis/ /de ni so sor rnam pa dgu/ /zhes dang / 'grel pa las/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i gzhi'i rten can ma rig pa dang gzugs la dre gas pa'i phung po dang / zhes (1)sogs gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ de dag la dmigs pa'i shes sgrib gzung rtog med pa'i phyig gzhan yang nyi snang las/ de yang rnam par byang ba'i char gtogs pa'i phung po dang / skye mched dang khams dang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la rtsogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa dgur 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ phung sesnags la dmigs pa'i shes sgrib rnam byang gzung rtog dgu med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ phung po sgyi ma bzhi dang yul can skye mched drug dang yul can khams drug la dmigs pa'i gzung rtog med pa'i pyig der thal/ 'dzin pa la dmigs pa'i gzung rtog med pa'i phyig der thal/ de gnyis dmigs pa kho nas 'jog pa'i phyir te/ gser zeng 'a/sa/ de dag gis ni legs par ma rtogs te/ nas/rtog pa bzhi pa'i yul du gzugs can bshad pa rnams dor dgos par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig lugs gnyis pa gzung tshul lam zhen tshul kho nas shes sgrib gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog lasdog pa mi 'thad par thal/ gzung tshul gyi sgo nas gzung bar bden par zhen pas shes sgrib gzung rtog dang/ 'dzin par bden par zhen pas shes sgrib 'odzin rtog tu bzhag pa gcig kyang yod/ 'dzig rten gyi grags pa dang mthun par yul gzung ba kho na dang / 'odzin pa kho na dang / gzung 'odzin gnyis ka yin pa gsum 〈snad pas gzung 'dzin rtog pa la mu gsum byas pa'i gyig dang 4 grub ste/ yul shes pa dang) phyin drug sogs lam yin kyang 'jug bya'am longs spyad byar bden par bedzin pa'i blo shes sgrib gzung rtog yin yangade dag longs rgyud pa por bden par ladzin pa'i blo — ——— ————1 parazengasaganyis ba/tshagasami 'apad/348
gzung 'dzin rtogshes sgrib 'dzin rtog yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ des na longs spyad byar bden par zhen pa dang longs spyod byed du bden par zhen pa ni gzung bar rtog pa dang 'odzin par rtog pa'i don no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid gnyis pa grub lte/ de ltar dmigs yul gyi ma bzhag na rtog pa mu gsum pa gcig mi rung ba'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ des na 'dir ni gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bshad pa'i zhar la sbyo skad la grags tshod kyi gzung 'dzin bshad nas de la mu brtsis pa yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig rdo rje'i tshig tu snang ngo / /yang kha cig /kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos la longs spyad byar bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'odzin nyon mongs gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid dang / rnam byang gi chos la de ltar 'odzin pa rnam byang gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ nyon mongs phyogs kyi chos la nyon mongs pa'i chos mi dgos/ rnam byang la de ltar yin pa'i pyir/ 'dzin rtog la kha cig na re/ gang zag rang rkya zub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de/ rtsabag rdzas dang btags pa'i rten can gyi/ /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rdzas 'odzin rtog pa yin zer na/ de chos can/ (1)shes sgrib 'dzin rtog yin par thal/ de'i dngos bstan gyi rdzas 'dzin rtog pa yin pa'i phyid gdod mi nus nta/nyon sgrib yin pa'i pyir te/ rnam bshad las/ dang po la dmigs pa'i 'dzin pa nyon sgrib yin pas shes sgrib 'dzin rtog tu mi 'thad la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ phung po'i tshogs pa la skyes bur btags pa 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de/ rtsabar/ btags pa'i rten can gyi/ /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi shes sgrib btags 'dzin rtog pa yin zer na/ de chos can/ spang bya rtog pa yin par thal/ shes sgrib btags 'dzin rtog pa yin pa'i phyig 'dod mi rigs par thal/ khyod kyi zhen yul gyi 'dzin ltangs tshad mas grub pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ phyi ma'i —— —— — ——— ——— — —1 bar zengs gnyisapa/shes sgrib rdzas mdzen rtog pa/ 349
phar phyin skabs dang po/'dzin pa tshad mas grub pa'i don 'dzin pa yin pas spang bya rtog par mi 'thad/ ces gsungs pa'i pyig yang kha cig /gang zag don byed nus par 'odzin pa'i rtog pa de shes sgrib rdzas 'dzin dang / gang zag don byed mi nus par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de shes sgrib btags 'odzin rtog pa ste/rtsabag rdzas dang btags pa'i rten can gyi/ /'dzin pa'ang rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /ces pa'i rtog pa gnyis yin zer na/ dang po de chos can/ khyod kyi zhen yul med par thal/ shes sgrib 'odzin rtog yin pa'i phyig der thal/ shes sgrib rdzas 'dzin rtog pa yin pa'i pyig 'dod mi nus te/ de'i zhen yul bkag na skyes bu don (1)byed nus pa la skur 'debs su 'gyur ba'i phyir te/rnam bshad las/ de bkag na skur 'debs su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes sem/ /gang zag don byed mi nus par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ khyod kyi zhen yul don dam dpyod pa'i rigs pas 'gog dgos par thal/ khyod shes sgrib 'dzin rtog yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ shes sgrib btags 'dzin rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod kyi zhen yul gang zag don byed nus par 'dzin pa'i tha snyad pa'i tshad mas khegs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de de dang gang zag la dmigs nas 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du song ba'i tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ phyi ma'i 'dzin pa tha snyad pa'i tshad mas kyang khegs pas gnas lugs kyi don la dmigs pas dgag mi dbostos/ zhes then/ /yang kha cig/gang zag bden grub rdzas yod dang] der 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang] gang zag bden stong sgyu ma ltabu btags yod dang] de 'dzin pa'i rtog pa shes sgrib btags bedzin rtog pa zeran/'on/ 'der bstan shes sgrib btags 'odzin rtog pa lhan skyes med par thal/gang zag bden stong sgyu ma lta bu stong nyid ma rtogs bar du mi 'byung ba'i sgyig 'dod na/ mthong spang — —— —— —— —1 par zengs gnyis pa/ byed pa/350
gzung 'dzin rtogshes sgrib rtog pa bzhi dang sgom spang shes sgrib rtog pa bzhi mi 'thad par thal/ rnam bshad las/'dir bstan skyes bu btags 'dzin rtog pa la lhan skyes mi srid par (1)'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod na/ rtsabar 'gal lo/ /yang kha cig na re/ shes sgrib rdzas 'dzin so skye la yod/'phags par med/ shes sgrib btags 'dzin rtog pa 'phags par yod so skye la med de/ rtsabadserdzo 〈sna skye 4 'phags dbye bas/ /sems can rdzasadang btags yod pas /rnam rtog 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ shes sgrib rdzas 'dzin gyi dmigs yul skyes bu rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i zhen yul med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i so skye med pas rdzas 'dzin so skye'i rten can zhes bshad/ de med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa 'phags pa la yod pas btags 'dzin 'phags pa'i rten can zhes bshad/ so skye dang 'phags pa 'og ma gnyis la shes sgrib 'dzin rtog gnyis yod pa'i phyig dang ṭo grub ste/ nyi snang las/ chos thams cad (2)bdag med pa yin no/ /zhes 〈sna rtso skye bos kyang rtogs pa min nam/ nas/ de dag gi de ni mos pa yid la byed pa yin la 'dir ni de kho na yid la byed pa brjod par (3)'dod pas snying ṭo med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin du/ rnam bshad las/ phyi ma'i zhen yul myong stobs kyis khegs pa serdzo so skye bo la med/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ rgol bas de mi 'thad pa'i sgrub byed du (4)'phags par ngas ce spyang skad thos zhes gsungs pa yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ sgyu ma lta bu'i btags yod kyi tshig (5)yin gyi so skye ltar ma — wawa— —— —— wawa1 pa ra zengs gnyisapa/'gyuraba'i phyir ro//2 par zengs gnyis gabadagazedayin na//zhes chosade ltabu rnams rtso rtsoskye pos kyang rtogs bamasananam/3 bar zengs gnyis ba/'dod ba yin pa sa/4 parazengs gnyisapa/'phags par yanganangabar gyi tshe/5 parazengs gnyis pa/yin pas/351
phar phyin skabasadang po/yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ de'i tshig ni tha snyad pa yin gyi don dam pa min pa des na snying po med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rnam bshad las/ 'phags pa la 〈snad pas/ zhes serdzo/ /gsum pa grub ste/ gnyis spu'i rgyud kyi lhan skyes 〈snad pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ sbyor gnyis ka'ang gnyis rka'i rten can du shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisrang lugs la/ rang gi dmigs yul gzung ba la dmigs nas longs spyad bya'i rigs su bden par gzung ba'i cha nas bzhag pa'i bden 'odzin de/shes sgrib gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/yul can gyi yul dang gzung ba dang longs spyad bya 'dra bas rigs gnas smos pas ldog 'dzin sdud cing / cha bzhag gi phyi rol don bedzin gyi rtog pa yang bsdu'o/ /dbye na/ shes sgrib kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog dang / rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi dmigs yul kun nyon phyogs kyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyad bya'i rigs su bden par 'dzin pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i bden 'odzin de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ yul gyi sgo nas dgu yod/ rang gi dmigs yul rnam byang phyogs kyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyad bya'i rigs su bden par 'odzin pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i bden 'odzin de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs yulagyi sgo nas dgu yod/rang gi dmigs yul 'odzin pa'i chos la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par 'edzin pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i bden 'dzin de/ shes sgrib 'odzin rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ shes sgrib rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / shes sgrib btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ rang gi dmigs yul rdzas 'dzin la dmigs nas sngar ltar 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul rdzas bedzin la skyes bu dang] dbang po dang / rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'odzin pa dang] bden 'odzin sogs lasdog lte/ rdzas grub du 'dzin pa thams cad do/ /dbye na dgu yod/ rang gi dmigs yul btags 'dzin la dmigs nas longs spyodad pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i 352
gzung 'dzin rtogbden 'dzin de shes sgrib btags 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul btags 'odzin ni/bdag med gsum gang rung rtogs pa'i gang zag dang] de yo'i blo dang de gsum gyi rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i skyes bu'am gang zag dang / de dag gis khyad par du byas pa'i gang zag de dag 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang mngon sum rnams yin/ des na lana'i gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa gnyis dmigs yul khonadangaka gzung tshul khonas mi lasdog la/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas kyang gzung rtogadang 'edzin rtog la mu bzhir bshadade dmigs yul gzung ba kho na la longs spyad byar bden par 'edzin pa'i rtog pa de/ gzung rtog yin la 'dzin rtog ma yin pa'i mu/ shes pa skad cig ma la longs spyodad pa por bden par 'edzin pa'i rtog pa de/ 'odzin rtog yin la gzung rtog min pa'i sa rgyun dang bcas pa'i shes pa longs spyad byar bden par bedzin pa'i rtog pa de/ gnyis ka yin pa'i mu/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi phar pyin de/ gnyis ka min pa'i mu yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de dmigs pa dang 74na tshul gnyis lnga'i sgonas shes sgrib gzung rtog yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa yin la 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa ma yin pa zhes bya ba mu bzhi lte/ mu dang po ni/ gzugs la se gas pa'i yul drug bosna/zhes gsungs pa'i pyidkhyab lte/ yul bshad pas yul can go ba'i phyir te/ rgyan snang las/ de la mu dang po ni yul drug tu snang ba'i rnam pa can gyi rnam par rig pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub lte/ so so skye po'i mngon sum la mi snang bas gzung bar ma bzhag cing 'edzin pa'i tshul gyis kyang bedzin rtog yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ gnyis pa ni skad cig ma gcig dang ldan pa'i rnam par rig pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dis kyang yul las ma bshad kyang na ba'i phyir te/ rgyan snang las/ gnyis pa ni skad cig ma gcig pa'i 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggsum pa grub ste/ rgyun dang ldan pa'i shes pa so skye'i mngon sum la snang bas gzung ba dang shes 353
phar phyin skabs dang po/pa yin pas 'odzin pa yang yin pa'i sgyiganyi snang las/ gsum pa ni skad cig ma gzhan gyide nyid do/ /zhes dang] rgyan snang las/ gsum pa ni de nyid kyi skad cig ma gzhan du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ nyi snang dang rgyan snang gnyis las/ bzhi pa ni rnam pa de dag dang bral ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggsum pa rtsod spong la/ kho na re/ gzugs sgyi rol don du 'odzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid der thal/ shes sgrib gzung rtog yin pa'i phyir/ der thal / rtsabar/gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dod na/ longs spyad byar bden par 'dzin pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i bden 'dzin yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i pyir/ 'dod na/bden 'dzin yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ bden 'dzin rags pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / phung 4 bden 'edzin la longs spyad byar bden par 'odzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ kun nyon gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid der thal/shes sgrib kun nyon gzung rtog yin pa'i phyig'dod na/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos la dmigs par thal/ kun nas nyon mongs phyogs kyi chos la dmigs pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ nyon mongs yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod mi nus ste/ shes sgrib yin pa'i nyid des rnam byang phyogs dang / rnam byang gi chos kyang 'dra'o/ /yang kha cig na re/ 'phags pa'i lugs la kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog yin na rnam byang gzung rtog yin dgos par thal/nyi snang las/ gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang po gang yin pa gnyis pa'ang de yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ mdo las gzung rtog sbyor bstan pa'i rtog pa yin na rnam byang gzung rtog yin dgos pa'i pyid mdo las/ khyod nyon mongs pa med pa rnams kyi ma:rdzog tu bstan pa ltar/ zhes pa nas/ 〈snas thams cad mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyi slob pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi rtog pa la de ltar dgos pa gang zhig /de'i 354
phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin gnyis bstan pa/dngos bstan gyi shes sgrib gzung rtog la rnam byang gzung rtog gis khyab pa'i phyid dang po grub ste/nyi snang las/ rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan nyid kyi dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa ni rab 'gyor ji ltar ngas khyod/ ces sogs gsungs pa'i pyig khyab ste/ 'phags pas de rjes su nyon mongs gzung rtog dgu bshad pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon gyis kyang de rtog pa athi+-i la sbyar ba'i phyir te/le brgyad ma las/ rnam par rtog pa dang ldan pa spyi'i dbang du byas nas bstan pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ mdo las/ bka' bstsal pa/ shā ri'i bu byang chenade ltar slob pa ni shes rab kyi/ nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis slob pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyidgsum pa yongs 'dzin ni/ rtsabar/ sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs/ /nas/ yongs 'dzin yin/ /zhes byung / 'phros spre1ra mtha' dbyad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ mdo las/ byang chen theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa sher phyin la rgyud pa/ zhes sogs kyis sgyi nang gi yongs 'dzin gnyis bstan pa de 'chad par 'di byung / gnyis pa ni/ byang sems bhyor lam pa'i yongs 'dzin chos can/ gnyis yod de/ phyi'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / nang gi thabs shes tshang ba'i thabs mkhas kyi yongs 'dzin gnyis yod pa'i pyid mtha' dpyad pa la kha cig na re/ byang sems sbyordzor lam pa la thabs shes kyi cha yongs su rdzogs par ston pa'i dge bshes de/ de'i phyi'i yongs 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ byang sems bhyor lam pa'i yongs 'dzin du gyur pa'i bye smra chos can/ der thal/ de'i pyid de yod pa'i sgyig der thal/ de'i yongs 7rin du gyur pa'i sems tsam pa yod pa'i phyig der thal/ jo bo'i yongs 'dzin gser gling pa dang / shan ti pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ snga ma sems tsam rnam bden pa dang sgyi ma rnam rdzun pa yin pa'i 355
phar phyin skabs dang po/pyid 'dod na/ de la sems bskyed nyi shu dang] stong nyid brtso brgyad sogs ston nus par thal/'dod pa'i sgyid de la kha cig na re/ jo bo'i bla ma shrī la rakṣi ta phal chen sde pa yin zer na/ de chos can/ bye brag smra ba yin par thal/ phal chen lde ba yin pa'i sgyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ theg chen khungar lam bzod pa thob pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ lam rim las/ phal chen sde pa'i gnas brtan chen 4 shī la rakṣi ta zhes bya ba sbyongar ba'i lam gyi de kho na nyid kyi phyogs gcig la zhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin brnyes pa zhig la mkhan 4 mdzad nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyig yang kha cig/sbrengar lam gyi de kho na nyid la phyogs gcig tu zhugs pa spre1ra lam rtsemo la byed zed kha cig na re/theg chen kho na'i bhyor lam bzod par byed zer na/ dang 4 mi 'thad par thal/ de spyor lam bzod pa'i ming don yin par bshad zin pa'i pyir/ gnyis pa yang mi 'thad par thal/ nyan thos bhyor lam bzod pa'i dus kyang bedzin pa phyogs gcig pa'i ting nge bedzin yod pa'i phyig der thal/ de sbyongar lam bzod pa'i ming yin pa'i phyir te/ nyan sa las/ dmigs pa med pa lta bur snang mod kyi/ de dmigs pa med pa yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidrang lugs la/ byang sems sbyongar lam pa la chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de/ de'i phyi'i yongs 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems grar lam pa srid zhi'i mthar ltang ba 'gog pa'i byang sems bhyor lam pa'i mngon rtog de/ de'i nang gi yongs 'odzin gyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems bhyor lam pa la theg chen gyi chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de/ de'i theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid/ de la thabs shes kyi cha rdzogs par ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de/ de'i theg chen yongs rdzogs ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /rtsod spong la khon re/ byang sems bhyor lam pa'i thabs shes khyad par can gnyis chos can/byang sems bhyor lam pa srid pa'i mthar ltang ba lasag byedasan par thal/ de srid zhi'i mthar lhung 356
phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin gnyis bstan pa/ba lagag byed yin pa'i phyis lasad na/ de'i rgyud kyi stong nyid kyi ltabs zin pa'i snying rje chen pode srid mtha' 'gog byed yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyis 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi snying rjes zin pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba de zhi mtha' 'gog byed yin par thal/ ladod pa'i pyid ladod mi nus te/ rtsabag shes pas srid la mi gnas shingaka /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dngan /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ lag rjes so serdzor bstan pa dang/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab kyis zhi mtha' mi khegs/shes rabadang bral ba'i thabs kyis kyang srid mtha' mi khegs pa'idon yin pa'i pyig dang po grub ste/ shing rta chen po kwa ma la shī la'i sgom rim las/ byang chub sems dpas shes rab tsam bstenanani nyan thos kyi 'dod pa'i myacan las 'das par ltang bas 'ching ba bzhin du 'gyur te/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pas krol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'ching (1)ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig shes byed kyang du mas grub 'o/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ sgom rim las thabs tsam 'ba' zhig bsten na yang byang chub sems dpa' so rtso skye bo'i sa las mi 'da' bas shin tu bcings pa kho nar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid ma khyab mtshams la 'dod mi nus te/ stong nyid kyi lta bas zin pa'i snying rjes kyang srid zhi gnyis lnga'i mtha' lasag/sems bskyed dang snying rje chen pos zin pa'i stong nyid kyi ltabs kyang zhi mtha' lasag pa'i phyis dang 4 grub ste/dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo las/ shes rab kyis ma zin pa'i thabs ni 'ching ba'o/ /shes rab kyis zin pa'i thabs ni thar pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ mdo de las/ thabs kyis ma zin pa'i shes rab ni 'ching ba'o/ /thabs kyis zin pa'i shes rab ni thar pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig— — —— ——1 bar zengs gnyis ba/ba'o//357

phar phyin skabs dang po/dgongs la dpyad pa gsum/ dang po la/ dgag bzhag spangs gsum/ dang po la/ nyan zos sde pa'i lugs/ sems tsam pa'i lugs/ dbu ma ba'i lugs la dbyad pa gsum/ dang po la kha cig na re/ bye mdo gnyis rigs 'dod tshul mthun zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ bye smra'i rigs kyi ngo 4 sems byung dang ma chags pa'i dge bar khas len/ mdo sde pas zag med sems kyi sa 'on zhig tu khas len pa'i phyir/ dang 4 grub ste/ dge rtsagasum gyi nang gi ma chags pa'i sems byung gcig 'phags pa'i rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ ma chags 'phags rigs/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de la dbye na chos gos ngan ngon gyis tshog shes dang / bsod snyoms ngan ngon gyis chog shes dang / gnas mal ngan ngon gyis chog shes dang / slong ba dang sgom la dga' ba'i ma chags pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ de dag las/ /gsum gyi tshul bstan tha ma'i las/ /srid pa skye ba'i gnyen po'i phyig /de yi dus dang gtan zhi'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub nye/ rgyal sras ma las/ mdo sde pa dag rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs ni zag pa med pa'i sems kyi sa bon gyi nus pa la 'dod/ces gsungs pa'i phyidgnyis pa sems tsam pa'i lugs la kha cig na re/ sems tsam pas rigs drug tu 'dod de/ nyan thos kyi rigs/ rang rgyal gyi rigs/ byang sems kyi rigs/ nges pa'i rigs/ ma nges pa'i rigs/ rigs chad dang drugasmo thos kyi chos thos pas gso bar bya ba rṇa thos kyi rigs/gzung ba rang bzhin med pa man chad kyi chos thos pas gso bar bya ba rang rgyal gyi rigs zer ba la/ yang kha cig na re/ rang rgyal gyi rigs bzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i chos thos pas gso ba'i don gzung ba pyi don med pa dang bden med gang rung dgos pas mi yod zeg blun 4 la la na re/ rnam bshad las kyang de ltar gsungs pa yang zhal nor zed rmongs zhen kha cig na re/360
rigs/bdag med gnyis gang rung mayin pa'i gzung ba rang bzhin med payin par thal lo 3da dedag mi 'thad par thal/ rang rgyal gyis gzung ba skye mched gang zag gi bdag med du gtso 'or bsgom pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnal 'gyor spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa ma gtogs grub mtha' gzhan bzhi ma'i lugs la nyan rang gnyis la shes rab kyi rtogs rigs tha dad par mi 'dod pa'i nyid der thal/ rang rgyal gyis kyang nyan zos kyi sde snod la dmigasanas slob/ mngon rtogs kyang chos mngon rtogs sogs mngon rtogs bdun rgyud la skyed tshul mi 'dra yang mngon rtogs bdun nyan thos dang 'dra ba'i phyig dang po grub ste/ kun btus las/ nyan thos kyi zeg pa gang zhe na/ nas/ nyan thos kyi sde snod la dmigs nas chos kyi rjes su (1)mthun pa thob pa'o/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa gang zhe na/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid nges pa'am/ ma nges pa la gnas pa dngaka nas/ bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i bsam pa can nyan thos kyi sde snod la dmigs nas chos kyi ṣṭṛ rdzu ༈ pashā spya pa'i ru kau spya zlor/ /sa/ ga/ (rsha pa mp+raṃ lha (spra dī dī spyad parazlo )pa spras ༷kta parlo / ༷ ༷ ṭwāṃ kṣiṃ ṭwāṃX sdu shlau two smaṃ /ra//khri shaṃ ṭwāṃX ༷ shlau hūm̐ pyā mp+raṃ ༈/ hā/sna ༵ sna (slo na pa/ 〉( rsha pa( /sdu dī ༵༵༵༵ sdu sno pasbyo (3 sna ༈ kaushā dri mp+raṃ rtogs pa bdun po de dag kyang gzhan gyi sgra la ma brten par thob pas rang sangs rgyas kyi mngon 1 b.razengasaganyis pa /nga zunapa 'i chos bsgrubacing sdugabasngal ñtsha tsha tharaslin pa thob pa'o//2 par zengasaganyisapa/redagabadun po nyid/ 361
phar phyin skabs dang po/par rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab lte/ mngon rtogs bcu'i nang gi chos dang]don dang] de kho na dang / rjes la dang / dkon mchog dang / kun tu mi 'byung ba dang mthar thug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bdun po de yin pa'i phyig de ltar ma go nas mkhas rloms dang blun po du mas mun sprul byas so/ /gzhan yang] rnam bshad kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don skye mched bcuganyis gang zag gi bdag med pa la byed par thal/ nyan rang gnyis gas nyan thos kyi sde snod las gang zag gi bdag med bsgom par gsungs pa 'dra yang gtan la dbab pa'i gzhi'i sgo nas khyad par yod pa'i phyig der thal/ de gnyis nas gang zag gi bdag med gtan la 'phebs bdang sgom dus nyan thos rang bzhin gyi dbang ṭo rtul bas phung po lnga tsam gyi steng nas dang / rang rgyal rang bzhin sgya dbang 4 'bring yin pas skye mched bcu gnyis kyi steng du gtso sar byed pa de yin pa'i phyig mdo sde du ma dang] mdzod las/ slongs dbang 'dod rnam gsum gyi phyir/ /phung po la serdzogs gsum bstan to/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mig spros pas chog la gzhan du'ang bshad zin/nyan sa las/ de ni lus las khyad par du gyur pa dang] skye mched drug gis zin pa dang zhes pa'i don la kha cig mdo thugan re/ dbang sa lnga rigs su mi rung bas skye mched yid kyi skye mched la bya zeg 'bri chen 4 shes rab 'bar na re/ 〈snar bzhag chog ste/ dbang po lnga yang sems kyi snang ba yin pa'i phyir zed kha cig na re/ can gyi/ pyi'i skye mched drug po de bzhin nyid la bya lte/chos nyid kyis thob pa zhes pas so 3ra/ de rnams mi 'thad par thal/ dang po gnyis skye mched la ma zhakhrul yang rigs su 'dod tshul nog gsum pas ni skye mched dang rigs gnyis ka ngos ma zin pa'i phyig dang po grub ste/ rigs can gyi nang gi skye mched drug rigs kyi gdags gzhi yin gyi rigs ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nang gi skye mched (1)drug gi steng gi gnas 'gyur —— wawa wawa — ———1 bar zengs gnyis ba/ drug zhiganas/362
rigs/ltar ram gang rung gi steng gi gnyen so mthar thug 'byung rung dang dri ma zad rung gi nus pa'am sa 'on la lasdog pa'i phyir/ dbang po drug gnas 'gyur ba'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis zob par bshad pa'i phyis nyan sa las/ sa bon de ni skye mched drug po de dag las logs shig na tha dad pa'i mtshan nyid med de/ nas/ skye mched drug po de ltar gyur pa'i gnas skabs de la rigs dang sa 'on dang khams dang rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / sa bon zhes bshad pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub lte/ chos nyid kyis thob pa'i sdom pa yang yod pas des 'du ma byas su mi 'grub la dbang po gnas gyur dang ye shes lnga gang gi gnas gyur sogs ma shes pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nang gi skye mched drug gang rung la thogs med nas rgyun ma chad par 'ongs pa'i byang chub thob rung gi nus pa la byed dgos pa'i phyir nye/ rgya mtsho sprin las/sa son de yang 'dus byas las de nyid gzhan dang gzhan du brjod pa las grol ba gzung bar mi nus pa skye mched drug gi khyad par zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggsum pa dbu ma ba'i lugs la/ rong ṭīka pa na re/ dri bcas kyi sems gsal rig de rang bzhin gnas rigs yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi nyer len yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla ma las/rigs khams sbrang tsi'adra ba 'di gzigs nas/ /nas/ lus can la yod zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /zhes dang / bstod tshogs las/ bde gshegs sems las sangs rgyas 'byung / /rang sems de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs nang nas sangs rgyas dang / /de bzhin dri ma med par gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/ lung dang 4 drangs mtshams la ma khyab par thal/ sems can gyi sems bden stong la zag med shes par btags nas sbrang 6lta bur bltan pa yin pa'i phyid der thal/ rgyud bla ma las de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang sbrang rtsisogs bcus bshad pa gang zhig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 363
phar phyin skabs dang po/snying po stong nyid yin pa mdo dang thogs 'grel las/ dpe dgu tshan gnyis kyis kyang bstan pa'i phyir/ dang 4 grub ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ de ltar rgyal ba'i snying po yis/ /rnam bzhag rnam pa bcu zhes brjod/ /nyon mongs sbrubs na gnas pa de/ /dpe dag gis ni shes par spha /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ de'i thogs 'grel las/ rtag pa'i chos nyid rigs par bya ba nyid skya dbang du byas nas don rnam pa bcus de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di rnam par bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ de 'dra'i rang bzhin gnas rigs la pad ngan nang gi de bzhin gshegs pa lta bur gsungs pa'i phyir te/ snying po'i mdo las/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi nyon mongs ba can du gyur pa de dag gi nang na de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid mi ga〈sna zhing srid pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyis ma bosnas pa mthong nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni nga dang 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dpe dang po'i grub don skabs su snying po'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu dag 'di ni chos rnams kyi chos nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung / sems can 'di dag ni rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi mig yod na the tshom ga la 〈snad/de bzhin du thogs 'grel las kyang / rang bzhin dag pa'i chos nyid kyi dbang du byas nas dpe dgus de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zlogan lnga ngas pa'i sbrubs phye ba mtha' yas pas btums pa ni mdo ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig tsartags gsum pa grub ste/dpe dgu sdom gyis 'chad par/ rgyud bla ma las/ sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang mismrang ma la/ /zhes lce'ogs dang / rgyas bshad kyi nang nas/ de bzhin lus can rnams kyi zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang (1)ma'i sbrang rtsi'adra/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyig des na bstod tshogs kyi lung don snying po'i — —— — — —1 par zangasaganyis pa/ma'i gdang 4/364
rigs/mdo ltar yin te/ mdo de'i don tshigs bcad byas par shin tu gsal ba'i phyir/ spros pa tsam gyis shes so/ /yang kho na re/ dri bcas kyi sems gsal rig de rang bzhin gnas rigs zer na/ de chos can/ khyod rang bzhin gnas rigs ma yin par thal/ khyod la rang bzhin gyi don ma tshang pa'i phyig der thal/ khyod rgyu rkyen gyis gsar du bcos pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir te/nyi snang las/ de dag gis ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs la rang bzhin du brjod pa'i don brjod dgos so/ /rgyu'i rnam grangs yin no zhe na/ rkyen gyis yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba yang de yin pas des na don gyi khyad par ci zhig yod/ ces gsungs pa'i pyidgzhanayang/de chos can/ chos nyidayin par thal/rang bzhin gnas rigasayin pa'i phyiskhyab lte/ de ni mdo dang mthun/ 'phags seng gi dgongs pa yang yin pa'i phyis dang po grub ste/dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/gang la 'du byed cung zad kyang med pa de ni 'dus ma byasasan la/'dus ma byas gang yin pa de ni 'phags pa rnams kyi rigs yin te/ zhes dang] phal chen las kyang] kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i rigs zhes bya ba ni chos kyi dbyings lhur len pa nam mkha' ltar yangs ba rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyiradang] rje btsun gyis kyang/dri med gsaladang gzhan med chos nyid kyi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyidaganyis pa grub ste/nyi snang las/ chos nyid kyi rnam grangasasan pa la ni nyes pa 'di medado/ /zhes dang/ 'grel pa las/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kho na la rigs zhes bstan to/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisgzhanakhang] sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyis ma khyab par thal/dri bcas kyi sems gsal rig tsam la rigs su lasdog pa'i phyis khyab ste/de ltar na rigasade gsar bzhag dgos pas mdo du ma dang 'gal ba'i phyis chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de yod pas ni 'gro kun dang / /mya ngan 'das 365
phar phyin skabs dang po/pa'ang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dkon brtsegs las/ rigs de ni nam mkha'adang mnyam pa nyid kyis khyad par med pa'o/ /rigs de ni thams cad kyi mee chos kyi de bzhin nyid yin pas chos kyi ro gcig tu gyur pa nyid kyis rtag pa'o/ /zhes dang /zogs 'grel du mdo drangs pa las/ji ltar nam mkha' gzugs rnams kun tu song / /de bzhin 'di yang sems can tshogs kun song / /zhes dang /thogs 'grel las kyang / de ltar sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang / sbrang midang / snying po'i dpe 'di gsum gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams khyab pa'i don gyi dbang du byas nas sems can 'di dag thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo can yin no zhes bstan rto/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ chos dbyings gang ༷༷sa/ kli ṭī sgyus pa phru rṇi 〉spra ༷sna der/nga snaji bee ghnā rmi ṭwāṃ kṣiṃ mp+raṃ (zi nyisa~X rdha sda/ two ༷༷ // two khri///āoṃ/ two ṭwāṃ/ ༷༷ rnyi ༷ ༵ ༵ /spya /9 nye(smo /spya khriX nyid dri ma dang bcas dus su sems can gyi khams dang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po yin/dri ma thams cad zad dus de chos sku yin pa'i phyir/ dar ṭīka las/ de bzhin nyid gcig pu dri ma dang bcas pa'i gnas skabs na sems can gyi khams dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo zhes bsnyad la dri ma mtha'adag gis dben pa na chos kyi sku'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de gnyis gnas skabs sgo nas 'gal ba'i phyir dang / mdo dang shing rta chen po'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/thogs 'grel du seng ge'i nga ro'imado drangs pa las/shā ri'i bu/ sems can gyi khams zhes bya ba 'do ni dri ma ci rigs pa spangs shing cung zad dang bcas pa'i gnas skabs na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying 366
rigs/po'i tshig bla dwags so/ /shā ri'i bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying pho zhes bya ba 'dini dri ma mtha' dag gisadapen pa na chos kyi sku'i tshig bla dwags so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisgzhan yang / rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyi chos nyid chos can/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid yin par thal/ rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa'i pyig 'dod mi nus te/ de'i tshe dri ma med la dri ma ma spangs pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi chos nyid gnas gyur mthar thug pa'i tshe ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung de/ rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ lam ma zhugs kyi rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs dngan nyan rang gi rgyud kyi de dag chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyig yang kha cig /mtshan nyid de theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ rgyun mtha' pa'i chos nyid chos can/ gnas 'gyur mthar thug gi tshe ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyig 'dod mi rigs par thal/ gnas 'gyur mthar shug gi dus sungo bo nyid skur gyur zin pa'i phyig der thal/ de mee sangs rgyas zin pa'i phyir te/ de sangs rgyas zin pa'i dus yod pa'i phyidyang kha cig /theg chen gyi gyor lam drod yan chad kyi byang sems rgyud kyi chos nyid de/ 'dir bstan rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ 'o na/ byang sems kyi drod yan chad kyi mthong spang bden 'dzin gyi chos nyid chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ sems can gyi sems kyi chos nyid de/ rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid zer na/'o na/ rang bzhin gnas rigs yin na sems gcig gi chos nyidayinadabosnas par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i pyid'dod mi nus te/ sangs rgya rung gi gang zag dang / phung 4 dang / sems byung gi chos nyid kyang rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sangs rgya rung gi de dag sangs rgyas pa na 'bras bu lngasnas sku yin pa'i phyig367
phar phyin skabs dang po/gnyis pa rang lugs la/ ngo bo dang / dbye ba dang / sgra bshad dang / rigs nas 'khrid tshul bzhi/ dang 4 la/ bye mdo sems tsam pa'i lugs rnam grangs su 'god pa dang / rang gi lugs so/ /(1)dang po ni/ bye smras ma chags pa'i shes pa tshog shes 'phags pa'i rigs su 'dod de/mdzod las/ ma chags 'phags rigs/ zhes 〈sna/ /mdo sde bas zag med ye shes 'byung rung gi sems kyi nus pa'am sa bon la rigs su 'dod de/ rgyal sras ma las/ mdo sde pa dag gis rigs zhes bya ba 'di ni sems kyi sa bon gyi nus pa yin te/ so rtso skye 'o dang slob pa'i gnas skabs na yangasku'ongs su nyams pa'i chos can gyi sa bon la rigs zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig dbye na dgra bcom dgu'i rigs dgu yod/ sems tsam pas kun gzhi ma bzhag na 'og med nas brgyud de 'ongs pa'i nang gi skye mched drug gi steng gi zag pa med pa'i ye shes skye rung dri ma dang bral rung gi sa bon zos sogs kyis gsos ma btab pa rang bzhin gnas rigs kho na dang/'os sogs kyis gsos btab pa'i nus pade rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dang/ kun gzhi bzhag na de'i steng gi de 'dra'i rigs gnyis lasdog pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin gnas rigs khyad par bzhi ldan yin te/ grub dus kyi dang / rgyun gyi dang] thob tshul gyi dang / gdags gzhi'i khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyig dang 4 yod de/ khyod kyi rigs mwa snga ma thog ma med pa nas yod pa'i phyir/byang sa las/thog ma med pa'i dus can/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyid sems tsam pa'i lugs ladang po nyid nas rigs nges pa'i dang 4 lade rp+pa gcigadagos so/ /gnyis pa yodade/ khyod kyi rigs 'dra grub pa nas rgyun chad ma myong ba'i phyir te/ byang sa las/ de ni gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de 'ongs la/ zhesadang] mdo las/ byang chub semasadapa' rnams kyi rigasadeni thog ma med panas brgyud de 'ongs pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gsum pa yod de/ lam sgom pa sogs kyi rtsol bar ——— —— ——wawa1 bar zengasaganyisab/dang 4 la/dang sga bye smras/368
rigs/ma stos par chos nyid kyis nus pa de thob pa'i phyir te/ byang sa las/ chos nyid kyis thob pa de lta bu yin no/ /zhes dngan mdo las kyang/ chos nyid kyis thob/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir bzhi pa 〈snad de/ gdags gzhi skye mched drug gi khyad par gdags gzhir byas nas gnas 'gyur khyad par 'byung ba'i nus pa gcig rigs su 'jog pa'i phyir te/ byang sa las/ de la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i rigs ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi skye mched drug gi khyad par gang yin pa lte/zhes dang / mdo las/ skye mched drug gi khyad par gang yin pa lte/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid kun gzhi'am nang gi skye mched drug gnas 'gyur rung gi nus pa rigs yin te/ kun gzhi gnas gyur chos sku dang/nyon yid gnas gyur longs sku dang sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur sprul skur btsun pas bzhed pa'i phyid gzhan yang / rigs su 'dod pa de ltar yin te/ kun gzhi gnas gyur me long ye shes dang] chos dbyings ye shes chos sku dang /nyon yid gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes/yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur 〈snar rtogs ye shes gnyis longs sku/ dbang shes lnga gnas gyur bya grub ye shes dang sprul skur bzhed/ skye mched drug kho nas dbang du byas (1)nas yid shes gnas lha) spral lha (tā /ngaskyo shārmo rtswa pa)pa /dī lopa spras shātnanā dzño tshiming rnyi spridī spya/satsa ṭwāṃ dbyings kyi ni/ /ngo bo nyid du 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ de nyid las/nyon mongs can yid gnas gyur pa/ /nas/ yid kyi rnam shes de nyid de/ /de dag longs spyod rdzogs skur 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyig gsum pa grub ste/ de nyid las/ dbang po lnga yi rnam shes gang / /nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul sku de/ /sprul pa (2)kun gyi rgyu yin pas /zhes ———1 par zengasaganyisapa/na/2 b.razengs gnyisapa/rnams kyi/ 369
phar phyin skabs dang po/gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ de nyid las/ kha cig yid ni kho na la/ /sprul pa'i sku nyid du ni rtogs/ /dbang po lnga yi rnam shes gang/ /de yi longs athi+-id rdzogs skur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'di gser 'od dang cha tso'o/ /mdo sne rgyan gyi de yang ci rigs yod de/ gser phreng dang le brgyad mar bshad do/ /de ltar ma go bar snga phyi mang pos mun sprul byas so/ /(1)rang bzhin gyi rigasade la dbyen thos sogs kyi gsos ma btab pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs tsam dang/thos sogs kyis gsos btab pa'i rgyas 'gyur dang rang bzhin gnas rigs gnyis ka yin pa gnyis yod de/ gser phreng las/ de ni ldog pa 'gal ba yin gyi rdzas 'gal ba ni min no/ /des na rdzas la bsam na lam du zhugs nas gnyis ka yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig rigs drug ni bosna sla/gnyis pa dbu ma pa'i lugs la/ rang gi thob bya'ingo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung gi chos nyid de/rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ dang po'i sku ni dang 4 ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de rigs su 'gyur tshul yod de/ de 'dzin stangs su dmigs te bsgoms pas 'phags pa'i chos dang dri ma dang bral ba'i chos skur 'gyur bar dpe du mas bshad pa de'i phyir/ rgyud bla ma las/ yang dag mtha' ni 'du byas kyi/ /rnam pa thams cad dbeen pa ste/ /nyon mongs las dang rnam smin don/ /sprin la sogs pa bzhin du brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i (2)phyigdbye na lam la zhugs ma zhugs gnyis dang / zhugs pa la theg pa gsum gyi rigs gsum 'dzid de/ rtsabar/ rten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis/ /de yi dbye ba 〈snangs su brjod/ /ces serdzo/ /thos sogs kyis gsos btab pa'i rang gi thob bya'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung gi dngos po de/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis/ /zhes —————wawa——1 pa ra thengs gnyis ba/rigs can/2 bar zengs gnyisab/ chigaganyis pa'i/370
rigs/gsungs pa'i phyir/ dbye na/ ye shes chos skur 'gyur rung gi sems kyi nus pa dang] gzugs skur 'gyur rung gi sems kyi nus pa gnyis skyusnad de/ rgyud bla ma las/ dkon mchog gsum 4 'di yi rigs/ /thams cad gzigs pa rnams kyi yul/ /de yang rnam bzhi/ zhes dang / gser phreng las/ gnyis pa ni/ de la sbyir sems can gyi shes rgyud la yon tan skye rung zhing sgrib pa spang du rung ba'i rgyu tsam zhig rigs su 'jog pa dbu sems gnyis ka bzhed pa mthun/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rnam bshad kyang / sems can rnams kyi sems kyi steng na dri ma 'bral rung zhes serdzogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnas skabs kyi rigs gsum dang ma nges pa dang gnas skabs rigs chad du dus 'khor ṭīka chen ltar 'thad kyang / gtan nas rigs chad med par rnam bshad dang dus 'khor ṭīka chen gnyis shar bshad pa'i phyir te/thogs 'grel las kyang/rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i rigs yod pa'i phyir/ 'ga' yang gtan rnam par dag par mi 'gyur ba ni 'os pa min te/ zhes gsungs pa'i (1)phyig sgra bshad du ma yod de/ yon tan slol (lha shā /shā dī 〉ji /pa( dhī (/sdu lha lhapa rnyis sdi hūm̐ /lha /ji go/ ༷spri ṅgi gā lhan( pa spya/ (lha ṭwāṃ pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ yon tan sgrol ba'i don gyis na rigs te/ zhes 〈sna/ /gnyis pa grub zhung/ lhasna gutshi ///hākāñtsha ༵ sna ṭwāṃ nd+ra spraX ༷rsha /sna /sa//phyu/ hārsha miX ṭwāṃ dī / shā ṅgi sgra/ /ṭwāṃ /dā nd+ra /rdzu ༵༵༵ /pa ༵ kṣ+ṇā ༵ sna (skyo 〉rdzorsha ༷ /(spras/ spra/ ༵ pasag/ snro rmi pa kā rdzu rnyi bsnyi( pa las/ sprubyogs na gnas pa'i smrasag chags rnams la 〈sna ba zhes gdags te/ des na 〈sna ba skyodab par ————— 1 par thengs gnyis pa/ pyidagasum pa sgrabashad ni/ 371
phar phyin skabs dang po/byed pa'i rigs yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gyim kha cig ku la 'dir bshad pa nor ro/ /bzhi pa rigs nas nyakhrid tshul yod de/thog mar nyan sa ltar zeg pa gsum gyi sde snod bshad pas/ gang la mos pa dang dbang po rtogs par byas te/ de nas rigs sad pa'i thabs bsags sbyang dang slo grang dgos pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ rigs bsags sbyang gi khyad par du byas pa yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ tshogs chen po bsags pa dang blo sbyangs pa ma yin na skrag nas sher phyin slong ba sogs kyis nyams pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / thos pa tsam la'ang sangs rgyas la brten nas bsod nams byed dgos pa gang zhig/sher phyin nyan pa dang bsam pa'i snod rung la'ang bskal pa du mar sangs rgyas du ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bkur nyi byas pa'i rigs khyad par can dgos pa'i phyig dang po grub lte/ rtsabag sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /zhes dang / 'grel ba las/ 'das pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams la dge ba'i rtsab bskrun cing sbyangs pa/zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ rtsabag sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang] /zhes dang] nyi snang las/ mang 4 la bsnyen bkur byas pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa dang ldan pa ni len pa la 〈snags pa'i snod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyig rigs sad na lam brtan pa dang/ngan 'gror mi ltang ba sogs kyis thog mar rigs sad dgos te/ sad pa'i thabs zeg chen gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i ched du tshogs rgya chen po sogs la smon pa dang / lam skye ba'i gegs sprungang ddhi/ yakṣa nā ṭwāṃsnyisna /sbya dhri rnyi zu pa mp+raṃ kham̐ /shā ༵ rsha rtswa 3sna ḍā / sna( shā kṣiṃ sbrispri sbyiji du tshogs rgya chen po gsesnag tu 'jug pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mdo sde rgyan las kyang /— — wawa1 bar zengs gnyisapa/rtsogs ñtsha sgonas/372
rigs/sangs rgyas chos rnams rdzogs bya dang / /sems can rnam yongs smin pa dang / /myur thob bya ba 'grub pa dang / /lam rgyun mi gcod la mkhas pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa kun la/ /thabs ni mtshungs pa med pa ste/ /zhes dang]de'i 'grel pa las/ byang sems rnams kyis sa thams cad la thabs rnam pa lnga 4 'di la mkhas pa ni/ de las gzhan pa dag dang mtshungs pa med de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub lte/ rnam bshad las/ lam skye ba'i gegs kyi nyes pa sgo du ma nas legs par sbyangs na/ zhes pa nas/ theg pa chen po'i rigs la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang/rgyan gyi 'grel pa las kyang / myur du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pas sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags sesna/ /zhes bya ba nas/ bdag gis ye shes rdzogs pa'i byang chub par gyur cig ces pa'i bar de so sor bshags pa dang / rjes yi rangs pa dang] gsol ba dang / yongs su bsngo ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ de 'dra'i sems bskyed dang smon lam ni phyir ༷( spri pa'i /sna ba rnghi sna hārsha dri nā ༷ lhar tebya/tram̐ kṣiṃ /rdzu ༵ ryaṃ/'ab ༵༵ shā dzā // /rdzu sto/lha tu rtsom par mdzad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / bzang ba ste dge ba stobs can dang smon lam stobs can gyis ni rang bzhin 'dun pa gong 'phel dang / lam sogs gong 'phel gyi khyad par du 'gro ba'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ brtan pa rnams kyi smon lam ni/ /sems pa 'dun dang bcas pa ste/ /zhes dang] 'grel bag smon lam ni sems kho nas mod la 'bras bur 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / ma 'ongs pa na medod pa'i don 'grub pa'i sgyig nas/ smon lam gang byang chub sems dpa' smon lam gyi stobs can rnams rnam par brtsebade'i lus bgrang bar sla ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ de'i sgo nas don gnyis sgrub pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ sna tshogs che 373
phar phyin skabs dang po/dang byang chub bag /zhes dang/ de'i 'grel bad sna tshogs pa ni mos pa spyod pa'i sa la 'di lta 'di ltar gyur cig ces bya bsan no/ /chen po ni sa la zhugs pa'i smon lam chen po bcu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar rigs sad pa la zeg chen la lam rim ltar skyes bu gsum gyi slo sbrengang ba dang sems bskyed pa sdom pa 'dzin pa sogs yin te/ rnam bshad las/ lam gang dang gang la 'jug kyang thog mar de dang de'i rigs sad par byed pa'i thabs rnams bstan dgos pas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyi'agortsod spong la kho na re/ nyan thos kyi sems bden stong chos can/ bde gshegs snying yo yin par thal/ rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ (1)nyan thos chos can/ khyod kyi sems bden stong rang bzhin gnas rigs yin par thal/ (2)khyod sems can yin pa'i phyir/'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ nyan zos kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de brten pa'i sgo nas gnas skabs nyan 'os kyi rigs sbya/ pa( dzño shā bhee /pa shān pa shā //lha rsha shāX ༷༷ dzosna tram̐ |spri ༵ (spra smra lhashā dī hūm̐ /sna nyan thos kyi dang / zeg chen gyi rigs su brten pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyis dper na rdza bum gcig bcud gsum gyis rim bzhin sbrang rtsi'i bum pa dang i kha ra'i bum pa dang 'o ma'i bum par 'jog pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ 'grel ba las/ dper na 'jim pa gcig las mngon par grub cing me lce gcig gis so btang ba'i rten bum pa la sogs pa brten pa sbrang tsidang li kha ra la sogs pa'i snod nyid kyis tha dad pa de bzhin du brten pa'i chos zeg pa gsum gyis ——— ——1 bar zengasaganyis pa/de chos ca/khyod bdenastong]khu b.razengs gnyis pa/khyoda'atshang rgya4sa skya semasasan/374
spong gnyen/bsdus pa rtogs par bya ba tha dad pa nyid do/ /zhes bstan to/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggnyis pa ni/ rtsabar/ gnyen po dang ni spong ba dang / /de dag yongs su gtugs pa dang / /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ de'i 'og tu de dag skye ba'i stobs kyis/ nas/ rnam par rtog pa spangs pa'o/ /zhes byung / bhyor ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen mthong sgom gyi bar chad med lam bcu gcig gi de dang de skyes pa'i stobs kyis rang rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon zad pa dang de spangs zin pa dus mnyam ste/ bar chad med lam de dang de skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa dang rang rang gi spang bya 'gag pa la phyogs pa dus mnyam/ bar chad med lam skyes pa dang spang bya 'gag tsam dus mnyam pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ 'dis ni lam gnyis spu'i bar chad med lam gyi spang bya spong tshul bstan pa yin gyi sa brgyad pa'i bar chad med lam 'ba' zhig la sbyingar ba 'thad par mi sems/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyid mtha' dpyad pa la gsum las/dang ṭo la kha cig na re/ mthong spang rtog pa mngon gyur pa 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar ba gsum dang / zeg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gnyis spang gnyen mi rung ste/ kun btus las/ 'das pa dgag pa'i phyir ma (1)yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/'o na/mthong spang rtog pa mngon gyur pa spong byed kyi gnyen 4 med par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam de de ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod sa 'on dang bcas pa dang / khyod kyi rigs mwa phyi ma mtshams kyor ba spong byed kyi gnyen 4 med par thal/ khyod skya dngos gnyen med cing mthong spang rtog pa yin pa'i ya mtshan de'i phyig rtags de yod na gang dran ma yin pa bud/ 'dod mi nus te/ theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam de — —— — —1 b.razengs gnyis pa/yinan//375
phar phyinaskabs dang po/khyod sa bon dang bcas pa 'joms byed yin pas rigs 'dra phyi ma mtshams sbyongar ba spong byed yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag spong ba dang / zhes dang / mdo las/ bskal pa'i me 'bar ba'i mee 'du byed kyi gnas med cing rjes su mi dmigs/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig khyab ste/ dpe des slong gnyen bar chad med lam des de de ltar spong bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ bskal pa'i me 'bar ba'i tshe 'du byed kyi gnas med cing rjes su mi dmigs pa nyid kyi dpes bag chags kyi mtshams sbyongar ba spangs pa'i don gyis gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gzhan yang] theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam de mthong spang rtog pa thams cad spong byed ma yin par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i pyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rang rgyud kyi de thob pa chad pa'i tshul gyis dang / gzhan rgyud kyi de dmigs pa'i sgo nas slong bar gong 'og gi mkhas pa kun mthun pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ dmigs pa (1)la/ /nyon mongs pa ni spang byar 'dod/ /ces dang /de'i rang 'grel las/ rang gi rgyud la yod pa ni thob pa chad pas so/ /gzhan gyi rgyud la yod (2)pa ni nyon mongs pa dang / gzugs thams cad dang nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i chos ni de dag la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs pa rang gi rgyud la yod pa spangs pas sesna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi dus na de'i ngos skal gyi spang bya med la rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyi dus na gnas ngan len gyi dri ma yod zer ro/ /de shin tu tha chad yin par thal/ gnyen po bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi spang bya skye 'gyur gyi slong ba dbu sems rmya lugs dang / 'gag 'gyur gyi spong ba bye smra'i lugs gnyis ka gcig tu bsres pa'i mig der thal/ mthong lam bar chad med lam la skye 'gyur gyis spong ba dngaka rgyun mtha'i ——— ———— — ——— — —1 bar zengs gnyis pa/las/2 par zengs gnyis ba/pa'i nyon mongs/376
spong gnyen/bar chad med la 'gag 'gyur gyi tshul gyis spong bar khas blangs pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/dzño ༷/ ༵༵ pa/ rnyi( kā gyi lha/ sbyinā rnyi/nga ༷pa rdzu /lhag/ tsho( paX rnyi mp+raṃ kṣiṃ lhan ༷na ༵/ gzhan mang po na re/ bar chad med lam gyi dus na (1skyodas skal gyi sgrib pa yod la rnam grol lam skyes pa dang / de'i rigs 'dra phyi ma skye mi rung du byas pa skye 'gyur gyis spong ba yin zeg la (2)la na re/ bar chad med lam gyi dus na sgrib pa med la de'i rigs 'dra phyi ma skye mi rung du byas pa 'gag 'gyur gyis spong ba yin zer na/ dang po la 'o na/ spong ba'i gnyen pos (3ngos kyi sgrib pa skye 'gyur dang 'gag 'gyur gang gis spong dpyad pa ma yin par thal/ rnam grol lam la sbyar na skye 'gyur bshad pa'i phyig khyab lte/ lana'i spong ba'i gnyen 4 bar chad med lam la gong 'og gnyis nas khas len pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ dri bcas slong ba'i lam dag gi /zhes dang /rang 'grel las/ spong ba'i lam de bar chad med lam yin no/ /zhes dang / gnyen po rnam bzhi'i skabs su/ rang 'grel las/ spong ba gnyen sa ni bar chad med pa'i lam thams cad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ slong ba gnyen po'i slong tshul dpyad skabs gzhi'i gnyen 4 la sbyar ba bzhad gad yin pa'i phyid gabar 'dod mi nus te/ gnyen 4 dang ni spong ba dang / /zhes pa'i don dpyod skabs yin pa'i phyir dang / de spong ba gnyen po'i skabs yin pa'i pyir te/ nyi snang las/ mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i brten ni/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yang mi 'thad par thal/ skye 'gyur gyis slong ba'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyan snang las/ gnyen so mtha' dag rgyu ba dang 3 pathun pa3 ljogs lagag pa dag gi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gzhan yang/ slong 1 par zengs gnyis pa/dngos kyi/2 par thengasaganyis pa/lasabar chad 3 par zengs gnyis sa/dngos/
phar phyin skabs dang po/gnyen gyi 'gag 'gyur gyis spong tshul khyed ltar ma yin par thal/ bar chad med lam da ltar ba dang / 'gag bzhin pa'i dus na (1ngos kyi sgrib pa yod kyang de slong ba'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ 'gag par 'gyur ba'i lam gyis ni/ /de yi sgrib pa rab tu 〈snang / /zhes dang /de'i mtshams sbyongar gyi rang 'grel las/ gnas skabs gang gi lam gyis de skye ba'i sgrib pa spong zhe na/ 'gag par 'gyur pa'i lam gyis ni/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/yang kha cig na re/ 'di'i bar chad med lam sa brgyad pa'i yin zer na/ 'o na/ rgyan snang las/ de'i 'og tu ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mthong ba'i lam dang 〈snam pa'i lam dag gi'o/ /de'i 'og tu de dag skyes pa'i stobs kyis rkun po phyung pa dang sgo 'phar bcad pa dang 'dra ba/zhes pa'i lung don mi 'thad par thal/ mthong lam dang sgom lam de dag gsar du skyes pa'i stobs kyis ngos skal sgya spang bya kun po phyung ba dang sgo 'phar gcod pa lta bu'i bar chad med lam re med pa'i phyir te/ mthong lam gyi de med pa'i phyir te/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus shing khyab pa yang grub ste/ de'i shugs kyis mthong lam sgom lam gnyis kyang mthong sgom sbyo la byed pa dang / sa bcu'i 〈snam lam bar chad med lam grub pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ 'dis ni lam gnyis lnga'i bar chad med lam gyis/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig yang kha cigaganyen po dang spong ba'i sprispri shā tsho kṣiṃ ༈ ṭwāṃ /dī/di/ spyan snad //spra lhashā sna ṭhaṃ rshar rṇi ༷༷ sna paXrnyi shādri pasha( (lha la 'o na/ gnyen 4 dang ni spong ba dang / /zhes gnyis smos pa dang] nyi snang las/ gnyen po dang ni spong ba gnyis kyi rten gang yin zhe na/ zhes dang] mdo las kyang]nyi ma'i dkyil lha'or dang bskal ba'i me'i dpe gnyis so sor bkod pa rnams mi 'thad par thal/ de spong ba'i gnyen po byed tshul — — —— — — —1 bar zengs gnyisab/dngos/378
spong gnyen/gcig pu las bshad rgyu med pa'i phyis khyab ste/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam lta bu des gnyen po tsam byed pa dang spong ba'i gnyin 4 byed tshul la khyad chen po yod pa'i phyig der thal/ des sgom spang bden 'edzin lhan skyes kyi yang gnyen po tsam byed pa gang zhig /des spong ba'i gnyen ṭo mi byed pa'i pyid dang 4 grub ste/ bden 'dzin lhan skyes dang theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gnyis lhan cig mi gnas 'gal yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam 'grel las/gnod bya gnod byed ngo bo'i phyis /sogs dang / mdo las/ nyi ma'i dkyil gshor shar ba'i 'od la mun pa'i gnas med cing / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de'i byed pa ma nyams bar du bden 'dzin lhan skyes mngon gyur mi skye yang byed pa nyams na 'byung ba ni nyi 'od kyis khyab pa la mun pa med pa 〈snags kyi dpe yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ gnyen po'i rten ni nyi ma'i dkyil lubog zhes so/ /khyab ste/ de de la zur du sbyar ba'idagos pa yod pa'i phyir te/ le brgyad ma las/rab 'phyor 'di lta ste dper na nyi ma'i dkyil dngog nas/ zhes bya ba ni gnyen po'i phyogs rmya rten yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub lte/ spong ba'i gnyen 4 byas na slar mi skye bas khyab pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs slong ba'i rten ni bskal ba'i me 'bar ba'i tshe 'du byed kyi gnas (1)med cing /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ bskal ba'i mes bsreg bya lhag med dang skye mi rung (2)byas pa'i phyir dang] zur du sbyar ba'i phyir te/ le brgyad ma las/ rab 'phyor 'di lta ste bskal pa'i me 'bar ba'i tshe/ nas/ zhes bya ba ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong ba'i rten yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig /rang lugs la/ slong ba'i gnyen pos ngos skal gyi spang bya spong tshul yod de/ gnyen po bar 1 parazengs gnyis ba/med/ces gsungs pa'i 3mabaskal ba'i/2 parathengasaganyis pa/sbyaraba'i/ 379
phar phyin skabs dang po/chad med lam skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa dang / rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa dus mnyam/ bar chad med lam skyes zin pa dang rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya 'gag zin pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ snang ba dang mun pa bzhin/ kun btus las/ gnas ngan len gyi rnam pa gang gi gnyen po'i rnam pa gang yin pa dang gnas ngan len gyi rnam pa skyes pa dang 'gag pa mnyam pa lte/ dper na snang bdang mun padag 'byung ba dang 'gag pa mnyam pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid bar chad med lam gyi dus su ngos skal gyi spang bya med cing skye bar mi rung ba'i chos can yin te/ de skye ba'i rkyen ma tshang bas skye mi rung yin kyang so sor brtags lasag gis skye mi rung da dung ma thob pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ bar chad med lam gyi dus na rang gi ngos skal gyi spang byade med cing skye bar mi rung ba'i chos can yin yang/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyig des na rgyun mtha'i dus na dri ma med kyang gnyen po bar chad med lam gyis zad pa dang spangs pa gang rung min te/ dngos gnyen gyi lag rjes rdzogs par bzhag ste skye mi rung ba'i chos can du byas pa'i lam ma thob pa'i phyig der thal/ dngos gnyen bar chad med lam gyi dus yin pa'i pyid ma khyab na/ rgyu 'bras dus mnyam par thal/ bar chad med lam dang de'i lag rjes kyi drangs pa'i lam dus mnyam du grub pa'i gyid (1)rtags khas/ khyab lte/ rnam bshad las/ rtags ma grub na/ rgyu 'bras dus mnyam par thal bas then/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig des na bar chad med lam gyis rang gi ngos skal gyi dus gsum gyi sgrib pa dregags thams cad spong tshul mi gcig kyang spong bar byed de/ rang gi ngos skal gyi de rang dus na 'das zin bum pa bcom pa ltar mi byed kyang sa 'onadangadamigs pa ci rigs kyis slongaka rang gingos skal gyi de rang dus na ma skyes pa mdun —— ——— —— —1 parazengasaganyis pa/rtags khas/rnam bshad/380
