tshogs sgrub/bskyed pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam smin gyi de bshad zin cing / khyab ste/goms byang gnyis med pa'i ming tshig tshad med thos pa kho nas 'dzin pa'i dran pa shes rab bshad pa'i phyir te/ goms shing kha thon byang bar ma byas/ zhes dang / thos pa tsam kho na'i don yod pa'i phyid gong gi rtags zur gnyis pa grub lte/ byang sa las/ don gyi gzungs gang zhe na/ snga ma dang 'dra ba las de'i khyad par 'di yod de/ chos de dag nyid kyis don tshad med pa dag goms shing yid kyis byang bar ma byas bar dus tshad med pa dag tu 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/②rtags gsum pa grub ste/ rgyan gyi 'grel ba las/ de la gzungs ni sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / mthong ba'i chos la rab tu thob pas len pa dang 'dzin par nus pa'i khyad par gyi sgo nas zos pa las goms pa dang ting nge 'dzin la brten nas rnam pa gsum mo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig ②rtags bzhi pa grub ste/ gser phreng las/ tshe 'dir ched du ma btsal kyang skye ba snga mar sbyangs pa'i rnam smin gyis thob pa dang / 'dir thos bsam la 'bad pas tshos skya tshig don du ma myur bar 'dzin nus pa dang / sgom byung gi ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis 'odzin par nus pa'i gzungs gsum las/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig de la kho na re/ 'o na/ rnam bshad las/ phyi ma gnyis ni chos rnams kyi tshig dang don bskal pa'i bar du mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'o/ /de yang bzod pa thob pa yan chad rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ tshig don gyi gzungs bhyor lam bzod pa man chad nas mi 'jog pa'i pyir na ma khyab/ tshig don gyi gzungs yin na bskal pa'i bar du mi brjed pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyis rnam bshad kyi don 'chad tshul 'thad pa'i pyid 'dod na/ bzod pa yan chad nas lam rnams rgyun chags su 'jug par khas len rung bar thal/ khyod kyis gzungs bskal pa'i bar du skye ba du ma blangs kyang mi brjed pas khyab pa'i phyis khyab ste/ tshe rabs dran pa'i mngon shes kyangade ltar skye dgos pas sngar bkag zin 427
phar phyinaskabs dang po/pa sogs kyis gnod pa'i pyir te/ rtsabag de nas rgyun chags yin pa'i pyig /zhes gsungs ba sogs du ma dang 'gal lo/ /gzhan yang / khyod kyi de mi 'thad par thal/ rnam bshad kyi de tshogs sgrub kyi gzungs kyi bshad pa gang zhig /gzungs spyi'i bshad tshul rgyan dang byang sa gnod lasdoms gser phreng sogs ltar dgos pa'i sgyig dang po grub lte/ rnam bshad las/ tshig la sogs pa'i gzungs kyi tshogs thob ste/ de la gzungs kyi ngo ṭo/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyiradang/ bzod pa la sbyar ba bzod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gzungs bzhi tsam bshad par shin tu gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ rnam smin dang zos pa la goms pa'i gzungs tsam ni lam du ma zhugs pa na'ang yod pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ rnam smin dang thos pa la goms pa ni lam du ma zhugs pa na'ang yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rtsabar yangan sangs rgyas bsten dang kun tsho dang] /sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod pa/ /len dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i/ /snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rigs pa rnam smin la gyor rgyu yin pa'i phyir dang / tshogs lam chen po'i chesnas rgyun skabs su yang] rgyan las/ sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la/ /zhes sem/ /rang lugs la/ gzungs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ bskyed pa'i rgyu/ byed las/ sa mtshams dang lnga/ dang po ni/ rnam smin dang thos gom ci rigs kyi stobs kyis dran pa dang shes rab khyad par 'phags pa thob pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i shes pa de/ gzungs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ 'khor dang bcas na sems dang sems byung gzhan yod kyang gtso 4 dran pa shes rab gnyis ka khyad par 'phags pa tshang dgos pa'i phyir te/ rgyan snang las/ gzungs kyi rang bzhin ni dran pa dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin te/ dran pa dang shes rab khyad par can gzungs zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ rnam smin gyis thob pa'i gzungs dang / thos bsam 428
tshogs sgrub/goms pas thob pa'i gzungs dang / sgom byung gi ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i gzungs gsum dang /sgom byung la mos spyod pa'i de chung ngu dang/ ma dag sa bdun gyi de 'bring dngan dag sa'i de chen po yin pa'i phyig rgyan las/ chen po shādo yang rnam pa gsum/ /zhes theg/ /dmigs yul gyi dbye na bzod pa'i de/ chos kyi de/don gyi de/ sngags kyi gzungs bzhi yod de/ thub dgongs las/ de yang dran pa shes rab kyi rang bzhin gyi bzhi rnams te/ bzod pa'i gzungs dang/ chos kyi gzungs dang /don gyi gzungs dang] sngags kyi gzungs so/ /zhes rtso/ /a ra ba tsa na la sogs pa yi ge zhe gnyis re re'idon yangadonadam par skye ba med pa sogs ston pa la goms pas stong nyid la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs ldan gyi dran pa dang shes rab kyi cha nas bzhag pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes de/ byang sems kyi sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i bzod pa'i gzungs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ rnam bshad las/ a ra pa tsa na la serdzogs pa'i yi ge zhe gnyis kyi don la dpyad nas/ zhes dang/ thub dgongs las/ a ra pa tsa na la serdzogs pa'i yi ge rnams la de'i don (1)de bzhin nyid du sgro btags nas/ sgom par byed pa rnams kyis goms pa yongs su rdzogs pa na/ yi ge de'i don don dam pa bzod pa skye ba de bzod pa'i gzungs te shes rab kyi bzod pa 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid byang sems kyis de lta bu'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i bzod pa'i mthus zhi sdu gas kyi sngags kyi tshig rtsome dusade ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i snying shā (ji] yishā ghnā ༷pa (snyo pa paswā kti dī ༵ /spra pa'i kṣiṃ shā cha ṭwāṃ sna ༵༵ ༵ ༷༷/ sna/ ༵༵ tram̐/ rnam bshad las/ de'i stobs kyis sdig pa zhi ba la sogs pa/ zhesadang] thubadagongs las/ byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin la dbang ba nyid kyis sngags kyi yi ge rnams pyin gyis brlabs — — — ———1 bar zengs ges ba/de nyid sa 429
phar phyin skabs dang po/te/ zhes dang] de byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes ni sngags kyi gzungs gleng/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid ṇḍa ting nge 7ngon gyi dbang du byas la sgyir ting nge 7rin dang smon lam gyi mthus byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyi gzungs gnyis yod de/ gser phreng las/ ting nge 'odzin dang smon lam dzño (spya pa ñtsā snyi kau ༵༵༵༵ dī /pa ༵ snashā gā nywa two dzosna lhanyi dī ༵ rsha gasdu ryaṃ spya/ /sna gnyis re re la gzungs sngags re yod pa'i phyir te/ thub dgongs las/ pyi mo'i yi ge rnams ji snyed pa de snyed kyi gzungs kyi sgo rnams sesna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid'di'i sngags la gsum 〈snad de/ gzungs sngags dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags gsum yod pa'i phyis der thal/ de yang thabs shes kyis yid skyob pas ngan 'gro sogs las 'odzin pas gzungs dang / ma rig pa spong shing rig pa bskyed pas rig sngags dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi gsang ba ston par byed pas gsang sngags zhes bshad pa'i phyig dang po grub ste/ mand+ra'i byings las de ltar thon pa'i pyir te/ thub dgongs las/ gzhan yang ma na shes pa la'o/ /(13nya skyob pa la'o/ /zhes pa ye shes dang snying rje ni sngags kyi sgras brjod par bya la/ de dag gi rgyu mthun pa nyid kyis yi ge de rnams la sngags su brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/rtog ge 'bar ba las/ gzungs sngags ni sgom pa'i rnam pa nyid yin te/ji skad du/ sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs las/ gzungs de sgom par byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi tshos rtogs par yang mi byed/ len par yang mi byed/ gnas par yang mi byed/ mngon par zhen par yang mi byed/ tha snyad de 'dogs par yang mi byed de/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 'ba' zhig sgom par byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid1 pa ra zengs gnyisapa/trika430
43gas sgrub/khyab ste/des kun rdzob sogs kyi 'dus byas sogs yid la mi byed par de kho na nyid khong du chud pa'i sangs rgyas sgom par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa grub lte/ rtog ge 'bar ba las 'di skad brjod par yang nus te/ gzungs sngags dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i man ngag bzhin du brjod pa dang] bsam pa dang/ sgom pas sdig pa rgyu dang bcas pa zhi bar byed pa yin te/ lam dang rjes su mthun pa yin pa'i pyid mdo sde la 〈snags pa'i gsung rab bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir bzhi pa grub lte/ phyin drug bden bzhi themags rtogs pa'i du ma yod pa'i phyir te/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ rig sngags kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang]'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos ston par byed pa'i yi ge dang]don gyi nyon mongs pa zad par byed pa ston par byed pa nyid yin te/ zhes dang/ thubadagongs las/ ma rig pa spong bar byed pa nyid kyi phyir dang rig pa skyed par byed pa'i phyig de rnams rig sngags 〈sna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig lnga pa grub ste/ de nus pa chen 4 can du byin gyis brlabs pa'i pyig dpag bsam gyi shing bzhin no/ /rtog ge 'bar ba las/ de bzhin du gsang sngags kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi gsang ba ston par byed pa'i sbas pa'i yi ge sbyar ba ngo 'os (( ༵ ༵ ༵ ༵ / stapa ༵ ñtsā ryaṃ pa/lha rnyipa hūm̐ sna hūm̐ (sbyinā rnyi'i ((lha dī ༵༵ shārnyi ༷dī lha( no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigasher snying gidon yang de ltar dgos kyang 'od ṭīkadag gis ma thon no/ /tingange 'dzin gyi mchus sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bshad pa'i chos kyi phung po chen po 'os tsam gyis 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa dang shes rab kyi cha nas bzhag pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de/byang sems kyi ting nge ladzin las byung ba'i chos kyi gzungs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ thubadagongs las/ de nas phyongags bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bstan ba'i 431
phar phyin skabs dang po/phung 4 'dzin pa'i rgyu ni gzungs te/ dpag tu med pa'i chos rnams thos tsam gyis mtha' med pa'i dus su 'odzin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyigating nge 7rin gyi mthus de ltar de dag gi don 'dzin nus pa sogs snga ma lta bu'i sems dpa'i ye shes de/ byang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'idon gyi gzungs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ thub pa dgongs rgyan las/ de nas de bzhin du de'i don 'dzin pa'i rgyu ni don gyi gzungs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gzhan yangan sa bcu la gzungs bcu dang / sa re re la'ang mtha' yas pa thob lte/ dgongs rgyan las/ de bzhin du yang sa so so la gzungs re re sngon du 'gro ba'i gzungs stong phrag grangs med cing] dpag tu med pa du ma rnams so sor thob 4/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gsum pa de dag bskyed pa'i rgyu yod de/ phyi'i spyod lam dang nang gi ting nge 'edzin gnyis tshogs dgos pa'i phyir/ gdod pa thob pa la chags zhen med pa dngan ma thob pa la phrag dog dang re ba med pa dang]bslangs pa ster ba dang / byang sems kyi sde snod dang sde snod kyi ma mo la shin tu dga' zhing brtson pa bzhi med mi rung dang] bzod pa'i gzungs la de las kyang lus ngag bag ldan dgos pa'i phyigdang po grub ste/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na gzungs 'de dag thob ste/ gang yang rung ba ma tshang bas ni ma yin no/ /zhes 〈sna/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa thob par byed pa'i gzungs gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid kyi rgyu la shin tu spyad pa shes rab dang ldan pa dbeen par gnas shing tshig kyang mi smra la/su dang yang mi 'phrad cing] de bzhin du ran par za ba dang] bab col du mi za ba dang] kha zas sna gcig za ba dang / sems pa lhur len byed pa dang / mtshan mo yun thung ngu nyal zhing yun ring du mi nyal ba ni/ zhes gsungs pa'i nyid bzhi pa byed las yod de/ gzhan la tshad med pa rgyas par ston cing rang gi mi brjed par gong du 'phel ba sogs yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ byang chub 432

phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ stong nyid mngon sung du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis rin pa'i zeg chen gyi mngon rtogs de lam shes kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon song gi byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i tshogs lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyig der thal/ de yod pa'i pyid 'dod na/ theg chen 'phags lam yin par thal/ lam shes yin pa'i phyid 'dod mi nus lte/ theg chen gyi 'phags lam thob dgos yin pa'i phyig der thal/ byang sems tshogs lam pa yin pa'i 3ga de la kho na re/ lam shes la theg chen 'phags lam gyis ma khyab par thal/ byang sems kyi lam rnams lam shes yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yum gsum gnod 'joms kyis de ltar bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ gnod 'joms las/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya ba ni 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i dang po sems bskyed pa nas mos pa'i spyod pa'i sa nas bzung nye/ chos kyi sprin la thug gi bar du zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gser rlung las kyang] 'di'i lugs tsam bshad do/ /rtsabar 'dod na/ mkhyen gsum 'phags lam ma yin par thal/ gzhi shes lam shes la tshogs lam se gas 〈snad pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ de gsum gang rung rgyud ldan gyi so skye med pa'i mig nyi snang las/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang du mdzad nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan nye bar lasad pa gron du 'gro bas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyigyang kha cig na re/ skabs gnyis pa 'der lam shes dang 4 gnyis dang de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bsnyan nas/ lam shes gsum ga'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun mi ston pa mi 'thad par thal/lam shes gsum ga'i rgyu sogs tshang bar ston dgos pa'i phyir zhe na skyon med par thal/ skabs dang por bshad zin pa'i phyid byas pa la kho na re/ 'o na/ theg chen gyi mthong sgom gyi lam gnyis 448
mtshams sbyar/'dir ston mi dgos par thal/ dang por rab dga' sogs sa bcu bshad pa der byang sems kyi mthong lam sogs bshad pa'i phyir zhe na de'i skyon yang med par thal/ dang por sems bskyed sogs chos bcu rnam mkhyen gyi yul du bshad pas de rtogs kyi mkhyen pa mthar zug rnam mkhyen du go yang de'i rgyur mi shes pa'i phyid dang 4 grub ste/ desadeng dus gaga' zhig ltar rnam mkhyen gyis thams cad mi mkhyen snyam pa'i log rtog sel ba'i phyis 'grel chen las/ (1)rgyudang 'bras bu nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen ba nyid ces brjod pa yin pas/zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub lte/ rnam mkhyen der bgrod pa'i lam rnams de skabs su ma gsungs snyam pa'i 'ordzog rtog sel ba'i phyig 'grel chen las/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi lam ni de las gsungs pa ma yin no zhes dogs pa bsal ba'i phyis zhes so/ / de la kho na re/ rnam mkhyen thob pa la zeg pa gsum gyi lam shes rdzogs par sgom mi dgos par thal/ de thob ba la gnas lugs gcig su sgom pas chog snyam pa dang] de la skyabs 'phro tsam gyis kyang chog snyam padang/ byang sems kyi lha'or bar skye ba lenadagos pas skyo ba mi mdzes nyan thos la mdzes snyam pa'i log rtog rnams yod pa'i phyir zer na/ dang yo mi 'thad par thal/ thabs shes gnyis tshang bar grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsags dgos pa'i pyig der thal/ de ltar bye mdo dbu sems kun mthun pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas/ /'byung ngo / /zhes dang / nyan thos sde ba'i mdo las/ pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams mngon gyur pa/ /zhes dang / theg chen gyi mdo las/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab ni 'ching ba/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa yang mi 'thad par thal/ shes rab sogs phar phyin drug ma tshang bar sangs rgyas pa med pa'i phyis der thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid pa shes —— wawa— — — —1 par zengs gnyis pa/ rgyu dang 'bras buganyisal sa/ 449

phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang] der gyur pa'i nyer len rigs sad pa dang/ der gyur pa'i pa'or ba mi 'dor ba'i rang bzhin dang] der gyur pa'i byed las dang lnga yod/ sa mtshams byang sems kyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod de/ byang sems kho na la bshad pa'i sgyiganyi snang las/ yul so sor nges pa ni/ ji skad gu byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa la ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa dang ston pa'i skal ba med pa nyid kyis na lam shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' kho na'i yin gyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ de lam shes kyi yan lag la dgongs pa'i pyidrtsod pa spong ba la kho na re/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ sems dpa'i yon tan yin par thal/lam shes kyi yan lag yin pa'i pyid der thal/ lam shes kyi rgyu 'bras ngo bo'i chos gsum gang ndha dī sprapa two sdidī dīhā/ dī ṭwāṃ shā kṣiṃ 'i ste phyi// ṭwāṃ/dīsna pa/ (sna kṣiṃ rnyiX pa dri shezlor dzi ༵ nd+ra pa/ pa'i phyir dang / don bdun cu rin chen phreng ba las/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i lam shes kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ lam shes skye ba'i gegs mngon pa'i nga rgyal mngon gyur dang bral ba sogs lam shes rdzogs byed kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi yon tan no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kho na re/ de de yin par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na lam shes kyi yan lag yod pa'i phyig der thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na yan lag can gyi lam shes yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ kho na re/ lam zhugs kyi theg chen gyi rigs sad pa :snas can/ lam shes kyi yan lag yin par thal/ de'i yan lag gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gsum par gyur pa'i de yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus lte/ byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa'i dgra bcom pa la yang lam shes kyi yan lag med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems bskyed pa na snod rung du mdo 454

phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/gnyis pa zeg pa gsum du 'dod pa ni/ sems tsam pa na re/ mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub pa yin te/ zhi ba bgrod pa gcig pu ba'i nyan rang dgra bcom 'tshang rgya mi srid pa gang zhigbyang chub tu yongs su 'gyur ba'i nyan rang dgra bcom pa 'tshang rgya ba yang yin la/ gtan nas yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos can yang yod pa'i phyir/ rtags dang 4 grub ste/ de dag snying rje chung ba dngaka dngor bas 'jigs pa/ rigs dman pa gsum gyis 'tshang rgya mi nus pa'i pyid dgongs 'grel las/ zhi ba bgrod pa gcig pu ba ni sangs rgyas thams cad brtson pa dang ldan par gyur kyang byang chub kyi snying po la bzhag lte bla med byang chub thob par mi nus so/ /de ci'i spras sbyo/sa/ kham̐ ༵ kto shā spra ji ṭwāṃ hūm̐ nā oṃ snashā na da tsho ( phyu spriX ༵༵nga ༷༷ hāsnyi tt+waṃ shā/pa gnyis pa grub ste/ dgongs 'grel las/ nyan thos byang chub tu yongs su 'gyur ba gang yin pa de ni ngas rnam grangs kyi byang chub sems dpar bstan te/ 'di ltar de ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa las rnam par grerdzol nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bskul na shes bya'i sgrib pa las sems rnam par grol bar byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis rtags gsum pa grub lte/ mdo las/ log sred can gtan nas yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos can no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiskhyab lte/ de sgra ji bzhin par rang lugs su byed pa'i mig rnam bshad las/ lugs 'di la ni gtan nas yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos can bshad pa yang rang lugs su mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs ba'i pyig des na mthar zug theg pa gcig tu bshad pa yang drang don yin pa'i phyir te/ dgongs gzhi bdun la dgongs nas mthar zug theg pa gcig tu bshad pa'i phyigdgongs gzhi bdunawenadade/zeg pa gsum gyi chos dbyingasanam mkha' ltar gcig padang/zeg pa gsum gyi gang zag rnams bdag med rtogs par mtshungs pa dang/ sdug bsngal kun spangs pa'i 458
theg pa gsum dang gcig la dpyad pa/rnam grol rnams mtshungs pa dngad ma nges pa'i rigs can gyi nyan thos rnams theg chen du zhugs nas 'tshang rgya bas rigs tha dad pa gnyis kyang lam gcig tu zhugs pa dang] de bzhin gshegs pas bdag gis sngon byang sems kyi spyodzid pa spyad pas sangs rgyas so/ /zhes gsungs pa na byang sems nyan thos lam la zhugs pa 'ga' zhig la yang bdag gis kyang gron byang sems kyi sbyod pa spyad pas bdag kyang 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i bsam pa mtshungs pa thang gcig tsam skye ba dang / sprul pa'i nyan thos 'ga' zhig nyan thos kyi theg pas mya ngan las 'da' tshul lan du mar ston pa dang /theg pa gsum gyi mchog theg chen yin pa dang bdun la dgongs pa'i pyid mdo sde rgyan las/ chos dang bdag med rnam krol rnams/ /mtshungs phyir rigs ni tha dad nyid /bsam gnyis thob pyir sprul ba'i pyid /mthar thug phyir na theg gcig nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/mthar zug theg pa gcig tu bstan pa'i darbardzos pa 〈snad de/ nyan thos ma nges pa kha cig theg chen la drangs pa dang / gzhan theg chen rigs can gyi byang sems theg chen las mi ldog par rjes su bzung ba'i ched yin pa'i sgyid mdo sde rgyan las/ kha cigadag ni drangs phyiradang/ /gzhan dag rjes su gzung ba'i pyid /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /ma nges rnams la theg gcig bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid dngos zin la gnod byed yod de/ lung rigs gnyis kyis gnod pa'i pyid dgongs 'grel gyi lung dang / gzhan dbang yongs grub bden grub tu sgrub pa'i rigs pas gnod pa'i pyig de ltar medod mkhan yod de/ sems tsam pa theg pa sna tshogs te gsum du smra ba rnamasade yin pa'i nyid rgyan snang las/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi zhal snga nas dang de'i gzhung gi rjes su 'brang ba theg pa sna tshogs su smra ba rnams ni gzhan du 'chad de/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid gsum pa ni/ kha cig na re/ rong〉kasems can thams cad 'tshang rgya nges su lta zhog 'tshang rgya rung tsam yang min zer na/ sgrib pa thams cad gnyen pos 'joms rung ma yin 459
phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/par thal/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya rung tsam yang ma yin pa'i pyig rtags khas/ 'dod na/dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin la zhugs nas 'bral mi rung bar thal/ gnyen pos gzhom mi rung ba'i sgrib pa yod pa'i phyis rtags khas/ pangor gsum/ 'dod mi nus te/ sgrib pa sems kyi rang bzhin la ma zhugs pas sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba dang dri ma slo bur ba sbrin lta bu yin pa'i phyis dzabur gsum/ rnam 'grel las/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal te/ /dri ma rnams ni slo bur ba/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig kha cig na re/ rong3kasems can thams cad 'tshang rgya nges lta zhog 'tshang rgya rung yang sgrub mi nus te/ sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi rgyu tshang na thar lam la ma zhugs pa'i sems can mi srid par thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer na/'o na/ 'bras bu skye rung yin na rgyu'i tshogs pa tshang bas khyab par thal/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya rung yin na sems can thams cad la sangs rgya ba'i rgyu'i tshogs pa tshang bas khyab pa'i phyigrtags khas/ lha'or gsum/ 'dod na/ bang mdzod kyi nas skam yar ba chos can/ nas kyi myu gu skye ba'i rgyu tshogs tshang bar thal/ nas kyi myu gu skye rung yin pa'i phyis gangor gsum/ rtags khas/der thal/ nas kyi sa 'on yin pa'i phyig khyab ste/ sa 'on gyi don yod pa'i pyid gong du medod na/de chos can/ rlan zhing gsher ba dang ldan par thal lo/ /'dod na/ chos can de ma yin par thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te/ rgyu'i tshogs pa tshang na 'bras bu skye rung gis khyab pa rigs pa'i dbang phyug bzhed kyang skye rung la rgyu tshogs tshang mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ rgyu tshogs pa las 'bras skye ba/ /rjes su dpog pa gang yin te/ /don gzhan la ni mi stos phyig /de ni rang bzhin yin par brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i sgyid kha cig rang ṭīka sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya yang / sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pa mi srid zer na/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pa srid par thal/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pa'i dus yod pa'i sgyig der thal/460
theg pa gsum dang gcig la dpyad pa/sems can thams cad rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam nam thob pa na 'tshang rgya ba'i phyig lugar gsum/ byas pa la kho na re/ dngos so thams cad med pa srid par thal/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pa srid pa'i phyis gdod na/ ṇḍa tshun du dngos po yod la ṇḍa phan chad du dngos 4 mi srid pa'i dus kyi yin pa 'dzin thub par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na shin tu ma khyab ste/ de 'dra'i dus kyi yin pa med pa'i pyida'o na/ 'di tshun chad du sngon 4 yod la 'do phan chad du sngon po med pa'i dus yin pa 'grog rigs par thal/ gron 4 zhig pa srid pa'i phyig khyab pa khas/ rtags ma grub na/ de chos can/ rtag dngos yin par thal/ rang rgyu las skyes kyang zhig pa mi srid pa'i phyigrtags khas/ gshor gsum/yang kha cig na re/ sems can thams cad chos can/ 'tshang rgya ba la 'gal rkyen gyi gegs med par thal/ khyod 'tshang rgya nges yin pa'i phyir zer na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma'i 'grel ba las/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i rigs yod pa'i phyig 'ga' yang rnam par dag par mi 'gyur ba ni 'os ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyida'o na/ byang sems sa brgyad pa ba chos can/ khyod 'tshang rgya ba la 'gal rkyen gyi gegs med par thal/ khyod 'tshang rgya nges yin pa'i phyiskhyab pa khas/ lha'or gsum/ der thal/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa'i byang 'phags yod pa'i phyig'dod mi nus te/ 'tshang rgya ba la shes sgrib kyi gegs dang bcas shing de spong dgos yin pa'i phyig gzhan yang / bum pa yod nges ma yin par thal/ bum pa 〈snad pa la 'gal rkyen gyi gegs srid pa'i phyig dngor gsum/ rtags grub lte/ de yod pa 7)ga pa'i tho ba sogs yod pa'i sgyid'dod mi nus te/ bum pa yod pa tshad mas grub pa'i nyid gzhan yang/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya nges yin par thal/ sgrib bcas kyi sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya nges yin pa'i phyid461
phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/der thal/ de dag gi rgyud kyi sgrib pa rtag pa yin pas spangs mi rung ba yang ma yin/ mi rtag pa yin yang slong byed kyi thabs med pa yang ma yin/ gnyen po yod kyang shes mkhan med pa yang ma yin/ shes mkhan yod kyang ston pa mi srid pa yang ma yin/ gdul bya la don gnyer mi srid pa yang ma yin pa'i phyig de skad du rnam 'grel las/ rtag nyid phyir ram thabs med phyig /yang na thabs ni mi shes phyid /skyon rnams mi zad pa nyid ces/ /bya bar yongs su rtogs grang na/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid rtags dang po grub ste/dedag gi rgyud kyi sgrib pa'i rgyu yo da pas mi rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ rnam 'grel 'a/sa/ rgyu yod phyir dang / zhes so/ /rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ rgyu bdag 'dzin gnyis kyi gnyen so goms pas zad par byed pa'i pyid rnam 'grel las/ rgyu yi ni/ /gnyen 4 goms pas zad phyir dngad /zhes so/ /rtags gsum pa grub ste/ chos thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde gshegs yod pa'i phyig rnam 'grel las/ de shes pa yang grub pa yin/ /zhes so/ /rtags bzhi pa grub ste/ ston pas thugs brtsebs gzhan la thabs phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i phyisrnam 'grel las/ zugs ba〉ldan phyir rtsom kun yang / /gzhan gyi don du bhyor phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /rtags lnga pa grub ste/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus de ltar don du gnyer ba 'byung ba'i phyis spyod 'jug las/ de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig ltan bsod nams slo gros thang 'ga' 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir ro/ /yang kho na re/ rong mngon pa'i nga rgyal bcom pa'i rgyud kho na sems bskyed dang lam shes skye rung yin par thal/ khyod kyis rnam bshad las/ phyis kyang mngon pa'i nga rgyal bcom pa'i rgyud kho na las sems bskyed dang lam shes kyi rtogs pa skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de skye dus de 'dra dgos par bshad pa'i phyir/ 'grel chen las kyang / mog mog por mdzad ba ni mngon pa'i nga rgyal bcom pa'i rgyud kho na la rtogs pa skye'o zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir 462
'khor ba la mtha' yod med dpyad pa/mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gabar 'dod na/ lam shes skye rung gi sems can yin na lam shes rang rgyud la skye dus kyi sems can yin pas khyab par thal/ lam shes rang rgyud la skye dus kyi sems can la mngon pa'i nga rgyal bcom pa mi dgos pa'i phyid rtags khyab khas/ dngor gsum/ ma grub na/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal bcom pa kho na'i rgyud la skye bar thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyislhangor gsum/ gong du 'dod na/ ngan 'phyo ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig dngor gsum/ rtags grub nye/ lam ma zhugs kyi sems can yin pa'i phyig khyab ste/ 'grel ba 'di las kyang / skye bo thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthar zug pa can yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i 9ga 'dod na/ 'phags pa dang ngan 'gro ba'i gzhi mthun yod par thal/ lam shes rang rgyud la skye dus kyi gis 'gro ba yod pa'i phyis 'dod mi nus te/ mdzod las/ bzod thob 4na song yongs mi lhung] /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis de sogs kyi rigs pa du ma spro la/ lhag med pa la rnam shes med par 'dod pa 'og tu 'gog par bya'o/ /gsum pa gshor ba la mtha' yod med dpyad pa la/ gshor ba la thog ma'i mtha' yod na rgyu med las skye dgos pas thog ma'i mtha' med kyang pyi mtha' yod de/ mdo las/ 'og med gyur kyang tha ma dang ldan pa/ /zhes dang / 'grel ba 'do nyid las kyang] skye bo thams cad bla na med pa/zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ gagor ba la phyi mtha' yang med par thal/'khor ba thog ma dang tha ma med pa yin pa'i pyir/ der thal/ de rbog ma dang tha ma med pa'i stong nyid kyi stong gzhi chos can yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na/ dbang rten khog pa chos can/ pyi nang gnyis ka yin par thal/ phyi nang gnyis ka stong nyid kyi stong gzhi chos can yin pa'i phyis khyab pa khas/ dus gsum chos can/ mi dmigs pa yin par thal/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi 463
phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/stong gzhi chos can yin pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ tshad ma'i dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / 'khor ba'i thog mtha' med kyang phyi mtha' yod par thal/ de la thog mtha' med kyang phyi mtha' yod pa sa bon bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sa bon gyi 'og ma'i mtha' dang sa bon gyi rgyu'i 'og ma yod pa ma yin kyang tha ma'i mtha' skyed pa'i rgyu ma tshang ba mthong ba yod pa bzhin du gangor ba yang yin pa'i phyir te/ sa 'on mer bsregs pa'i mtha' mthong ba bzhin lha'or ba skyed pa'i las nyon zad pas lha'or ba'i mtha' yod par grub pa'i phyid bzhi brgya ba las/ ji ltar sa 'on mtha' mthong zhing / /de la thog ma yod min ltar/ /de bzhin rgyu ni ma tshang pyid /skye ba'ang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig gshor ba la thog mtha' gnyis gang yang med par 'dod pa mi 'thad par thal/ mdo las/'khor ba la mtha' yod med kyi phyogs gnyis ka gsungs shing rjes 'brang rnams kyis kyang phyogs gnyis bshad pa gang zhig /thog mtha' med la tha ma'i mtha' 〈snad pa lung rigs kyis grub pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ 'grel chen las lubor ba mtha' med sngar bkod nas mtha' yod kyi lugs phyis bkod pas phyi mas snga ma don gyis bkag cing phyi ma la dngos shugs gang du yang dgag pa mi 'byung ba'i phyid 'grel chen las/ kha cig na re/ gang 'di sangs rgyas kyi rigs 'di thog ma med pa yin pa'am/ sangs rgyas re re byung ba na sems can grangs med pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' mod kyi/ de ltar na'ang lnga'or ba la zad pa med pas mtha' yas pa'i pyir nam mkha' dang 'dra ste/ zhes pa nas/ gzhan dag na re/ gang gnyen po'i chos dang phrad pa na 'bri ba'i chos can du snang ba de ni gnyen po'i phyogs shin tu 'phel ba na shin tu 'grib par 'gyur ba srid pa yin te/ dper na gser gyi dri ma la sogs pa bzhin no/ /lubor ba yang bdag med pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi gnyen po'i phyogs mngon du gyur pa na 'grib pa'i chos can 464
'khor ba la mtha' yod med dpyad pa/yin no zhes bya ba'i rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs kyi stobs kyis gangor ba rgyun chad pa yin no zhes 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir khyab lte/ lung phyi ma la brten nas sems can thams cad 'tshang ba dang 'tshang rgya nges dang 'tshang rgya ba'i dus srid pa rnams legs par grub 4/ /rtsartags gnyis pa ma grub na/ gtor ba'i snga mtha' de lubor ba'i snga mtha' yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyig 'dod na/ de chos can/ gtor ba yin par thal/ dngor ba'i snga mtha' yin pa'i pyidgangor gsum/ 'dod na/ rang rgyu ma rig ba las byung bar thal/ lasad pa'i phyig 'dod na/ khyod kyi sngar byung ba'i zhanar ba yod par thal/ khyod kyi sngar byung ba'i ma rig pa yod pa'i pyid 'dod na/ lha'or ba'i snga mtha' chos can/ ga'or ba'i snga mtha' ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi sngar byung ba'i gshor ba yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ pa'or gsum/ ②rtags gsum ba ma grub na/ shes bya chos can/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pa'i dus mi srid par thal/ 'khor ba'i pyi mtha' med pa'i pyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya nges yin pa'i sgyig 'grel chung las/ skye 4 thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthar thug pa can yin lta/ zhes dang / ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas 'gyug /zhes dang] rgyud bla ma'i 'grel ba las/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i rigs yod pa'i phyir/ 'ga' yang gtan rnam par dag par mi 'gyur ba ni 'os ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi lung don grub pa'i sgyig gshor gsum/yang kha cig /sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya bar thal/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud kyi sgrib pa de gnyen 4sa gzhom rung yin pa'i phyir zer na/ kha cig na re/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud kyi sgrib ba yod par thal/ de gnyen pos gzhom rung yin pa'i phyir na rnam pa gcig tu ma khyab ste/ rgyun mtha' bas sgrib pa spang dgos pa yin pa'i phyig 'o na/ sems can yin na 465
phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/sgrib pa rgyud ldan yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i sems can chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgrib pa rgyud ldan ma yin par thal/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ zhakhor gsum/ yang kha cig /sgrib pa rgyud la mi ldan pa'i gang zag yin na/ sgrib pa'i dngos gnyen rgyud la thob myong yin dgos zer na/ sems can thams cad chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub zin/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ lam rgyud ldan ma yin pa'i phyis ma grub na/ lam ma zhugs kyi sems can de lam rgyud ldan yin par thal/ sems can thams cad lam rgyud ldan yin pa'i phyig zhakhor gsum/ yang kha cig /tshig la 'khris nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyis 'dod na/ sems can thams cad sgrib pa spangs pa zhig yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems can thams cad la sgrib pa ma spangs pas ma khyab par thal/ sems can sgrib pa spangs pa dang ma spangs pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir zer na/ 'o na/ sems can med pa'i dus srid par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na sems can med pa'i phyir/'dod na/ re zhig songaka sems can med pa srid par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems can med pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyis 'dod na/ sems can yin na yod pas ma khyab par thal/ sems can med pa zhig dang yod pa zhig dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ khas blangs rnams rim bzhin song / lubor gsum/ yang kha cig /gsar ba bye brag pa la mtha' yod na gshor ba la mtha' yod dgos te/ bum pa la yod na dngos po la yod dgos pa'i phyir zer ba la kha cig na re/ dngos 4 la dgag gzhi yod par thal/ bum pa la dgag gzhi yod pa'i phyir zer na ma khyab/ 'o na/ bum pa'i dgag gzhi bum pa la yosnad pa'i chos can yin par thal lerdzo/ /'dod tshul brjod pa de'i mig 'dod na/ ri 'ong rwa'i dgag gzhi ri 'ong rwa la yod par thal/ bum pa la 466
'khor ba la mtha' yod med dpyad pa/de'i phyig gshor gsum gyi lusar lo yod pas glang rgan khrod du ma (1)rgyug cig /de sogs tshig pikhyi gcod dgos/bzhi pa nyan rang dgra bcom zeg chen lam du gang nas 'jug dpyad pa la kha cigan re/ nyan rang dgra bcom theg chen lam du 'jug pa'i tshe dang por sa brgyad pa nas 'jug ste/nyon sgrib sa 'on dang bcas pa spangs zin pas de man chad du zhugs pa la dgos pa med la shes sgrib spong pa'i mgo sa brgyad pa nas rtsom pa'i phyir zhes rgya nag 'grel chen bzhed do/ /'o na skabs 'dir bden 'dzin skor dgu la shes sgrib tu lasdog pa ma yin par thal/ shes sgrib slong pa'i mgo sa brgyad pa nas rtsom pa'i phyis khyab ste/ de nas spong ba'i mgo rtsom pa thal 'gyur bas bden 'odzin nyon sgribadang de'i bag chags shes sgrib tu byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ rtsabad gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang] /bedzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni/ /zhes pa'i lung don grub pa'i pyid gzhan yangaka zeg chen tshogs lam pa las nyan zos tshogs lam pa 'tshang rgya ba myur bar thal/ de gnyis kyi nang nas nyan thos tshogs lam pa sa brgyad pa thob pa myur ba'i phyisrtags 〈snang/ der thal/zeg chen tshogs lam pas sa brgyad pa thob pa la bskal chen grangs med gnyis la tshogs bsag da〈snas pa gang zhig/nyan thos tshogs lam pas dgra bcom pa tshe gsum la thob cing sa brgyad pa nas zhugs tshog pa'i phyir/ dang 4 grub lte/ 'grel chen las/ bskal ba grangs med pa dang pos ni tshogs lam nas brtsams te sa dang po'i bar du rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pas ni dri ma med pa'i sa nas bzung lte bdun pa'i bar du'o/ /yang bskal ba grangs med pa gsum pas ni mi g.yo ba nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ mdzod las/ myur ba srid pa gsum gyis mthag /zhes wawa—— wa wa— —— —1 pa ra zengs gnyis pa/ rgyugs 'ag 467
phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/gsungs pa'i pyid gabar 'dod mi nus te/ de gnyis las theg chen rigs nges tshogs lam pa myur ba'i phyir/ der thal/ snga mas bskal ba grangs med gsum dang pyi mas bzhir tshogs bsags nas 'tshang rgya bar a skyo ka ras bshad cing / snga mas grangs med sum cu rtsagasum du tshogs bsags nas 'tshang rgya na phyi mas bzhi bcu bsags nas 'tshang rgya bar dge ba lhas bshad pa'i phyig dang 'o grub ste/ thub dgongs las/ gnyis po de dag kyang bskal ba grangs med pa bzhi mngon par rdzogs nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid 'ba' zhig go/zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ :snad 'jug 'grel ba las/ 'di ni byang chub kyi sems kyi stobs kyis nyan thos dag las kyang byang chub sems dpa' tha na bskal ba grangs med pa bzhi bcus myur bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs ba'i pyid khyab ste/ gser phreng las/ snga ma ltar na grangs med gcig dang / phyi ma ltar na grangs med bzhi bcus byang chub sems dpa' las bul lo/ /zhes dngaka rnam bshad las/ 'de la brten nas theg pa chen sar rigs nges pa dang gnas skabs nyan thos su rigs nges pa dus mnyam du tshogs lam du 'jug pa gnyis bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa la theg pa chen po'i rigs can ches shin tu myur zhing] gcig 〈snas ches shin tu bul ba'i khyad par yang shes par sga zhes gsungs pa'i migdes na rang lugs ni/ nyan rang dgra bcom theg chen lam du 'jug tshe dang khor theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas 'jug par thal/ dgra brtsom de gnyis zhi ba'i dbyings la snyoms 'jug gi 'phen pa ma zad bar du mi ldang zhing zad la nye ba na 'od dpag med la sogs pa'i sku'i 'od zer gyis sad par byas nas gsung gis bskul bas/ theg chen gyi lam du 'jug pa'i tshe sa gser zla ba lta bu'i sems bskyed mngon du byed pa'i phyig rtags dang 4 grub lte/ lang gshegs las/ting nge 'dzin gyi lus thob nas/ /bskal ba'i bar du mi sad do/ /dper na skyes bu myos pa 468
'khor ba la mtha' yod medadapyad pa/ni/ /rtsu1sa 'gyur med na sangs pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas chos zhes bya ba thob/ /ces dreg/ /rtags gnyis pa grub lte/ gsung gis khyod da dung myang 'das mthar zug ma thob pas 'tshang rgya ba'i zeg pa tshol zhes skul ba'i phyig pad dkar las/ 'de ltar mya ngan 'das par gang brjod pa/ /gangor (shā smaṃ ghnā two /pa )pa pa( sbyo/ tha'e rdoso] /khye/shā ༵ /( ༈ ༵ ṭwāṃ spya (sa ༵ sna ༷/la/ ༵༵/ ༷pa sangs rgyas dgrabacom padedag zhi ba'idabyings las langs te/ lam mchog shes par byed pan skabs dang lo nas bstan pa'i sems bskyed pa thog mdang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang sor byas te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ nyan rang la bdag med rtogs pa yod med gang gi lugs byas kyang zeg chen lam du 'jug tshe tshogs lam nas 'jug dgos pa'i phyir te/ tshogs lam gyi skabs su tshogs gnyis mtha' yas par thos bsam gyis gtan la phab ste/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gis bskal ba grangs med par sgom pas sa dang po'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs thob pa'i phyid rnam bshad las/ des na nyan thos la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod pa'am/ med par 'dod kyang rung lte theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam nas 'jug par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ nyan rang dgra bcom zeg chen lam du 'jug tshe zeg chen mthong lam nas 'jug par thal/ de dag sa dang por lhag bsam dag pa'i sa nas 'jug pa'i phyig rtog ge 'bar ba las/ de ltar na yang nyon mongs pa med pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i phyig sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskul ba na rab tu grar ba byed de des dang bor lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa'i sa nas nye bar bzung nas byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud pa yang kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin par ltabar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de dag thog mar 'jug tshul min la/ bden 'odzin spong ba'i thog ma bstan pa 469
phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/yin cing / rgyu 'bras bdun gyi lhag bsam la sbyar yang lam rim dang sgom rim kun kyang mthun pas shin tu legs pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ sems bskyed dang po gsum bskyed nas skabasadang po'i gdams ngag gis zeg chen gyi tshogs lam phal ba ste chung ngu sbyangs nas skabs bzhi pa nas bstan pa'i thar ba'i cha dang mthun pa bskyed pa'i pyid 'grel bshad las/ nyarna thos dang rang sangs rgyas de dag /ces pa nas/ sems bskyed pa thog ma dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang por byas nas gdams ngag la brten nas tshogs kyi lam phal ba sbyangs nas skabs bzhi pa nas bstan pa'i thar ba'i cha dang mthun pa bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigde la kho na re/'o na 'phags pa so skyer 'gyur ba yin par thal/ de dag zeg chen so skye'i sa nas 'jug pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ lang gshegs las/ nyan thosadang rang sangs rgyas rnams bag chags kyis nya5sa padangatingasnga 'odzin gyis myos pa med par gyuranas/ zag pa med pa'idabyings las slar sad de yang 'jig rten gyi dang 'jig rten las 'das pa zag pa med pa'i dbyings su gtogs pa'i tshogs rnams yongs su bskanganas chos kyi sku bsam gyis 'i khyab pa ladabang byed par rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ 'jig rten zhes pa theg chen so skye la bhyoradagos pa'i phyir te/de'i 'dzig rten gyi tshogs bshad pa'idon yod pa'i pyid ladod mi nus te/de'i tshe 'phags pa'i chos thob pa'i so skye masan pa'i pyid kun btus las/ so so skye 4 gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i chos ma thob pa la gdags sesna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis /470
gnyis pa lam shes kyi rang bzhin nam ngo 4 ston par 'grel chen las/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni gangor ba ji srid pag zhes sogs byung] mtha' dpyad pa la/ bod snga rabs pa kha cig mchen/ na re/ 'dir mi spong rgyu'i nyon mongs ni snying rje la nyon mongs su btags pa yin par thal/ btags pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i phyir te/ srid par mtshams spyor bar 'dra ba'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje ni srid par dga' bar byed pa lte/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ rtsabar 'dod na/ nyan thos kyi lam gyis ched du gtan nas spang bar bya ba'i nyon mongs kyang btags pa bar thal lo/ /'dod mi nus lte/ byang 'phags kyis nyon mongs ched du gtan nas mi spong bar rang gi byang chub bsgrub pa'i yan lag tu byed pas nyan thos kyi lam las rang bzhin khyad par zhugs par ston pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snying rje dang smon lam gyis lhangor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po sogs kyi lus bzung nas sras stong sogs bskyed pa'i yan lag byed pa'i phyir/ 'od srung gis zhus pa las/ ji ltar grong khyer ser skya'i mi gtsang lud/ /de ni bu ram shing ba'i zhing la phan/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /des ni sangs rgyas chos rnams skyed la phan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ 'dir bshad nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin kyang / byang 'phags rnams skye ba len pa'i rgyur dgos pa yin te/ nyi snang las/ 'dod pa dang srid pa'i zag pa ni min te/ bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba len pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/ 'o na byang 'phags rnams las nyon gyi dbang gis gsar du skye ba yod par thal/ skye ba len pa'i rgyur dgos pa de'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ byang 'phags las nyon gyis gsar du skye 'chi byed pa spangs pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla ma 47/
phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/papas/ /paspri rnyi ༵ rnyi na snang dzo sna rsha phyi/ra/ dzño dzño / smi kṣiṃ snang ༵ ṭwāṃ sa zlo ༵/nga/ kṣiṃ dhri snang/ spya/ 'phags rigs nges kyi ma'ong lam pas 'dod pa'i nyon mongs mi spong zer na/ 'dod pa'i sas dīspras 〉〉 traṃ hāpa ༵ (dī ṭwāṃ 14 parnyi /shā hūm̐ 59 bsna pa/nā trā sna sdi (rnyi lha /mipa (( zad kyang med pas mthong spang rnams mthong lam nas spangs pa'i phyir/ nyi snang las/ ma rig pa dang lta ba'i bag la nyal 〈snang gi /zhes dang / rnam bshad las/ nyon 3(ngas can gyi ma rig pa dang log lta sogs gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu dgos pa cung zad kyang med pa'i/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyissmras pa/rdzongs 'dir 'gal 'du mang bris khur che yang] /legs bshad skad du brag cha ltar slog byed/ /'phags seng rang lugs padma bye ba'i tshogs/ /cig car bzhad pa'i 'od stong 'di na 'chag /thal rang bzhed gzhung 'o ma bu ram gyi/ /mngar khyad ji bzhin shes kyang bshad dka' ba/ /kho bos ku sha'i 〉ltar ma 'dres shing] /gsal ba stong 'khun za 'og ri 36 bzhin/ /zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /472
gnyis pa lam shes kyi rang bzhin la/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang / rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang] byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes gsum/ dang po la/ lam shes kyi ngo 'o dang] rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bshad pa gnyis/ dang 4 ston pag lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ /nas/ nyan thos lam 'di shes par sga /zhes byungan 'phros mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang 4 ni/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen 4 rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs ni mi rtag sna sprad shā dzño rshaswā /ga/ stormo dmo ba hūm̐ ṭwāṃ /shā dīhā kā spra ༵ ñtsā snang nāṃ dzo (srang] /ga/pa pa mtha' dpyad pa la kha cig na re/ mdo'i sgras zin la nyan thos kyi lam bstan zer na/ 'o na mdo las mi rtag pa nyid du yid la bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dngos bstan mi rtag pa yid la byed pa de nyan thos kyi lam yin par thal/ mdo'i sgras zin la nyan thos kyi lam bstan pa'i phyis rtags shālha /la pad spya / ༵ sdu shāsdi rṇi ༵ rnyisna smyo/ ṭā shāstan ṭhaṃ hūm̐ /pa smra/ ṭwāṃ kṣiṃ tshosmra lam med de/ yod na mi rtag sogs su yid la byed pa la 'dod dgos na/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod na/ rten byang sems dang kun slong sems bskyed dang bden par mi dmigs pa'i shes rab dang thabs rnam mkhyen du bsngo ba gsum gyis zin pa'i lam ma yin bar thal de nyan thos kyi lam yin pa'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/ mdo dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyig gser phreng las/ de yang yid la byed pa 'o byang sems dang kun slong theg dman 'dod pa dang ma 473
phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/'dris pa'i rnam mkhyen yid byed dang / yid la byed tshul mi dmigs pa'i rnam par yid la bya bar gsungs shing / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gser phreng las/ de ni sngar ltar rten kun slong yid byed mthar bsngo tshul rnams byang sems 'ba' zhig dang 'brel bar gsungs pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la kha cig na re/ de mi 'thad par thal/ 'di'i lam shes kyi yul gyi lam ni nyan thos kyi lam yin dgos la/ 'dir nyan thos kyi lam ma bshad par bden bzhi'i rnam pa bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ de'i lam shes par byed tshul yang dmigs yul 'di la rnam pa 'di ltar dmigs zhes shes par byed dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yul dang bral ba'i ye shes rkyang pas de'i dmigs rnam shes mi nus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dmigs rnam ma shes par yang shes pa'i rab dbye rtogs tshul med pa'i phyig gser phreng las/ dmigs rnam ma bcad par yang shes pa'i rab dbye rtogs par mi nus pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigyang kha cig na re/ skabs 'dir sgras zin gyi shes par bya rgyu la ga thos kyi lam lajug mi rigs par thal/ mdo'i sgras zin gyi shes par bya rgyu la nyan thos kyi lam ma bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ mdo'i sgras zin la bden bzhi'i rnam pa shes rgyu dang de dag bden par mi dmigs par shes tshul skyar ba tsam yin pa'i phyig 'di'i thad kyi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs ni mi rtag par yid la bya nye/ zhes pa nas/ dge ba'i rtsab de yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par ga thos kyi sar bgror mi 'jug /rang sangs rgyas kyi sar bgror mi 'jug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyid khyab ste/ 'di la rnam pa mi rtag pa dang mi dmigs pa tsam las dngos su ma bshad pa'i phyid gser phreng las/ mdo'i sgras zin la rnam pa rnams shes rgyu dang / mi dmigs pa shes tshul la sbyar yang / zhes gsungs pa'i 474
nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/phyis rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ bstan bcos 'dir nyan 'os kyi lam shes rgyu dang] mi rtag sogs kyi rnam pa rnams bden par mi dmigs par rtogs par shes tshul dudangos su mdzad pa'i phyir te/rtsabad 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi /rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni/ /nyan thos lam 'di shes par sga /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab ste/ dngos bstan mngon rtogs mdo las gab kyang rje btsun gyis bstan bcos su gsal bar bstan pa'i nyid gser phreng las/ de ltar byung yang mi mthun par mi bsam ste mngon rtogs kyi don ni mdo'i nang du gab pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid de la kho na re/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i lam ni nyan thos kyi lam bshad tshul ma yin par thal/ nyan thos kyi sde snod du bden bzhi la brten pa'i rnam pa bcu drug bshad cing / 'dir bden bzhi la brten pa'i rnam pa serdzo gsum bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ 'dir bden bzhi la brten pa'i smi bhee //pa shlau ṭwāṃ sbyoXkhri /༷ ༷spyi smo khri| ༷ ༷ shlau ra/smaṃ hūm̐ two snrorsha rnyis/rnaspridzo rsha hūm̐ chi /dī pa (/spru/ /na dzño ñtsha shā/shā spra so/ 'dzi~X shā (spriswā/ papa rnyi mp+raṃ/ /ji rṇi ryaṃ sprispri ñtsā spraX tshormo spridī ram̐/ spra hūm̐ rdzu/sa/ hūm̐ ༵ ṭwāṃsdu sa /(sna ༵ snashā /shā pa// traṃ // druṃ bya//ga/sdupa rtsupya ba ārsha da|/lha/kā me/ spru ((shā ba tā rshadī ]ṭwāṃ 〉spra ༷/lha rtsu pa / g.yo ba nyid dang] rab tu sngag pa nyid dang] sngags pa nyid dngad 'go ba'i nad nyid dngamanye bar 'tshe ba nyid du yid la bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ dang 4 bzhi sdug bden gyi rnam pa 475

phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/mtshan nyid zer na/ de 'dra'iwe shes chos can/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas par thal/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin pa'i phyig khyab ste/ de la nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs shig dgos pa'i sgyid mdo las/ gzugs ni mi rtag pa nyid du yid la bya'o zhes sogs kyis nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi 'dzin ltangs bshad pa'i phyig ma khyab na/ mi rtag sogs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lamade nyan zos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shesasan par thal/ma khyab pa de'i nyid gdod na/ de chos can/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyid gdod na/ slob lam na bden gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pa yod par thal lo/ /gdod na/ slob lam na mnyam rjes gnyis ngo ṭo gcig tu gyur pa'i ye shes yod par thal lo/ /gshor gsum/ gzhan yang / nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin na rnal 'gror mngon sum yin dgos par thal/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid 'thad pa'i phyig 'dod na/ gang zag gi bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ de yod pa'i pyid 'grel ba las/ de dag gis shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po nyid du sgom pa'i lam zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag ba med gnyisasan pas lam rnam pa gsum 〈sna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gyig 'khodar gsum/yang kha cig /nyan thos kyi lam rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid zer na/ de 'dra'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ nyan thos kyi lam rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i pyid ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ gzhi grub pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin na/ nyan thos kyi shes rab kyi rtogs rigs yin pas khyab par thal/ skye med gsum bshad pas theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs 'byed pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ gdodan/ gang zag 478
nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/gi bdag 'edzin spang bar 'dod pa'i theg chen mthong lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/ nyan zos kyi thabs kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i sgyig der thal/ de 'dra'i nyam thos kyi mthong lam nyan thos kyi thabs yin pa'i phyirate/ nyan thos kyi byang chub thob 'dod kyi sems bskyed de nyan thos kyi thabs yin pa'i mig yang kha cig na re/ nyan zos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ de la kho na re/ byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin par thal/ nyan 'os la de'i phyig 'dod na/stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin par thal/ byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ bdag med gsum rtogs rigs so sor lasdog tshul yod pa'i pyid rtsabar 'dod na/ byang sems kyi lam shes yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ nyan 'os kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin na/ nyan thos kyi lam shes yin mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ nyan thos kyi lam shes med pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ sangs 'phags kyi lam shes yin pa'i phyidyang kha cig na re/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shesadang rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ byang 'phags rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes de de gnyis ka yin pa'i phyig der thal/ de rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gang zag gi bdag med rang rgyal slob pa 'phags pa'i bsgom bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin de'i spang bya'i gtso 'o yin pa'i phyigder thal/ thar pa de'i 'jub bya'i gtso 'o yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin de rang rgyal gyi thar pa thob pa la sgrib pa'i gtso 'o ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de rang rgyal gyi gzung bedzin 479
phar phyin skabs gnyis pa/rdzas gzhan du 'odzin pa'i gzung rtog rags pa spangs pa'i spangs pa thob pa la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa'i gtso 4 ma yin pa'i phyig der thal/ de spangs na shes sgrib gzung rtog rags pa spangs pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ nyan thos mi slob pa yod pa'i 9ga yang kha cig na re/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gtso bor sgom pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam med zer na/ de gtso bor sgom pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam yod kyang byang sems kyi sgom lam med pa'i khyad par 'byed mi rigs par thal de gtso bor sgom pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam med pa'i pyid rtags khas/ 'dod na/ rnam bshad las/ lam 'diyang mthong lam gyi skabs nyid du sgom par byed kyi sgom lam gyi gnas skabs su goms pa lhur len byed pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes khyad par phye nas gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/'dod pa'i pyid byas pa la kho na re/'onade bsgom bya'i gtso 'or byasanas sgom pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa yod par thal/ de gtso 'or bsgom pa'i byang sems ma'ong lam pa yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ de de'i bsgom bya'i gtso 'o ma yin pa'i pyid der thal/ bden med de byang sems mthong lam pa'i sgom bya'i gtso 'o yin kyang gang zag gi bdag med de ma yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi spang bya'i gtso 'o shes sgrib yin kyang nyon sgrib ma yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi 'jub bya'i gtso 'o thams cad mkhyen pa yin kyang thar pa ma yin pa'i phyiggnyis pa rang lugs la/ sems bskyed bsngo ba stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab gsum gyis zin cing nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i ched du shes par bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de/ 'dir bstan nyan thos kyi lam shes paXpa pahā lha ༈ ༵༵ shā trā/ (shārnyi lhaX kau dī rnyi tha lha( 35 /rsha sduX/ stu rnyi/33 tā ghnā re/ nyan thos kyi thabasasanan nyan thos kyi shes rab masanadagos par thal/ thabs shes kyi rtogs 480

nye ring gi rgyu mtshan/mngon sum gyis bden bzhi'i lnga sa rnams ming dang ma 'dres par yul du byed par gsungs pa dang /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ de shing rta chen po'i dgongs pa yin pa'i pyid kun btus las/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes pas bden pa'i rnam pa la 'jug pa na/ mi rtag pa'i don mthong gi /mi rtag pa nyidado zhes bya b.rani mayinano/ /mi rtag pa nyid ji ltab bzhin du rnam pa lhag ma rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyig yang kha cig na re/ srid mthar lhung ba'i tshad la las nyon gyi skye ba chad tsam la gcig tu thob byar zhen pa zer na/ 'o na/ 'di'i chad pa'i myang 'das la las nyon kyi skye ba zad pa kho nas tshog par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i 9ga 'dod mi nus te/ der ma zad snying rje dang smon lam gyis skye ba yang 'gog gdod pas myang 'das don gnyer dgos ba'i phyig rnam bshad las/ las nyon gyis skye bar ma zad snying rje dang smon (1)lam gyis skye ba yang 'dog 'dod pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig (2)'didag la spro bya mang mod yi ge mang dogs des shes par gyis/gnyis pa rang lugs la/ srid zhi'i mtha' ngos 'dzin pa dang / de la gnas tshad/ de lasag byed kyi lam bshad pa dang / gzhi shes kyi mtshad nyid bshad pa dang / de'i dbye ba gnyen po dang mi ma/thun phyogs kyi gzhi shes bshad pa lnga/ dang po ni/ las nyon gyis rang dbang med par nyingan mtshams sbyar ba'i 'khor ba ni/ kun rdzob la stos pa'i srid mtha' dang /gshor mtha' yin te/ srid pa'i rgud pa yin pa'i phyir/ so skye'i rgyud dang nyan rang rgyud kyi lubor ba rnams mtshan gzhi/ rnam bshad las/ tshu rol ni so so skye bo la lhos pa ste tshur ngos na yod kyi/ gshor ba chad pa'i phar ngos na med pa'i don mo/ /zhes so/ /las ton gyis nying mtshams sbyar nas rgyun ring bor zhugs 1 pa razengasaganasapa/lamagyisakyang/2 pa ra〉ngasarganas pa /rengs517
phar phyin skabs gsum pa/pa'i dngor ba de/ 'dir bstan tshu rol dngor ba'i rtag mtha' yin kyang rtag mtha' ma yin te/ rtag mtha' yin pa mi srid cing 'dir dngor ba yin pa'i pyid gagor mtha' thams cad la 'dir bstan rtag mtha' zhig mi dgos pa'i phyig de la yun ring bor gshor bar nying mtshams sbyar bas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ rgyun ring 'or 'jug pa'i don yin gyi/ rtag dngos kyi mtha' ni min no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig las nyon kyis skye ba chad par ma zad snying rje dang smon lam gyis skye ba chad tsam gyi myang 'das de/ kun rdzob la stos pa'i pha rol zhi mtha' dang zhi mtha' gnyis ka yin te/ de zhi ba'i rgud pa yin pa'i phyig rnam bshad las/ chad mtha' yang las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba chad par ma zad snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis skye ba chad pas thob pa'i myang 'das 〈sna/ /zhes sesna/ /de las nyon gyi skye ba'i mjug gi cha yin pas 'dir bstan chad mtha' yin kyang chad mtha' ma yin te/ chad mtha' gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir dang /de zad pa'i mjug cha la bzhag pa'i phyig rnam bshad rigs pa las/ mtha' ni zad dang mjug cha dang //zhes gsungs pa'i pyiggsor ba don dam par grub pa de/ 'dir bstan don dam la ltos pa'i srid mtha' yin te/ srid pa la mtha' gcig tu don dam par dor byar zhen pa'i yul yin pa'i phyis chad pa'i myang 'das don dam par grub pa de/ 'dir bstan donadam la stos pa'i zhi mtha' yin te/ srid par skye ba chad tsam gyi myang 'das la mtha' gcig tu donadam parador byar bzung ba'i zhen yul yin pa'i phyid rnam bshad las/ srid zhi'i mtha' la bden par zhen pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'grel chen las/ de kho na nyid du dmigs pa'i 'du shes ni phyin ci log tu 'jug pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin pa de'i phyig zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gnyis pa ni/ thabs shes khyad par can dang bral zhing srid par las nyon du ma zad snying rje dang smon lam gyi skye ba la yang mtha' gcig tu dor byar zhen pa de/ kun rdzob la stos pa'i srid mthar lhung ba'i tshad yin te/ de rgyud la ldan tsam gyis mi chog 518
nye ring gi rgyu mtshan/par bshad zin pa'i phyig sgom rim bar ba las/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab 'ba' zhig gis ni nyan cas bzhin so zhes gsungs pa'i phyidthabs shes khyad par can dang bral bas rang gcig pu'i don du srid par skye ba chad tsam gyi myang 'das la mtha' gcig tu blang byar zhen pa de/ zhi mtha' la gnas pa dang lhung ba'i tshad yin te/ der lhung ba dang gnas pa blo'i dbang gis yin te/ sgom rim bar ba las/ nyan thos rnams kyi ni snying rje chen po dang bral bas thabs dang mi ldan pa yin te/ de bas na gcig tu mya ngan las 'das pa la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid 'di'i shugs la zhi mthar lhung tshad yin par shes par gyis/ don dam la stos pa'i srid mthar lhung ba'i tshad yod de/ thabs shes med cing rang don du dngor ba la mtha' gcig tu don dam par dor byar zhen pa de yin pa'i sgyiddon dam la ltos ba'i zhi mthar ltang pa'i tshad yodade/ thabs shes med cing rang gcig phu'idon du myang 'das la don dam par mtha' gcig tu blang byar zhen pa de yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/srid zhi'i mtha' la bden par zhen pas/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du shes pa med pa'i phyig zhes dang /gser phreng las/nyi tshe ba'i yum ni gsor 'das la zhen nas gnas pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'di dag gis don dam par srid zhi'i mthar lhung tshad gnyis ka bshad pa'i sgyid gsum pa ni/ thabs kyis zin pa'i mi rtag sogs rtogs pa'i shes rabade/ kun rdzob la stos pa'i srid mtha' 'gog byed yin te/ srid rtsalasdoms pa'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/sgom rim las/ de dag kyang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi stobs kyis nyon mongs pa mtha' dag spangs pas 'khor bar yang mi lhung / zhes gsungs pa'i pyid byang sems rgyud kyi snying rje chen 4 ni/kun rdzob la ltos pa'i zhi mtha' dang chad mtha' 'gog byed yin te/ de'i dbang gis lubor bar skye ba yang yang blangs nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das sgrub pa'i phyid sgom rim las sems can 519
phar phyin skabs gsum pa/thams cad la lta bas ba〈snad nams kyi tshogs rgya che zhing tshad med pa'i dbang gis mya ngan las 'das par yang mi ltang ngo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ sems can la lta zhes pas sems can tshad med pa'i don du zhing sna tshogs su skye ba bstan pa'i phyir/ sngar bshad zin/ byang sems kyi thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i srid zhi bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab de/don dam par srid zhi'i mthar lhung ba'am gnas pa 'gog byed yin te/ des dus gsum pa'i chos rnams bden pa'i skye med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyig 'grel ba las/ dus gsum ga'i chos rnams skye ba med pa'i rnam par mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa/ zhes dang / 'grel chen las/shes rab dang snying rje dag yang dag par rtogs pas gsar ba dang myangan las 'das pa gnyis maradamigs pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab lte/ dmigs pa dang bral ba zhes pas dngor 'das bden par ma dmigs pa bshad pa'i phyir/ des na bden grub gangor 'das la ma sbyar bar spang blang du bden par zhen pa (1nyisar ba chen po yin te/ bya ba'i yul dang bya ba gnyis gzhi gcig la mi 'thad pa'i phyig thal 'gyur bas kyang kun rdzob la stos pa'i srid zhir lhung tshul 'dra yang / nyan rang 'phags pa don dam la lhos pa'i mthar lhung ba mi 'dod cing nyan rang so skye rtul 'o lhung bar 'dod dgos so/ /bzhi pa ni/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de/ gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ lten gyi slo nas 'phags bzhi'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes bzhi/ rtogs rigs kyi sgo nas nyan rang gi rtogs rigs gnyis yod/ sa mtshams/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod/ 'phags rgyutshod kyi mkhyen pa la mkhyen gsum gang rung gis ma khyab ste/ dgra bcom rtogs pa sngon song gi byang sems tshogs lam pa'i ——1 pa razengasaga'us pa/ror sa/520
nye ring gi rgyu mtshan/sems bskyed dang / lhag bsam sogs dang / ga rang 'phags rgyud kyi stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yi shes lta bu rnams gzhi shes su ma bshad pa'i sgyig lnga pa la/ bden 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i zeg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ nyan rang gi mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum yod/ sa mtshams/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam nas nyan rang dgra bcom gyi bar du yod/ thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin cing thegadaman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma dang / byang sems skye 'phags gnyis dang /sangs 'phags bzhi spu'i rgyud kyi de bzhi yod/ sa mtshams/ theg chen lam du 'jug kha'i lhag bsam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod/ snying rje chen 4 dang bral zhing mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i gzhi shes de/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de dang / 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes/ mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i gzhi shes gsum don gcig lte/ bden 'odzin gtso bor mi spong bar rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi gzhi shesayin zhing de des bcings pa'idon yin pa'i nyid thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin cing zeg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pade/ gnyen 4 phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de dang / 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes dang / lhag bsam rgyud ldan gyi 'phags rgyud kyi gzhi shes rnams don gcig /sa mtshams/ lhag bsam rnam dag rgyud la skyes pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar lasdog /gzhi shes 'de gnyis 'dod pa'i sems tsam pa dang rang rgyud pa'i slob dpon mang lte/ byams chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i pyid gser phreng las/ de'i rjes su 'bunganas thogs med sku mched dang blo gros brtan pa la sogs pa'i/zhes panas/ slobadasan chen po legs ldan 'byedadang zhi 'tshodapon slob dang 'phags seng rjes 'bungasadang bcas pa'i 521

nye ring gi rgyu mtshan/de 'phags pa yab sras kyis dgongs par slob dpon zla grags dang zhi ba lha gnyis rjes 'brang dang bcas pas bkral ba'i phyir te/ gser rlung las/ de lta na dpal ldan zla grags/ dza ya a nan ta/ slob dpon zhi ba lha/ sher 'byung / dge ba si bi ma la mi tra rnams nyan rang la chos rang bzhin med par rtogs pa yod par bzhed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisgsum pa rtsod pa spong ba la kho na re/ nyan rang 'phags rgyud kyi gzhi shes chos can/ mi mthun phyogs yin par thal/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir na 'gal khyab yin te/ de (1)byang sems lam la ltos pa'i mi mthun phyogs yin kyang sbyor gnyen po yin pa'i phyir te/ 'phags lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'grel ba las/ de bzhin gshegs pa la drenags pa la phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyu yin pa nyid kyis gnyen ṭo yin mod kyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes yin na bden 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i gzhi shes yin dgos par thal/ de yin na 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes yin dbosnas pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /thabs ma yin pas ring ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig ②bar 'dod na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan rang 'phags rgyud kyi de chos can/ bden 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i de yin par thal/ mi mthun phyogs kyide yin pa'i phyis khyab pa khas/ medod na/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ga rang gi mkhyen pa de/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin gyis bcings par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ nyan rang 'phags par bden 'edzin slong ba'i gnyen 4 med pasades bcings par bshad pa'i phyir te/ nyan rang 'phags pas rang lam du de spong bar mi byed pa'i phyig khyod rang la 'o na/gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan rang mthong sgom bar chad med lam pas gang — — — 1 pa ra thengasaganyis pa / byangasemasal stos/523
phar phyin skabs gsum pa/zag gi bdag 'dzin spong bar mi byed par thal/ bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan rang gi mthong lam pa dang sgom lam pas bden 'dzin spong bar mi byed pa'i phyis ma khyab na/ de'i rgyud des bcings par thal/ ma khyab pa de'i phyig yang kho na re/ gnyen 4 phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes gnyis 'dir bstan gzhi shes yin par thal/ de gnyis rtsabag de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la/ /zhes thenags kyi bstan bya'i gtso 'o yin pa'i phyig 'dod na/ de gnyis skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso 'osan par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyiran rnam pa gcig tu ma khyab/'dodan/ mi mthun phyogs kyide skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso 4yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na 'dor ma khyab/ ladod na/ gzhi shes de mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bstan bya'i gtso 'o yin par thal/don mngon rtogs brgyad mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bstan bya'i gtso 'o yin ba'i pyid khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ rtsabag shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos 4 brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i nyid gdod na/ skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso 'o yin na/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi de yin dgos par thal/ gdod pa'i phyig 'dod na/ skabs gsum pa'i shugs bstan bstan bya'i gtso 4 yin na/ rgyan gyi de yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu dang zeg chen sems bskyed nyer gnyis chos can/ rgyan gyi shugs bstan bstan bya'i gtso 4 yin par thal/ gsum pa'ide'i phyig gshor gsum/ 'dod mi nus te/dngos 4 brgyad dang don bdun cu gnyis tshigadon yan lag gi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa'i smig rnam bshad las/ gtan ladabab bya'i gtso bo rigs can gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyid524
mgo la me shor lta bur rab brtson kyang / /thabs mkhas bral na srid zhi'i mthar sgyung na/ /thabs dang shes rab 'grel ba'i lam bzang 4/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal ba'i lam tshol rigs/ /mkhas kyang pha ma'i grangs mtha' med pa'i 'gror/ /shes bzhin rang nyid gcig pu'i zhi bde'i dbyings/ /la zhugs ma rnams 'khor ba'i ngang tshul 'de/ /'phags pa yin kyang smad pa'i tshul la nye/ /rang nyid 'ching brgyas bcings kyang ma lus 'gro/slol 'dodadabugs 'byon rgyas sras dang po dang / /sgo nga'i sbrub rgya ma grol skad 'gyin pa'i/ /ka la ping das skye dgu ngo mtshar byed/ /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshegs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gzhi shes kyi bhyor ba la/ rab dbye dang / rang bzhin gnyis/ dang 4 ston paggzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang / /zhes sogs byung / 'phros bhyor mtha' dbyad gsum/dang 4 ni/ mdo las/ gal te gzugs la mi spyod na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gyod do/ /zhes pa nas/ sprul ba'i bar du 〈snam sems su mi byed pa de'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang sprul ba lta bu'i bar du yongs su shes bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i don ston par 'di byung / gnyis pa ni/ 'dir bstan byang sems kyi gzhi shes kyor ba chos can/ rnam pa bcu yod de/ yul gyi sgo nas bzhi/ngo po'i sgo nas gsum/ byed pa'i sgo nas gnyis/shes byed dpe'i sbyo ra ba gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ mtha' dpyad pa la gsum las/ dang po la kha cig na re/ gzhi kun rdzob ba dang don dam pa'i sdod lugs la phyin ci log tu zhen pa 525
phar phyin skabs gsum pa/'gog pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'phyor de/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gzhi shes bhyor ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam chos can/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gzhi shes sbyongar ba yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyig khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ bden 7ngon dngos su lasdoms byed kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ gzhi shes sbrengar ba ma yin pa'i pyid der thal/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa ma yin pa'i phyis der thal/ zeg chen gyi bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig de gzhi shes kyor ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i nyan thos kyi spyor lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyig der thal/ de 'dra'i nyan zos kyi mthong lam gzhi shes bhyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ don dam pa'i sdod lugs la phyin ci log tu zhen pa'i gnyen po ma yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ gzhi kun rdzob pa'i sdod lugs la phyin ci log tu zhen pa dang don dam pa'i sdod lugs la phyin ci log tu zhen pa gang rung gi gnyen por sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ 'dir bstan sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyongar ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i gyis lhagar gsum/ 'dod mi nus te/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su mi gnas pa'i phyig khyab ste/ rnam bshad las/ skabs 'dir stong nyid kyi rnam pa can gyi lam bshad pa ni gang gis zin pa'i lam de nyid ston pa yin gyi/ gzhi shes lhor ba'i mtshon byed ni gzhi shes kyi rnam pa can du shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigyang ku ma ra shri na re/ 'di'i gzhi shes rgyur ba spyor lam la byed zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ 'di'i gzhi shes bhyor ba lta sgom spyod 'bras sogs la mtshan mar 'dzin pa 'gog byed yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ des na ji srid mtshan ma de dag skye ba de srid du sgom dgos pa'i phyis526
gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba/gser phreng las/ ji srid mtshan ma de dag skye ba de srid du sgom dgos pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig yang kha cig na re/ sa bdun pa'i bar du yod zer na/ de yang mi 'thad par thal/ tshogs lamanas rgyun mtha'i bar du gzhi shes sbyongar ba 〈snad pa'i phyidagaser phreng las/ tshogs lam nas sa bcu'i bar la bzhag go/zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig kha cig na re/ bya dka' rnam gsum sbrengar ba gsum la byed par thal/ bya dka' ba gsum ni go cha'i dka' rgyud dang / 'jug pa'i dka' spyod dang /ston pa'i mtshan nyid kyi byed pa'i dka' rgyud kyi bhyor ba gsum la byed pa'i phyig der thal/'grel ba grags cha las/ sbrengar ba dka' ba rnam gsum dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ der de ltar bshad kyang mdo dang 'grel chen rnams dang mi mthun pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bya dka' ba gsum yul dang / sbyongar ba yul can du bshad pa'i phyig der thal/ ched du bya dka' ba rnam mkhyen dang athi+-ir ba de'i yul can yin/ lam shes sbyo4ra ba bya dka' ba dang sbyordzor ba de'i yul canadang /las byadaka' ba gzhi shesadang bhyor bde'i yul canayin pa'i phyig rtags zuradang po grub ste/nyi snang las/ ched du bya dka' ba nyidani rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de/(1) gang dag de la lhor bar 'dod pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ rnam mkha' grol 'dod pa ltar don dam par khyad par 'gror med cing tha snyad du sems can mi zad pas ched du bya ba rnam mkhyen thob dka' ba'i phyig nyi snang las/ de la bhyor bar 'dod pa de dag ni nam mkha' yongs su grol bar 'dod pa yin no/ /zhes dang / 'grel chen las kyang /tshos thams cad nam mkha' ltabur dmigs pade kho nag zhes gsungs pa'i phyig ②rtags gnyis pa grub lte/nyi snang las/ sbyordzor ba bya dka' ba nyid ni lam shes pa nyid de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ gdul bya'i rgyud la lam shes ——— ———— ———1 pa razengasaganyisapa/de nyid kyi nyam
phar phyin skabs gsum pa/(1)kyor ba'am lam shes skyed dgos kyang nam mkha' bar snang la btegs 'dod pa ltar don dam par skyed byer med cing tha snyad du sems can mi zad pa'i phyiganyi snang las/ gang dag de la 'bad par 'dod pa de dag ni nam mkha' bar snang la 'degs par 'dod pa yin no/ /zhes dang / 'grel chen las/ gang lam shes pa nyid la rab tu spru ra bar 'dod pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gartags gsum pa grub lte/ nyi snang las/ las bya dka' ba nyid ni thams cad shes pa nyid de gang dag de la rtsol bar 'dod pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab lte/ gdul bya'i sems can la de shes par byas nas ston dgos kyang don dam par bstan bya ma grub cing tha snyad du sems can mi zad pa'i phyig nyi snang las/ gang dag de la rtsol bar 'dod pa de dag ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu pyin pa thob pa nyidado/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gser phreng las/ bya dka' ba'i tshul ni bden gnyis kyi sgo nas sngar bshad pa nyid mdo dang 'grel chen rnams kyidagongs pa la 'grog go/zhes gsungs pa'i mig yang kha cig na re/ sbyongar bdang 4 dgu mnyam bzhag nas gtso cher sgom zhing bcu pa rjes zob na sgom zer na/ 'o na/ dang 4 dgu mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i dus su sgom par thal/ de dgu mnyam bzhag gi 〈snam lam yin pa'i phyig rtags khas/ khyab ste/ mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur bshad pa'i phyir te/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzungs las/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis ni chos thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil dang mtshungs par mthong ngos /de'i rjes la thob pas ni chos thams cad sgyu ma dang smig rgyu dang hra lam la sogs pa dang mtshungs par mthong ngo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis medod na/ gzugs sogs kyi rgyur ba dang /gzugs sogs mi rtag sogs kyi sbyordzor bdang /gzugs sogs la ma rdzogs padang rdzogs pa'i sbyongar ba gsum don dam pa'i rnam pa can yin par thal/ de mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i sbyongar —— —wawa— —— —1 b.razengs gnyis gakyor bas/528
gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba/ba yin pa'i phyig rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ de gsum kun rdzob la dmigs pa dang chags med la dmigs padon dam rnam can yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ kun rdzob ladamigs pa gsum dang don dam la dmigs pa gcig yod pa'i phyig zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ lhag ma kun rdzob la dmigs pa rtogs sla ba'i phyir/ gser phreng las/ spyor ba bcu po 'de rjes thob gtso che ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig byas pa la kho na re/ 'o na/ slob dpon gyis de dag yul du byas nas bden zhen 'gog par bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ dedag rjes thob gtso che ba'i phyiran ma khyab ste/ rjes thob bden grub bkag pa'i rdzun pa sgyu ma ltabur byed pa'i pyid gser phreng las/de dag tu zhen na de yang dgag dgos pa la dgongs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidgnyis pa rang lugs la/ gzhi kun rdzob pa dang don dam pa'i sdod lugs gang rung la phyin ci log tu zhen pa 'dog pa'i shes rab kyis zin cing / zeg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'dir bstan sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ 'dir bstan sems dpa'i gzhi shes bhyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ go thob byas/ rtsod tshe/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'dir bstan sems dpa'i rnal 'gyor de/ 'der bstan sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyongar ba'i mtshan nyid/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i de dang / rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs kyi sems dpa'i sbyo ra lam lta bu mtshan gzhi/ 'dir bstan bhyor ba la gzhi shes sbyongar bas ma khyab cing / dbye na bcu/ sa mtshams/ zeg chen tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du 〈snad/ gzhi kun rdzob pa dang don dam pa'i sdod lugs gang rung la log par zhen pa'i bden 'odzin gyi gnyen 4 med pa'i theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i spyor ba de/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi gzhi shes bhyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de dang theg dman gzhi shes bhyor ba don gcig ste/ 'grel ba las/ shugs kyis na nyan thos la sogs pa yi ni ji skad bshad pa las bzlog lte bhyor ba yin no/ /zhes 529
phar phyin skabs gsum pa/gsungs pa'i phyig yang kho na re/ snang ba rnam bdun brgyad stong par dngos su bstan par thal/'grel chen las/ dngos su gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ der bar ma brag cha bstan nas snga phyi gsum gsum shugs la bstan pa'i phyir/ 'grel chen las/ de ltar stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa pa rdzu ghnā /(rdzu lhasu/ sbyo rnghi shā rdzu rshadī ༵ ༵dī pa/da ༵ hūm̐/kṣiṃ do/sna zlo ( (sta/ papa /spya sdu da~X rten 'brel rnams chos can/ snang yang bden par ma grub ste/ bag chags 〈snangs su gyur pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rmi lam bzhin/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal 4 las/ ji ltar bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam na/ /bu pho byung zhing shi ba des mthong na/ /byung nas dga' zhing shi nas mi dga' ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes serdzo/ /chos can dang chos 'dra/ rgyu rkyen mnyam du tshogs pa las byung ba'i snang ba yin pa'i phyig dper na/ sgyu ma'i rta glang sogs bzhin/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ /rta dang glang ṭo shing rta sna tshogs byas/ /de la ji ltar snang ba gang yang med/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes serdzo/ /de don dam par med de/ bden par 'dzid par 'gal ba'i snang ba yin pa'i phyig dper na/ smig rgyu la chur snang ba bzhin/ ting 'dzin las/ smig rgyu la ni chur ni (1)yod med na/ /sems can slongs pa de la 'thung 'dod de/ /mi bden chu ni bltung bar (2)yod mi nus/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes serdzo/ /de bden par med de/ rkyen la rag las pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyig dper na/ brag cha bzhin/ mdo las/ ji ltar mi dag nags kyi khrod 'dug ste/ /glu len smra zhing gad mo rgod pa la/ /brag cha snang yang snang ba gang yang —— ——— —— ————— —1 bar zengasaganyisab/yong/2 b.razengs gnyis pa/yong /530
gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba/med/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes serdzo/ /de bden par med de/ snang yang bag chags lasdog byed kyi rnam pa las ma 'phos pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ chu zla bzhin/ mdo las/ ji ltar nam mkha' dwangs par zla shar ba/ /de yi gzugs brnyan dwangs pa'i mtshor snang yang / /zla ba chu yi nang du 'phos pa med/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes sesna/ /de bden par med de/ bden par grub pa'i rten med pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyid dper na/ yul gyi khyab par dang sprin dang nye ba'i rgyu las dri za'i grong khyer gyi snang ba byung ba bzhin/ de bden par med de/ don dam par byed pa 4 ma yin kyang byed par snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ sprul ba rnams 'gro 'ong dang smra brjod sogs byed par snang yang der ma grub pa bzhin/ sgyi ma gnyis ston par/ mdo las/ ji ltar sprul ba dri za'i krong khyer dang / /rmi lam ji bzhin sgyu ma ji bzhin du/ /mtshan ma sgom pa ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes them/ /yang kho na re/ 'di'i bhyor ba bcu theg dman rtogs rigs su gnas par thal/ gzhung 'dis gzhi shes sprungar ba bstan pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ dngos bstan gtso bo 3ga chen rtogs rigs kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin la/ shugs bstan la nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyor ba bstan pa'i phyig dang po grub lte/ de 'dra'i spyor lam 'da' byed mthong lam gyi rigs 'dra snga ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa can gyi spyor lam ni 'og nas 'chad pa'i 'da' bar byed pa'i mthong lam de nyid kyi rigs 'dra'i rgyu yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiskhyab lte/ dngos bstan gtso bo de ltar dang / phal ba la stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i mi rtag sogs rtogs pa'i gzhi shes lhor ba yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ de'i rgyu mi rtag serdzogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can gyi byang sems kyi sbrengar lam de nyid yin la/ zhes gsungs 531
phar phyin skabs gsum pa/pa'i phyid gong gi rtags gnyis pa grub lte/ rnam bshad las/ shugs kyis nyan rang gi sbrengar lam du bden 'dzin ma bkag par sgom par bstan pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/bden bedzin bkag nas bsgom na bden bedzin gyis mi 'ching yang de ltar ma bsgom pas des bcings par bstan pa'i phyig gzhan yang / ku ma ra shris/ spyor ba dang mnyam nyid sa mtshams so sor 'byed pa mi 'thad par thal/ de gnyis sa mtshams so sor byed pa'i shes byed med cing rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir/ dang 4 grub ste/ gser phreng las/ de la spyor ba ni drod rtsemo'i dbang po bcu'o/ /mnyam pa nyid ni bzod pa dang chos mchog gi stobs bcu'o/ /zhes zer ba la ni shes byed med cing / zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ rnam bzhi de'i mnyam nyid ni bhyor ba'i sgom tshul yin pas bhyor ba de dang sa mtshams so sor mi rung ba'i phyig der thal/ rnam bzhi bhyor ba'i sgom tshul yin pa gang zhig /des na de gnyis sa mtshams mi gcig pa la gnod byed du 'gyur ba'i phyis dang 4 grub ste/ nyi snang las/ ji ltar na rnam pa bzhi yin zhe na/ gzugs rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs kyis rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs bdag gi zhes rloms sems su mi byed/ gzugs la rlom sems su mi byed ces bya ba gang gsungs pa dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ de kyor ba'i sgom tshul yin pa'i phyig 'grel chen las/ mnyam pa nyid kyi sgo nas bhyor ba sgom dgos pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ de bzhis bhyor lam skabs su yang de thob pa la rlom sems bkag pas/ rtogs pa 4 dang rtogs yul sgya chos thams cad mi dmigs pa bzhir bshad pa'i phyis 'grel chen las/ rtogs pa po dang shes bya'i chos rnam pa thams cad du mi dmigs pa rnam pa bzhi gsungs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gser phreng las/ rnam bzhi de'i mnyam nyid ni spyor ba'i sgom tshul la gsungs bas/ zhes gsungs serdzo/ /gong gi rtags gnyis ba grub ste/ gser 532

phar phyin skabs gsum pa/rang gnyis kyi sgom lam zhig kyang yod pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ rtogs dka' las/thams cad shes pa nyid la nyarna thos dang byang chub sems dpa' dag gi sgom pa'i lam so sor med ce na/ zhes pa'i dris lan du/ nyarna thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi phun tshogs ni byang chub sems dpa'i shes pa dang mthong bas bltas nas 'da' bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ gser phreng las/ lan dang po byang sems kyi sgom lam dang / zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ lan gnyis pas nyan thos kyi sgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan du sbyar ba'i phyir/ der thal/ rtogs dka' las/ nyan thos la sogs pa la yang ji ltar mthong ba'i don nyid yang dang yang du mngon du byed pa sgom lam yin pas go sla ba'i phyir ma gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab lte/ lan gnyis pa des nyan zos kyi sgom lam ma bstan kyang go sla bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ gser rlung las/ gnyis pa nyan thos kyi sgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan du sbyar ba nyid slob dpon gyi dgongs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ skabs 'dir dngos su ma bstan pa'i sgom lam yin na/ skabs 'dir dngos su mi ston rgyu'i sgom lam yin pas khyab zer na/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyid 'dod mi nus te/byang chub sems dpa'i rang rgyud la shes bskyed bya rgyu'i de ma yin pa'i pyir/ yang kha cig na re/skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i sgom lam yin na/ theg dman rtogs rigs yin pas khyab zer ba dang / kha cig /de yin na/ byang sems sgom lam pas gtso sor mi sgom pas khyab zer ro/ /de gnyis la 'o na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi sgom lam chos can/der thal/ de'i phyig 'dod mi nus te/ shes sgrib slong phyir du goms pa lhur len gyis bsgom pa yin pa'i sgyid gra chung yon rgyam na re/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug goms pa lhur len gyis bsgom pa'i theg chen sgom lam de/ skabs 'dir dngos su mi ston rgyu'i sgom lam zer na/ 'o na/ de yod 538
